* **Physical and mental well\-being:** Access via OpenUp the online support from certified psychologists and lifestyle experts at no cost to you and your family
* **And Much More!** Discover additional perks and benefits when you join our team.


**Who we are**



We are Isar Aerospace and we are at the forefront of New Space building a modern space business to enable faster, better and cheaper access to space.



Our mission is to help democratise space and use it for good in order to improve life on Earth now and for the future generations.



We are a fast\-growing company aiming to provide sustainable and environmentally friendly launch solutions for small and medium\-sized satellites and constellations into Low Earth Orbit. The company is privately funded by world\-leading technology investors with strong commitment and support and our team is made of driven and talented people with a real passion for space innovation.



We're making rockets in a way that hasn't been done before disrupting a traditional industry. If you are up for the challenge, want to work on cutting\-edge projects and be part of a team changing the world for better, come, join us and launch your career!



Want to find out more about us?



Visit www.isaraerospace.com

jobs.title: System Engineer / IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Die **KÖSTER BAUCHEMIE** ist stark international ausgerichtet und mit über 20 Unternehmen in über 50 Ländern vertreten. Zu unseren Referenzen gehören das Empire State Building, die Metro von Barcelona, der Suez\-Tunnel und die Olympiahalle von Peking. Mehr Infos unter: **www.koester.eu**


Wir suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen  

  

**System Engineer / IT\-Systemadministrator (m/w/d)**



Als produzierendes Unternehmen verbinden wir klassische IT\-Infrastruktur mit den Anforderungen aus Produktion und Logistik. Viele unserer Lösungen entstehen dabei direkt bei uns im Haus – von Schnittstellen zu unserem ERP\-System bis hin zu eigenen Anwendungen, beispielsweise für mobile Scanner in Produktion und Lager. Bei uns hältst du also nicht nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen, sondern kannst Prozesse und Lösungen aktiv mitgestalten.


 **Deine Aufgaben**

  


* Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung unserer IT\-Infrastruktur in den Bereichen Netzwerk, Firewall, Windows Server und Clients,
* Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Microsoft\-Infrastruktur, insbesondere Active Directory, Gruppenrichtlinien und Remote Desktop Services,
* Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung unserer Virtualisierungsumgebung, aktuell auf Basis von VMware,
* Sicherstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Backup, Recovery und IT\-Sicherheit,
* Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Systeme und Schnittstellen rund um Produktion, Logistik und SAP,
* Mitgestaltung eigener Anwendungen und Lösungen zur Digitalisierung und Optimierung betrieblicher Prozesse,
* Analyse technischer Anforderungen sowie eigenständige Erarbeitung und Umsetzung passender Lösungen,
* Analyse und nachhaltige Behebung von Störungen sowie kontinuierliche Verbesserung unserer Systeme,
* Zusammenarbeit mit internen Fachbereichen und externen IT\-Partnern sowie

je nach Erfahrung und Interesse: Microsoft 365, Linux, Docker, Automatisierung und Scripting  
* 
 **Dein Profil**

  


* Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung oder Studium im IT\-Bereich,
* mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Administration von IT\-Systemen und Infrastrukturen,
* Erfahrung mit Virtualisierungstechnologien, idealerweise VMware; Kenntnisse in Proxmox sind ein Plus,
* gutes Verständnis für Netzwerktechnologien wie TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, LAN und VPN,
* Vertrautheit mit Backup\-Infrastruktur\-Lösungen (bspw. Veeam),
* Kenntnisse in Scripting oder Programmierung sind ein Plus, z. B. PowerShell, C\# oder .NET,
* selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie
* Teamgeist und gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

  





Uns ist nicht wichtig, dass du jede Technologie bereits perfekt beherrscht. Entscheidend sind eine solide technische Basis, ein gutes systemübergreifendes Verständnis und die Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.  



 **Wir bieten Dir**

  


* einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz mit langfristiger Perspektive in einem wirtschaftlich erfolgreichen und wachsenden Unternehmen,

jobs.title: Senior Go Backend Developer (Product Ops) (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product **Playtime Arcade**, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in\-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

**Keeping Platform Stability Front and Center for 770M\+ Users**


On the frontier of adjoe's most critical publisher relationships, the Product Operations team moves fast, cuts through complexity, and keeps our entire platform running. Operating across the full adjoe stack—backend services, SDKs, catalog, and integrations—we unblock strategic launches, build custom integrations, and resolve critical issues in production.


We act as the safety net for our product teams and the first line of defense for enterprise publishers like Venmo and PayPal. Beyond immediate troubleshooting, we build and scale high\-impact diagnostic tooling to automate root\-cause resolution across client\-side and microservice architectures. Combining cross\-stack technical depth with rapid execution, Product Operations ensures seamless performance wherever enterprise growth meets global scale.

**Your Mission \& Who We Are Looking For:**

* **5\+ years in Go, built for scale.** You have 3\+ years building production Go services and know how to profile and optimize applications under real traffic, not just identify bottlenecks, but eliminate them. You've worked on large Go applications with considerable daily request volume.
* **Distributed systems are your default context.** You design and operate microservice architectures using **Kafka** and **SQS/SNS** for reliable asynchronous communication, and are responsible for collecting and aggregating billions of daily API events into **Kafka** streams queryable from the data lake in seconds.
* **Data performance matters at every layer.** You work with **Druid**, **MySQL**, **Redis**, and **DynamoDB**, optimizing queries and data access patterns to deliver few\-millisecond response times. You know the tradeoffs between different storage solutions and when each one is the right tool.
* **Bridge product and Data Science.** You collaborate directly with Data Scientists to integrate ML algorithms that optimize ad delivery: translating complex mathematical solutions into production\-ready backend services.
* **Partner\-facing data ownership.** You support partners through well\-documented open APIs, providing raw or aggregated data transparently based on their business needs.
* **Infrastructure fluency is part of the job.** You have hands\-on experience with **Terraform**, **Docker**, and serverless infrastructure, owning services end\-to\-end from development to production.

**We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.**

**What’s in It for You?**


At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

* **Go Big.** Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.
* **Move Fast.** Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.
* **Be Direct.** Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.
* **Thrive Together.** Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.
* **Have Fun.** Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.


We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

Du möchtest nicht nur zusehen, wie KI die Softwareentwicklung verändert, sondern aktiv daran mitarbeiten? Dann werde Teil unseres Development\-Teams und gestalte mit uns intelligente Lösungen, die unsere Entwickler:innen produktiver machen und den Einsatz von KI im Entwicklungsalltag voranbringen.

* Du unterstützt bei der Automatisierung wiederkehrender Entwicklungsaufgaben und trägst dazu bei, unsere Prozesse kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
* Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Softwareentwickler:innen zusammen und sammelst wertvolle Praxiserfahrung in einem innovativen Entwicklungsumfeld.
**Dein Profil**
---------------

* Du bist immatrikulierte:r Bachelor\- oder Masterstudent:in der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Software Engineering oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs.
* Du hast Interesse an Softwareentwicklung und begeisterst dich für Themen wie Künstliche Intelligenz, Large Language Models oder Developer Tools.
* Idealerweise bringst du erste Erfahrungen mit Programmiersprachen wie C\#, Java, Python oder TypeScript mit.
* Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und bringst gerne neue Ideen ein.

* Du verfügst über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse (mindestens C1\) sowie gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens B2\), jeweils in Wort und Schrift.
* Du kannst uns **15 bis 20 Stunden** pro Woche unterstützen.
**Warum wir?**
--------------

* Spannende und praxisnahe Einblicke in modernes AI Engineering und innovative Softwareentwicklung
* Die Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen einzubringen und Verantwortung zu übernehmen
* Ein motiviertes Team, das Zusammenarbeit und Weiterentwicklung lebt

* Kostenlose Getränke (Kaffee, Wasser, Softdrinks) sowie frisches Obst zur Stärkung im Arbeitsalltag

**Über uns**
------------


Die EVEX Group ist der führende europäische Anbieter digitaler Lösungen für Optiker und Hörakustiker. Unter den Marken Amparex, IPRO, Euronet, Optix und Bludata unterstützen wir die führenden Akteure in Augenoptik und Hörakustik, ihre Kunden bestmöglich zu betreuen, wirtschaftlich erfolgreich zu sein und administrative Prozesse effizient zu gestalten.  

  

Mit unserer Präsenz in über 20 Ländern und einem breiten Technologie\- und Serviceportfolio schaffen wir digitale Infrastruktur, auf die sich tausende Expert:innen täglich verlassen. Unser Anspruch: Innovative Software mit echter Branchenexpertise verbinden – für einen einfacheren, smarteren und erfolgreicheren Arbeitsalltag unserer Kunden.  

  

Zu unseren Kunden – unseren Key Accounts – zählen zahlreiche führende Unternehmensgruppen in Europa, welche für ihre tägliche Arbeit am Kunden und ihr Wachstum auf EVEX zählen. In rund 14\.000 Fachbetrieben setzen unsere Kunden jährlich rund 8 Mrd. EUR um – mithilfe der Produkte und Dienstleistungen von EVEX.  

  

Die PE\-geführte EVEX Group befindet sich auf einem klaren Wachstumspfad: Wir treiben die Internationalisierung voran, erweitern unser Produktangebot um eine KI\-native Plattform und entwickeln unsere Organisation stetig weiter. Heute vereinen wir sechs Unternehmen aus Deutschland, Großbritannien und Italien in einer Gruppe – und gestalten gemeinsam die Zukunft digitaler Gesundheitslösungen in Europa.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist – Optimization Algorithms & Software Development (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
ZEISS Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology


Enabler for smaller, more powerful, and more energy\-efficient microchips


Working for tomorrow today.


Around 80 percent of all microchips worldwide are produced using ZEISS technologies. As the centerpiece of every electronically controlled system, they have become an integral part of our everyday lives – whether in smartphones, smart homes or smart factories. ZEISS is a technology leader in the field of semiconductor manufacturing equipment. With high\-precision lithography optics, photomask systems and process control solutions, ZEISS enables the production of ever smaller, increasingly powerful, and more energy\-efficient microchips, and thus plays a pivotal role in the age of micro\- and nanoelectronics.


As a developer for the system optimization of EUV lithography systems, you will help advance some of the world’s most sophisticated optical systems for semiconductor manufacturing. You will develop physical and mathematical models, optimization algorithms, and robust software solutions used in both system development and production. Working closely with experts from optical design, metrology, process development, production, system engineering, and software development, you will turn complex technical challenges into scalable and sustainable solutions. Depending on the task, you will coordinate technical activities or small expert teams and take responsibility for the quality, schedule, and results of your work.


**Your Role**
=============

* Design, refine, and implement physical and mathematical models as well as numerical algorithms for the adjustment and optimization of complex optical systems.
* Analyze system and production behavior, identify optimization potential, and validate solutions through simulations and experiments under realistic conditions.
* Translate mathematical and physical concepts into robust, maintainable, and testable software used in development and production, primarily in MATLAB and complementary software environments.
* Shape and drive the evolution of our software architecture, including modularization, interfaces, data flows, reusable components, and automated testing—while ensuring the continued operation of existing functionality.
* Establish and promote modern software development practices across projects through code and design reviews, regression testing, version control, knowledge sharing, pairing, and technical mentoring.
* Coordinate activities across optical design, metrology, production, system engineering, and customer interfaces; where appropriate, lead small expert teams and support the introduction of new processes and future technologies.

**Your Profile**
================

* A degree in mathematics, physics, computer science, engineering, natural sciences, or a related field; a PhD is an advantage.
* Strong expertise in mathematical optimization, numerical methods, physical modeling, or related algorithmic disciplines, with experience applying them to complex technical systems.
* Extensive experience in software and algorithm development, ideally for scientific, technical, or production\-related applications.
* Strong proficiency in MATLAB; experience with Python, C\#, C\+\+, or comparable languages is an advantage.
* Sound knowledge of software architecture and design, including modularization, interfaces, maintainability, testability, reusable components, and the incremental modernization of existing software systems.
* A proven ability to connect physical domain knowledge, mathematical algorithms, and professional software engineering, combined with fluent English at C1 level and a pragmatic, structured, and collaborative working style.

Your ZEISS Recruiting Team:


Sandra Köhler

jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer, AWS Billing
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The Agreements team within AWS Billing is looking for a Software Development Engineer to join our team in Berlin.  

  

Are you interested in building the next generation, cloud\-based commerce system for AWS that’s used by millions of customers worldwide? Are you excited by the idea of building real\-time stream processing systems that operate at millions of records scale? Do you want to make an impact at a several\-billion\-a\-year business? Then we need to talk!  

  

Computing AWS bills, at its core, is a challenging, distributed systems problem that requires calculations performed over trillions of usage records, millions of accounts, and hundreds of thousands of different rates. Furthermore, our applications must meet strict requirements for accuracy and once\-and\-only\-once processing.
  

  

As a Software Development Engineer, you will own problems end\-to\-end — whether that's the agentic automation powering zero\-touch launches, the core data stores for agreements, or the systems that publish agreement and pricing information to AWS downstream clients. You will build on AWS technologies like DynamoDB, Lambda, Step Functions, and CDK, and collaborate directly with AWS service teams to deliver platforms that let them bring new products to market in minutes, not weeks.  

  

The Agreements team within AWS Billing is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) team which provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3\) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2\), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

jobs.title: Digital Product Engineer
jobs.description:
### **About the company**


First Line Software works with some of the world's top businesses and organizations in industries like healthcare, data engineering, warehouse automation, retail digitalization, mobile app development, and e\-commerce. Our projects are as varied as our people, and our people are as talented as they come. We prefer working as a transparent and supportive team, who shares our knowledge as well as our success.
  

  

Let's see what we can create together!

### **The project and your role**


Our client is rebuilding its guest\-facing digital estate on a modern microservices architecture moving away from a fragmented collection of out\-of\-the\-box portals toward a purpose\-built digital platform that delivers personalised, seamless guest experiences across discovery, booking, pre\-stay, and in\-stay touchpoints. As a Digital Product Engineer, you'll build the digital products guests and staff use every day, working on a React/Next.js front\-end and a back\-end of independently deployable .NET 8 / ASP.NET Core microservices hosted on AWS.

* Build and maintain guest\-facing features in React and Next.js — search, the booking funnel, conversion optimisation, and promotional campaign delivery, in partnership with commercial and marketing teams
* Deliver logged\-in guest journeys on the guest portal, including pre\-stay upsell, activity booking, and in\-stay engagement
* Contribute to loyalty platform features — enrolment flows, member personalisation, and loyalty mechanics
* Design and build .NET 8 / ASP.NET Core microservices — REST APIs, domain logic, and integrations with core booking, CMS, and contact\-center systems
* Deploy and operate microservices on AWS using Lambda and ECS/Fargate, choosing the right hosting model per service
* Implement event\-driven communication between services using AWS SQS, SNS, and EventBridge
* Design RESTful APIs to agreed standards, including OpenAPI specifications, versioning, and documentation
* Write unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests, and ship through CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
* Participate in code reviews with nearshore engineering partners and take ownership of your services in production, including incident response

### **Your skills**

* 2\+ years of software engineering experience spanning front\-end and back\-end development
* Hands\-on, production experience with React and Next.js — App Router, server components, SSR/SSG
* Hands\-on, production experience with .NET (Core/.NET 5\+) and C\#; .NET 8 / ASP.NET Core strongly preferred
* TypeScript across the stack
* Demonstrable experience building and deploying microservices on AWS (Lambda and/or ECS/Fargate)
* Experience with RESTful API design in a microservices architecture
* Experience working in agile sprint teams, ideally alongside nearshore or offshore engineering partners
* Consumer\-facing product experience — eCommerce, hospitality, travel, or retail preferred
* English language proficiency for technical documentation and team communication

**Nice to have:**

* Experience integrating LLMs or conversational AI (OpenAI API or equivalent)
* WhatsApp Business API or Amazon Connect experience
* Familiarity with hospitality CRS/PMS systems

### **What we can offer**

* Our modern stack projects are the right mix of exciting and challenging
* Gain access to our diverse range of training programs, courses, and certifications
* Choose your work style — this role is hybrid, with 3 days a week in the office
* Enhance your language skills with our corporate English classes
* Work from anywhere and explore the world with our Workation program

jobs.title: Application Support Engineer
jobs.description:
Application Support Engineer


Help keep public transport moving.


We’re looking for a hands\-on Application Support Engineer to support and improve the systems behind real\-time passenger information, fleet monitoring and service operations. You’ll investigate issues that matter to customers and operators, take ownership through to resolution, and work closely with engineering teams to make our products more reliable.


Our platforms are used around the world to deliver accurate arrival information, manage vehicle fleets and communicate disruption updates to passengers. Built around Vix Horizon, BusNet and the new Beacon cloud platforms, our systems are increasingly cloud\-native on AWS.


What you’ll do* Provide second\- and third\-line support for internal and external customers.
* Investigate, diagnose and resolve application, data and connectivity incidents, using ITIL\-aligned processes.
* Own incidents from initial triage through to resolution, communicating clearly on progress, risk and impact.
* Escalate effectively to engineering, partners or other teams when needed.
* Use the command line to investigate remote devices, services and integrations.
* Support and improve applications, data feeds, cloud platforms and operational tooling.
* Build useful knowledge articles and share insight across the support team.
* Work with development and cross\-functional teams to improve performance, reliability and deployment.
* Contribute ideas that make the service—and the customer experience—better.


What you’ll bring* Proven experience in application support, technical operations or a similar hands\-on environment.
* Experience working with SIRI SM, VM or SX data feeds, or comparable real\-time data integrations.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across Windows, Windows Server and embedded Linux/Unix environments.
* Practical experience investigating remote or embedded devices, including GPRS/3G/4G connectivity and single\-board computers.
* Familiarity with AWS and cloud platforms, including Beacon, and an interest in developing deeper cloud expertise.
* Confidence with SQL and databases, plus an understanding of HTML, CSS and XML.
* Working knowledge of C\# or Python.
* A practical understanding of ITIL, incident management and service improvement.
* Clear communication skills: you can explain technical issues to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


The person we’re looking for
You’re curious, calm under pressure and motivated by finding the root cause. You take ownership, work well independently and know when to bring in the right people. You’re adaptable, collaborative and focused on delivering a great customer outcome—not simply closing a ticket.


This role is predominantly home\-based, with occasional travel to our offices in Manchester and Cambridge. There will also be an on\-call rota, including some out\-of\-hours and occasional weekend cover.

**What’s in it for you?**


Alongside the opportunity to work for a global, customer\- and people\-focused company, we offer:

* A great team of like\-minded professionals.
* Private healthcare.
* Income protection scheme.
* Pension.
* Group life assurance.
* Cycle to Work scheme.
* Electric Vehicle Benefit scheme.
* Employee Assistance Programme.
* Eyecare vouchers.


Sounds good? Apply now and get on board.


Please include anything else that demonstrates why you would be a great addition to the team. This role is open to UK citizens or residents with an indefinite right to remain and current full\-time right to work in the UK.


No recruitment agencies, please—we will not accept any introductions.


Vix Technology is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind and are committed to equal employment opportunity for all. We aim to build a workforce as diverse as the communities we serve, creating an inclusive environment where everyone can realise their full potential.

jobs.description:
Civil Engineering
UKIMEA Region

GLA00007P Requisition \#  

Graduate Civil Engineer


See it differently \- Early Careers at Arup


See it differently


You see the world through a unique lens and that’s exactly what we need. We embrace how you see things differently – it’s essential for creating a sustainable future.


Arup is a global consultancy with advisory and technical expertise across more than 150 disciplines. We guide, plan and design the future of the built environment. Globally, each year we recruit hundreds of graduates and students who help us see things differently and solve the most complex challenges facing our clients, climate and communities.


The Opportunity


Our Civil Engineering team works at the heart of the energy transition, helping to deliver the infrastructure needed to connect renewable energy and improve the resilience of electricity networks. We support major projects across offshore wind, transmission and distribution, energy storage, HVDC infrastructure and pumped storage hydro. As a graduate engineer, you will work alongside experienced specialists and gain hands\-on experience in the planning, design and delivery of civil infrastructure, including site development, earthworks, drainage, highways and access arrangements. You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, use industry\-leading digital tools and contribute to projects that have a lasting impact on the UK's net\-zero ambitions.


Contribute to the planning, design and delivery of major energy infrastructure projects, including offshore wind, transmission networks, substations, HVDC schemes and energy storage developments.


Support the development of civil engineering designs for earthworks, drainage, highways, access roads, foundations and site infrastructure using industry\-leading digital tools.


Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams of engineers, environmental specialists, planners and project managers to develop integrated engineering solutions.


Undertake technical assessments, engineering calculations, site investigations and preparation of reports, drawings and project deliverables.


Develop professional and technical skills through structured training, mentoring and hands\-on project experience while supporting the delivery of sustainable infrastructure that enables the energy transition.


https://www.arup.com/services/civil\-engineering/


https://www.arup.com/markets/energy/energy\-storage/


https://www.arup.com/markets/energy/transmission\-distribution/


Is this role right for you?


For this opportunity, we are seeking the following qualifications, skills and attributes: Masters level in relevant academic discipline, such as Civil Engineering, Construction Management; Ground / Geotechnical Engineering; Structural Engineering.


Skills and experience in Civil Engineering Design Principles; Engineering Drawing Interpretation; AutoCAD; Geotechnical Engineering Fundamentals; Drainage and Surface Water Design; Earthworks and Highway Design; Structural Engineering Fundamentals; Technical Report Writing; Data Analysis and Visualisation; Problem Solving and Engineering Calculations. Civil 3D; GIS (ArcGIS/QGIS); Microsoft Excel; BIM Awareness (ISO 19650\); Revit (basic understanding);


To be considered for a graduate opportunity, your application must include a copy of your academic transcript and meet the following criteria:


* Full working rights in the country of application
* No more than 12 months of full\-time experience in a comparable role
* Recently graduated, or on track to graduate, from your most recent degree, related to your role of choice, before employment starts.

Alongside your degree, we look for the following core attributes:


* Changemakers: A passion for sustainable development and creating a better world is key.
* Innovative minds: We’re looking for critical thinkers who embrace new ideas and challenge the status quo.
* Growth seekers: You have a growth mindset, always eager to learn and explore new ways of working.
* Adaptable adventurers: You’re ready to take on any challenge that comes your way.

Please note, in the event of high applicant volume, this role may be closed ahead of the advertised closing date. Early application is recommended.
  

  

Eligibility
  

Please note that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Therefore, you must ensure that you are eligible to work permanently in the UK without our sponsorship.


What we offer you


At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.


Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.


We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling permanent members to share in the results of our collective efforts.


We take an approach to flexible working that supports the diversity and wellbeing of our graduates.


We also provide for our permanent members Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.


Next Steps


We've designed our application process to be straightforward and supportive, giving you the opportunity to showcase your skills and potential. Applications are reviewed as they're received, so we encourage you to apply as early as possible.


The process includes an online application, psychometric testing, application review, case study, interview and offer stage. Our friendly Early Careers team is available throughout the process to answer questions and help you feel confident every step of the way.


Different people, shared values


Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas \- this drives our excellence.


Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross\-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ\+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your\-life\-at\-arup. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas.
  

  

We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please contact UKEarlyCareersRecruitment@arup.com to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.
  

  

As a Disability Confident Level 2 Employer in the UK, we will strive for one third of all our interview places to be allocated to candidates who have disclosed they are disability confident and best meet the requirements of the role.

jobs.title: Cable Project Engineering Opportunities (EHV)
jobs.description:
**Base Location:** For this role, we require successful applicants to be based from one of our Scottish locations \- Glasgow, Perth, Aberdeen or Inverness.


**Salary:** Based on experience \+ car / car allowance \+ performance\-related bonus \+ a range of other benefits to support your family, finances and wellbeing.


**Working Pattern:** Permanent \| Full Time \| Flexible First options available


**The role**



As part of SSEN Transmission Pathway to 2030 programme of works, we have EHV Cable Engineering opportunities at Professional, and Senior level, to join our HVDC Project Engineering team to help drive forward our projects and successfully deliver a network for Net Zero. Our projects include state\-of the\-art AC and DC cable system technology, and traverse marine and terrestrial environments across the UK.



Our Cable Project Engineering roles are key in driving technical excellence, quality of installation, best practice, and resolution to design risks/technical issues. These roles reside within SSEN Transmission’s Offshore Project Engineering Team and primarily focus on HVDC cable projects. Experience with Transmission networks is advantageous, although not essential. We encourage candidates with a project engineering background, ideally with HV/EHV cable engineering background in contractor, consultancy or client organisations to apply.


**You will**


* Support project Front End Engineering Design (FEED) activities such as options assessment, cable route development, landfall selection and risk assessment. This includes interdisciplinary working alongside various teams including environmental and land consenting, geotechnical, civil and offshore installation engineers.


* Promote the safety\-in\-design ethos and discharge these CDM duties on behalf of SSE Transmission As a key member of Designer and Principal Designer teams. This includes risk reduction (technical, quality, health, and safety) to the point of elimination or as low as is reasonably practicable.


* Review and acceptance of Contractor engineering and design deliverables for compliance with Employer's requirements, legislation and safe practice.


* Supervise installation and commissioning works for compliance with Employer's requirements and legislation.


* Support and mentoring of junior engineers, ensuring they are adequately supported throughout traineeship.


**Our** **Senior roles include the following additional responsibilities:**


* Inform the HVDC cable system requirements for Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) Contracts and supporting the tender review process as part of the technical team.


* Coordinate and support the installation and commissioning works for compliance with the Employer’s requirements, legislation – promoting health \& safety.


* Technical leadership, mentorship, and driving excellence within the HVDC Project Engineering team.


* Lead special analytical studies, solves complex and ambiguous problems.


**You have**


* A qualification of minimum BEng/BSc qualification level in a relevant engineering discipline.


* Technical knowledge and experience in holding key technical position(s) during development and delivery of a HVDC or HVAC transmission cable projects.


* Work experience and understanding of EPC contracts and CDM regulations; particularly with respect to roles of Supervisor and Principal Designer.


* Competent awareness and working knowledge of relevant industry standards, specifications and recommendations.


* Excellent communication, time\-management, and organisational skills.


* Experience and enthusiasm for giving mentorship/guidance to junior engineers and building technical excellence within the team and wider business.


**About SSE**



SSE’s purpose is to be restless every day until we make electricity clean, affordable and available for all.



We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. This includes electricity transmission and distribution networks, onshore and offshore wind farms, hydro\-electric power and flexible thermal generation. We also provide products and services for businesses and other customers.



Our investment plan will see SSE invest £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure to 2030\.



SSEN Transmission own and operate the electricity transmission network across the north of Scotland. We transport electricity from where it is generated to where it is needed, ensuring a safe and reliable electricity supply for the communities we serve. But that's not all – we're upgrading the grid to deliver cleaner, homegrown power for the future and building the infrastructure needed for a cleaner electricity system to create secure power for generations to come.


**Flexible benefits to fit your life**



Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest\-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.


**Work with an equal opportunity employer**



SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. please contact Hannah at hannah.e.cutajar@sse.com to discuss how we can support you.



We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry.


**Ready to apply?**



Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. We'll be in touch after the closing date to let you know if we'll be taking your application further. If you're offered a role with SSE, you'll need to complete a criminality check and a credit check before you start work.

**Salary:** Based on experience \+ car / car allowance \+ performance\-related bonus \+ a range of other benefits to support your family, finances and wellbeing.


**Working Pattern:** Permanent \| Full Time \| Flexible First options available


**The role**



As part of SSEN Transmission Pathway to 2030 programme of works, we have EHV Cable Engineering opportunities at Professional, and Senior level, to join our HVDC Project Engineering team to help drive forward our projects and successfully deliver a network for Net Zero. Our projects include state\-of the\-art AC and DC cable system technology, and traverse marine and terrestrial environments across the UK.



Our Cable Project Engineering roles are key in driving technical excellence, quality of installation, best practice, and resolution to design risks/technical issues. These roles reside within SSEN Transmission’s Offshore Project Engineering Team and primarily focus on HVDC cable projects. Experience with Transmission networks is advantageous, although not essential. We encourage candidates with a project engineering background, ideally with HV/EHV cable engineering background in contractor, consultancy or client organisations to apply.


**You will**


* Support project Front End Engineering Design (FEED) activities such as options assessment, cable route development, landfall selection and risk assessment. This includes interdisciplinary working alongside various teams including environmental and land consenting, geotechnical, civil and offshore installation engineers.


* Promote the safety\-in\-design ethos and discharge these CDM duties on behalf of SSE Transmission As a key member of Designer and Principal Designer teams. This includes risk reduction (technical, quality, health, and safety) to the point of elimination or as low as is reasonably practicable.


* Review and acceptance of Contractor engineering and design deliverables for compliance with Employer's requirements, legislation and safe practice.


* Supervise installation and commissioning works for compliance with Employer's requirements and legislation.


* Support and mentoring of junior engineers, ensuring they are adequately supported throughout traineeship.


**Our** **Senior roles include the following additional responsibilities:**


* Inform the HVDC cable system requirements for Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) Contracts and supporting the tender review process as part of the technical team.


* Coordinate and support the installation and commissioning works for compliance with the Employer’s requirements, legislation – promoting health \& safety.


* Technical leadership, mentorship, and driving excellence within the HVDC Project Engineering team.


* Lead special analytical studies, solves complex and ambiguous problems.


**You have**


* A qualification of minimum BEng/BSc qualification level in a relevant engineering discipline.


* Technical knowledge and experience in holding key technical position(s) during development and delivery of a HVDC or HVAC transmission cable projects.


* Work experience and understanding of EPC contracts and CDM regulations; particularly with respect to roles of Supervisor and Principal Designer.


* Competent awareness and working knowledge of relevant industry standards, specifications and recommendations.


* Excellent communication, time\-management, and organisational skills.


* Experience and enthusiasm for giving mentorship/guidance to junior engineers and building technical excellence within the team and wider business.


**About SSE**



SSE’s purpose is to be restless every day until we make electricity clean, affordable and available for all.



We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. This includes electricity transmission and distribution networks, onshore and offshore wind farms, hydro\-electric power and flexible thermal generation. We also provide products and services for businesses and other customers.



Our investment plan will see SSE invest £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure to 2030\.



SSEN Transmission own and operate the electricity transmission network across the north of Scotland. We transport electricity from where it is generated to where it is needed, ensuring a safe and reliable electricity supply for the communities we serve. But that's not all – we're upgrading the grid to deliver cleaner, homegrown power for the future and building the infrastructure needed for a cleaner electricity system to create secure power for generations to come.


**Flexible benefits to fit your life**



Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest\-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.


**Work with an equal opportunity employer**



SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. please contact Hannah at hannah.e.cutajar@sse.com to discuss how we can support you.



We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry.


**Ready to apply?**



Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. We'll be in touch after the closing date to let you know if we'll be taking your application further. If you're offered a role with SSE, you'll need to complete a criminality check and a credit check before you start work.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Senior Software Engineer**

**Reports to: Director of Engineering**


**Works With: Engineering Leadership, Product Managers, Designers, Software Engineers**

**Hours: 37\.5 pw (9\.30\-6pm Monday to Friday, 1 hour lunch)**


**Term: Permanent**


**Location: Hybrid \- London office based in Oval (2 days / week)**


**About us**



Artlogic is a leading technology platform for the art world. Founded in 1989, Artlogic empowers over 6,000 galleries, dealers, and art professionals worldwide to streamline their operations and grow their businesses. The company's integrated platform combines inventory management, CRM, websites, sales, marketing, and payment tools, everything needed to run a modern and successful art business.



In 2021, Artlogic was acquired by tech investors Cove Hill Partners to accelerate innovation and expand its global reach. Since then, the company has doubled in size, with employees across London, New York, Atlanta, and Cape Town.



Today, Artlogic is entering an exciting new chapter through its merger with ArtCloud, another industry leader in art technology. Together, the two companies are uniting complementary platforms to build the most comprehensive, forward\-thinking solution for the art world. This collaboration brings together deep expertise across CRM, sales, marketing, inventory, payments, and AI\-powered tools, empowering galleries, artists, and collectors worldwide.



Joining Artlogic means becoming part of a growing global team that is shaping the future of how art is bought, sold, and managed, both online and in person.



Our technology team comprises over 50 people across Product, UX and Engineering working in cross\-functional teams geographically distributed principally between the UK and Brazil with a technical operations team in the UK and South Africa. At present, our technology stack comprises a combination of Python, Typescript, C\# in Azure, GCP and AWS cloud environments.


**About the role**



We are seeking a pragmatic, impact\-driven AI\-Native Senior Software Engineerto help evolve and extend our platform while guiding technical direction and supporting team development.



This role centres on solving real\-world problems for art professionals, making thoughtful technical decisions that balance business impact with engineering trade\-offs. You will work closely with Product Managers, Designers, and engineers to take ideas from inception through to production, ensuring we build the right solutions for our customers.



You will act as both a senior technical contributor and a product\-minded engineer, someone who doesn't just implement requirements but actively shapes them. You will challenge assumptions, ask the right questions, and help ensure we are solving meaningful problems in the most effective way.



You will contribute to technical strategy by identifying opportunities to improve system reliability, performance, and user experience within our current architecture, while also supporting the evolution of our strategic platform.  

  

This role will play a key part in driving the adoption of AI across engineering, leveraging emerging technologies and embedding AI\-native workflows to improve how we design, build, and deliver software.



This role is predominantly hands\-on, with around 20–30% of time on technical leadership: architecture, mentoring, and shaping how the team works.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Help the team move faster by adopting AI\-native workflows and the shift to an agentic development lifecycle, without compromising the architectural qualities that make our platform reliable, scalable, and maintainable over the long term.
* Define guardrails, review practices, and validation gates that hold AI\-generated code to our standards for security, reliability, and cost\-efficiency (FinOps). These are first\-class concerns in agentic pipelines, not afterthoughts.
* Design, build, and operate software across our platform, applying the same rigour to AI\-augmented work as to anything else you ship.
* Embed deeply with Product and Design from the earliest stages of discovery, using rapid prototyping and iteration to compress the gap between idea and validated solution.
* Act as feature lead on a rotating basis, taking accountability for the development and delivery of a feature from shaping through to production. This means partnering with Product and Design on the approach, breaking the work down, coordinating the engineers contributing to it, removing blockers, and being the person who knows the state of the feature at any point
* Serve as a critical technical voice, stress\-testing AI\-generated solutions, surfacing second\-order risks, and ensuring the team builds the right thing, not just the fast thing.
* Shape platform architecture with an architectural lens, contributing to long\-term decisions about how AI tooling, LLM integrations, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls evolve across the stack.
* Continuously identify and exploit opportunities to improve performance, reliability, and user experience, using observability and analysis to find signals in noisy systems.
* Navigate confidently across legacy and greenfield contexts, applying AI tooling pragmatically to modernise where it matters most.
* Set the engineering standard, demonstrating through your own work what excellent looks like when much of the code is AI\-generated.
* Grow the team's capability and confidence with AI\-native practices, coaching more junior engineers to think critically about model outputs, prompt design, and the boundaries of automation.
* Define and evolve best practices for code quality, testing, documentation, and delivery in a world where much of the first draft is AI\-generated.
* Evolve CI/CD pipelines to incorporate agentic workflows, automated testing, AI\-assisted code review, and intelligent deployment gates.
* Champion secure by design principles across both human\-written and AI\-generated code, embedding security validation into the development pipeline rather than treating it as an afterthought.
* Own system observability and reliability, moving from reactive alerting to proactive, model\-assisted incident prevention.
* Participate in on\-call rotation, bringing the same rigour to incident response that you bring to day\-to\-day development.

  


**About you**
-------------



You're a hands\-on senior engineer with a product mindset and the judgement to know which trade\-offs matter. You care about business impact as much as engineering quality, and you've been building with AI tools long enough to know how to use them effectively.


**You'll likely bring:**


* Deep experience building scalable, secure, cloud\-based systems, giving you the foundation to confidently guide and validate agentic workflow outputs.
* Proven ability to work across both legacy and greenfield codebases, using modern tooling to improve reliability and evolve architecture pragmatically.
* Strong system design fundamentals across scalability, performance, and distributed systems, including API design (REST, GraphQL).
* Hands\-on experience with observability tooling (Datadog, Grafana, or similar) and a data\-informed approach to system health and reliability.
* Solid SQL and data management skills, with an appreciation for AI\-enabled, data\-driven systems.
* Familiarity with CI/CD, containerisation (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Docker), and DevSecOps practices in modern AI development environments.
* A pragmatic approach to testing, knowing what to cover, what to skip, and how to use AI to improve efficiency.
* Experience mentoring engineers and supporting the adoption of modern tools and AI\-native workflows.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to articulate technical decisions and trade\-offs clearly.


**You'll stand out if you:**


* Ask "what problem are we solving and why?" before reaching for a solution.
* Act as a genuine partner to Product and Design, shaping the problem, not just delivering against a spec.
* Balance technical debt and feature delivery with long\-term business value in mind.
* Make confident decisions with incomplete information and thrive in fast\-moving, evolving environments.
* Bring curiosity and hands\-on experience with agentic workflows, using them to raise the bar for engineering..

  


**What we offer**


* Company profit sharing scheme
* 25 days annual leave (plus 10 public holiday days)
* Long service entitlement
* Flexible working
* Premier private health insurance including dental, optical \& EAP
* Childcare nursery benefit scheme
* Cycle to work scheme
* Tech buying scheme
* Free eye test
* Company pension scheme
* A focus on continued professional development including access to courses and training programs


**Artlogic is an equal opportunities employer**



Artlogic is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to fair and inclusive recruitment and employment practices. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.



We are committed to making reasonable adjustments for disabled applicants and employees. If you have a disability and would like us to make adjustments to the application or interview process, or to discuss any adjustments to the role, please let us know.



Please note that this position is UK\-based and involves hybrid working with attendance at our London office for a minimum of 2 days each week, to support effective collaboration and engagement. Candidates must therefore have, or be able to obtain, appropriate immigration status entitling them to work in the UK for us in the role. Please note that we \[do not have a sponsor licence] and we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this position. The successful candidate will need to provide evidence/information to enable us to verify their right to work, prior to commencement of employment, and in accordance with current Home Office right to work guidance.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
UTEC, Acteon’s Geo\-services business line, harnesses data to optimize designs, save time, and maximize your project’s economic value by providing a holistic understanding of the marine environment. Our insights underpin customers’ decision\-making from design to asset life extension, ensuring every decision delivers.

  

We are sourcing a Senior Software Engineer on a full time, permanent basis. Based at our facility in Wokingham, the Senior Software Engineer is to develop and maintain application software for UTEC leading line of products in line with the Software Manager. To ensure that the delivery team is supported during project delivery. These applications provide support for our in\-house developed Renewable and Oil\-Gas structural monitoring systems and services globally.

  

UTEC develops wide range of .net applications of which may be standalone or web based. These applications are used to implement a software stack to ultimately transmit time\-series data from acquisition devices over a range of network protocols securely to the internet or to direct to customer networks and servers. We also develop applications for data processing and analysis of data. User interfaces and data visualisations are also often required and developed.

  

The role requires a competent .net developer who has proven competence C\# application development in .net environment using WPF framework. Equally we require same developer to have skills in asp.net core Web\-page front and back\-end development using Razor, Blazor or related UI frameworks. Our applications are deployed on range of operating systems and often as containers running in cloud, hence some knowledge or familiarisation of Docker is required. We require at least basic network knowledge of TCP/IP networking concepts and client server interfacing. Further, supporting the network nature of our product line, knowledge of implementing REST API client and server interfaces for our clients is a must have.

  

Our client’s requirement often differs so we provide data interfaces presented via a range of protocols for example MQTT, OPC\-UA and Modbus. Knowledge of one of more of these would be an advantage but not essential.

  

Duties \& Main Responsibilities

* To form a core part of the Technology Agile Development Team, ensuring software development and bug fixing during each sprint.
* Working with the Senior Software Manager, Commercial IT engineers and Data scientists implementing the solution.
* To assist and support the Senior Software Manager to plan and deliver software scopes on time.
* To identify key bottle necks and escalate to Senior Software Manager, including providing support and solutions to remediate identified bottle necks/issues.
* To take ownership of resolving software deficiencies and supporting the delivery team in achieving their goals.
* Working closely with the Software test and System engineering teams to debug software and be accountable for their problem resolution
* Taking ownership with Software department to build and maintain the software platform.
* To mentor and support other developers as needed.
* To maintain and help develop s/w implementation and delivery process
* Utilising Azure Dev Ops and executing Epics, Users stories, bugs, and work items as part of sprint or backlog.
* To document the Software implementation and maintain change logs, keeping Azure work items status up to date
* Working with the Software/Firmware and Commercial IT teams to develop test strategies and platforms. Including Automated Software unit testing.

  

**Requirements**  

* Able to think long term implications of changes to software
* Able to work within a framework and utilize the Agile development process
* Able to write software in C\# for ,net and asp .net core.
* Ability to support the software design team providing guidance in respect to software testing and reliability.
* Ability to develop testing approaches for software.
* Skills in web development technologies such as ASP.NET is essential with Visual Studio.
* Understanding of deployment and containerisation technologies such as Docker.
* Data interface and protocol knowledge e.g. MQTT, Modbus, REST API, OPC\-UA Experience.
* Experienced in developing software for Windows systems (3\-5\+ years min) specifically in the Visual Studio Environment.
* Agile Development and Testing
* In\-depth knowledge of Bug tracking using tools such as Azure DevOps or GIT.
* Understand modular design patterns.
* Have worked with Docker Containers and .NET core ecosystems.
* Excellent communications skills both written and verbal.
* Ability to work as part of a team
* Eager to develop new skills and learn new technologies as the business requires it.
* Attention to detail
* Passion for solving problems
* Practical approach in thinking

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
**Description**
---------------



Would you like to help drive the growth and technical software delivery expertise of a global company that works with 91% of the Fortune Global 500? Are you an experienced engineer who is fluent with the latest AI and agentic tooling, thrives on AI agent\-led delivery, and can think on your feet to propose innovative solutions to challenging problems? If so, we have an exciting opportunity to join our Willis Neuron Technology team in the UK.



This is an exceptional opportunity to play a key role in developing the change capabilities of a global financial services organisation, where our delivery model is pivoting towards AI agent\-led development, and the focus is on practical delivery and reacting to the highest value business needs.



You will hit the ground running: building AI\-enabled products with large language models and modern agent frameworks and directing AI coding assistants to deliver at pace. You will turn concepts from our architects and product managers into working software quickly, challenge technical design and delivery choices, and bring the analytical rigour needed to take AI solutions safely into production.


**The Role**

  


* Design, build and productionise AI\-enabled features and services using large language models, RAG, prompt engineering and agent frameworks / orchestration (such as LangChain, LangGraph or Semantic Kernel).
* Take AI solutions beyond prototype, owning evaluation, testing, guardrails, observability, security and cost management.
* Rapidly prototype and validate ideas, turning concepts into working software within days and proving out how to build the solution properly at scale.
* Deliver hands\-on development of class leading web\-based applications and services, integrating AI capabilities with our existing platform (C\# / .NET, React and/or Angular, Python) and our Azure cloud and DevOps tooling.
* Direct AI coding assistants and agentic workflows (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) alongside your own hands\-on expertise, and rigorously review both human\-written and AI\-generated code against our architectural, development and security standards.
* Own delivery of a small suite of business\-related projects, ensuring architectural and solution alignment with the wider technical vision.
* Drive adoption of AI agent\-led delivery across the team, coaching others in effective and responsible use of AI tooling so the capability spreads.
* Challenge established development processes and procedures, particularly how AI agents are integrated into the SDLC, and work closely with the Engineering Leads on tooling adoption and delivery outcomes.
* Track AI and agentic technology trends outside the organisation and apply them pragmatically to our products, whilst developing deep domain knowledge.
**Qualifications**
------------------



**What you’ll bring**

  


**Essential Experience**

  


* Practical experience building with AI and agentic technologies: large language models, RAG, prompt engineering, and agent frameworks / orchestration (such as LangChain, LangGraph or Semantic Kernel).
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants and agentic development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) in a professional delivery setting, and the ability to critically review, validate and secure the code they produce.
* Strong hands\-on software engineering experience (minimum 10 years commercial), with React and/or Angular, TypeScript, C\# / .NET and Python.
* Hands\-on commercial experience in Azure cloud, using GitHub and Azure DevOps, across all phases of the SDLC and Agile delivery.
* Proven ability to rapidly prototype and validate ideas, moving a concept from whiteboard to working demo in days.
* Demonstrable experience leading, influencing and mentoring through hands\-on contributions.
* Experience of working in a financial services organisation, preferably with exposure to the insurance industry / insurance broking. Where this directly relevant experience is not available, we will be looking for an ability to rapidly become effective in a new, unfamiliar environment.
* First\-rate communication skills, applied to rapid and creative problem solving with technical and business stakeholders in an occasionally pressurised environment.
* Comfortable working on your own initiative or as part of a broader project team, remotely or face to face, and confident challenging established approaches.

**Desirable Experience:**


* Experience running AI / LLM solutions in production at scale, including evaluation frameworks, guardrails and cost management.
* Experience designing or orchestrating multi\-agent workflows, and familiarity with agent protocols (e.g. MCP) for integrating AI agents with engineering pipelines and enterprise data.
* Experience with microservice based architectures and containerisation.
* Experience building and working with mathematical algorithms, or with geospatial, catastrophe or financial\-modelling data.
* Experience understanding and translating complex business processes across multiple stakeholder groups.
* BSc degree qualified in a quantitative discipline (Mathematics, Science or Computer Science).

  



The role offers hybrid working with travel to office expected on a regular cadence for meetings and workshops. Some occasional travel may be required as part of the engagement with business and technology stakeholders.


**What we offer**



Enjoy a benefits package designed to help you thrive, both professionally and personally. You'll receive 25 days of annual leave plus an extra WTW day to relax and recharge. Our comprehensive health and wellbeing offering includes private healthcare, life insurance, group income protection, and regular health assessments, all giving you peace of mind. Secure your future with our defined contribution pension scheme, featuring matched contributions up to 10% from the company.

  



We support your growth and balance with hybrid working options, access to an employee assistance programme, and a fully paid volunteer day to make a difference in your community. On top of these, you can opt into a variety of additional perks including an electric vehicle car scheme, share scheme, cycle\-to\-work programme, dental and optical cover, critical illness protection, and much more. Start making the most of your career and wellbeing with a range of benefits tailored for you.

  


**Equal Opportunity Employer**



We’re committed to equal employment opportunity and provide application, interview and workplace adjustments and accommodations to all applicants. If you foresee any barriers, from the application process through to joining WTW, please email candidatehelpdesk@wtwco.com

jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

The SPTS division of KLA, designs, manufactures and markets wafer processing solutions for the global semiconductor and related industries. SPTS provides industry leading etch and deposition process technologies on a range of single wafer handling platforms. End\-market applications include micro\-electromechanical systems (MEMS), advanced packaging, LED, high speed RF device IC’s and power semiconductors. SPTS is part of KLA Corporation which develops industry\-leading equipment and services that enable innovation throughout the electronics industry. We provide advanced process control and process\-enabling solutions for manufacturing wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. In close collaboration with leading customers across the globe, our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers design solutions that move the world forward.
**Job** **Description/Preferred** **Qualifications**

KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA's metrology and inspection products, is looking a **Mechanical Design Engineer** to join the team based in **Newport, UK.**

**Purpose of the role**

We are looking for a **Mechanical Design Engineer** who is hands on, highly motivated, and a team player. The candidate will be engaged during the entire product lifecycle, from prototype to productization, and play a decisive role in the mechanical design and qualification of future KLA products.


The engineer will support the design, building, and qualification of a wide range of KLA equipment front end modules (EFEMs) and integrated components. The candidate will be expected to provide technical solutions for new requirements and sustaining existing product portfolio and create prototypes for design verification though to production release.


**Your day to day responsibilities will include:**

* Responsible for the complete mechanical design process, including requirements specification, feasibility studies, cost management, and scheduling.
* Collaboration with cross\-functional teams to determine design requirements, implement best design practices, and achieve functional product design solution.
* Design mechanical components in CREO Parametric 3D \- Pro/E CAD software.
* Conduct or direct CFD and FEA analyses to optimize Semiconductor Equipment airflow requirements, and mechanical design.
* Reduce 3D mechanical designs to 2D drawing and proper application of mechanical tolerancing/GD\&T to achieve desired fit and functionality of manufactured parts.
* Collaborate with suppliers to develop components and sub\-system assemblies that will expedite product development timeline.
* Work closely with suppliers to ensure parts and assemblies are built per design, and cost and schedule requirements are achieved.
* Participate in entire design/build cycle, including design, 3D CAD modelling, design review presentations, 2D drawing generation, procurement of prototype parts, system integration, and prototype testing.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Holds Degree level qualification in Engineering or related subject (or have equivalent level of experience)
* Experience in design using 3D CAD software, ideally Creo.
* Demonstrate ownership of both project level and task level work, comfortable to lead and drive mechanical design projects.
* Candidate will ideally have experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
* Strong mechanical engineering fundamentals, including design principles, materials selection, and fabrication/machining methods.
* Experience with 2D drafting and tolerance analysis.
* Experience in several of these areas is desirable: CREO Parametric 3D MCAD \- Pro/E software, CFD airflow analysis; FEA analysis; Design for manufacture (DFM); Design of welded sheet metal structures and frames; Measurement instrumentation, testing and data acquisition; Programming in Python, C/C\+\+/C\# and/or MATLAB.

*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*

*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer*

Be aware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as KLA employees. KLA never asks for any financial compensation to be considered for an interview, to become an employee, or for equipment. Further, KLA does not work with any recruiters or third parties who charge such fees either directly or on behalf of KLA . Please ensure that you have searched KLA’s Careers website for legitimate job postings. KLA follows a recruiting process that involves multiple interviews in person or on video conferencing with our hiring managers. If you are concerned that a communication, an interview, an offer of employment, or that an employee is not legitimate, please send an email to talent.acquisition@kla.com to confirm the person you are communicating with is an employee. We take your privacy very seriously and confidentially handle your information.

**Full\-time**

 **Shape the future of customer experience at Anglian Water**


Having transformed how we connect with our customers and colleagues through our Contact Centre as a Service (CCaaS) technology, we're looking for a talented **Telephony Configuration Engineer** to help continue that journey.


As a key technical specialist within our Systems Engineering Practice, you’ll design, develop and support the systems that underpin customer and colleague interactions across Anglian Water. You'll play a pivotal role in ensuring our contact centre system delivers exceptional customer experiences while enabling the business to work smarter and more efficiently.


This is a great opportunity for someone to build\-upon their existing software development skills, or experience of working on critical telephony platforms.

**What you'll be doing**


As a Telephony Configuration Engineer, you'll work within an Agile DevOps environment to develop, enhance and support our CCaaS eco\-system.


You'll be responsible for:

* Configuring and enhancing our Contact Centre as a Service technologies
* Delivering backlog items and sprint objectives alongside Product Owners and stakeholders.
* Identifying opportunities to improve customer journeys, business processes and platform performance
* Monitoring, troubleshooting and resolving system issues, acting as a key escalation point when required
* Delivering system upgrades, testing activities and release management processes
* Working closely with operational teams to understand challenges and deliver technology improvements
* Driving continuous improvement through innovation, optimisation and best practice adoption
* Building strong relationships with stakeholders across the business.

**What does it take to be successful?**


We're looking for someone who combines technical expertise with excellent stakeholder engagement skills. You'll enjoy solving problems, working collaboratively and translating complex technical concepts into practical business solutions.


You'll ideally have:

**Essential**

* Experience developing in C\# and Angular,
* Knowledge of Agile delivery methodologies and principles
* Experience of software development, including Azure DevOps utilisation
* Strong stakeholder management and relationship\-building skills
* Excellent problem\-solving and issue\-resolution capabilities
* The ability to communicate technical information clearly to non\-technical audiences
* Strong planning and prioritisation skills

At Axon, we're on a mission to Protect Life. We're explorers, pursuing society's most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. * Familiarity with building flexible and testable Infrastructure as Code modules.
* Empathy to support the needs of software engineers.

* Competitive base salary and equity
* Comprehensive pension plan with matching contribution
* Private health insurance \& cash plans
* 30 days paid holiday \+ UK public holidays
* Enhanced maternity/paternity leave
* GymPass subscription
* Life assurance \& income protection
* Career growth support and wellness resources

***Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.***

  

Don't meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long\-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.



Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you're excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.*

You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at* ***axongreenhousesupport@axon.com*** *or via our* *Axon Privacy Web Form**. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our* *Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.*

All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.*
