jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
**Principal Engineer**
======================


**Location**: Waterloo, London, England, UK \| **Hybrid** (1 day per week in office)



**Who We Are**
--------------



At 8th Light, we bring life to the best ideas.



Founded in 2006 and headquartered in Chicago, we are a technology solutions consultancy that partners with organisations from early\-stage startups to the world's largest companies. We take on hard software challenges and turn them into durable results. We build agentic products, the platforms they run on, and the engineering and design at every layer.



Our commitment to quality means we deliver solutions we’re truly proud of, while our curiosity sparks innovation and breakthrough thinking. 8th Lights thrive in an environment that champions continuous education, fueling our growth through mentorship and hands\-on work. We foster an open, collaborative culture grounded in honesty that builds trust, and believe true success is measured by the outcomes we create for our clients.



If this kind of work and our kind of people energises you, you’ve found the right place.


**Who You Are**
---------------



You’ve shown long\-term repeated success on a variety of projects, typically over the course of 10\+ years. You are a trusted expert and leader, often called upon to guide ambiguous initiatives and architect scalable solutions. You bring a blend of deep consulting acumen, technical expertise, and product thinking that drives measurable and impactful outcomes. In your previous experience, you have:


* Built and shipped production\-grade platforms: the reusable foundations, tools, infrastructure, and workflows that help other teams shift faster and more reliably
* Taken AI and agentic systems from prototype to production, with a strong understanding of infrastructure, authentication, and observability
* Delivered on high\-stakes consulting engagements across multiple language paradigms, stacks, ecosystems, and client industries
* Built high\-quality, maintainable software collaboratively, incrementally, and through an approach tailored towards the unique needs of the clients you’ve served
* Led the development and delivery of production\-grade software using a variety of languages and frameworks, including but not limited to: Java, C\#/.NET, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Go, Ruby, Scala, R, and SQL
* Actively experimented with AI development tools and translated that experimentation into faster, higher\-quality delivery for your teams
* A track record of understanding, assessing, and embracing new tooling and trends within the software industry
* Built or integrated AI/ML features into products and systems, including recommendation engines, NLP, computer vision, predictive analytics, RAG pipelines, and agents
* Successfully led modernisation and replatforming efforts to align legacy systems with short and long\-term business needs
* Led and delivered solutions to architecture\-level problems including scalability, security, reliability, performance, maintainability, and observability
* Facilitated alignment across technical and non\-technical stakeholders to move initiatives forward through ambiguity and complexity
* Provided mentorship and team support at scale, while sharing knowledge and improving team practices
* Collaboratively led stakeholders to balance technical considerations with product and user needs
* Actively sought out and effectively given feedback

**What You’ll Do At 8th Light**
-------------------------------



As a go\-to technologist and strategist within 8th Light, you’ll work with a variety of clients, typically one to two in a year, while continuing to deepen your and our collective domain expertise over the course of your career with us. You’ll be responsible for:


* Rapidly building trust with clients, demonstrating technical expertise and understanding of their domain and objectives
* Driving platform engineering work at the client level, connecting long\-term technical vision to what ships
* Leading platform strategy and delivery across diverse platform types, connecting long\-term vision to what ships
* Working pragmatically to balance technology choices while delivering high\-quality work within deadlines
* Advising clients on architecture, scalability and platform evolution, connecting technical decisions to product and business outcomes
* Collaborating on systems that involve the full ML lifecycle from data ingestion and preprocessing, to model deployment, integration, and performance monitoring
* Driving innovation by proactively surfacing new technical approaches and product solutions
* Leading or initiating formal feedback conversations with teams and clients via retrospectives
* Clearly articulating and documenting outcomes and driving forward action items
* Contributing to the health of your team and 8th Light’s culture by modeling our Values
* Designing and managing high\-level technical roadmaps for large engagements
* Building your network and maintaining relationships with clients and other industry leaders within your domain
* Coaching client engineering teams, transferring knowledge and leveling up practices
* Influencing client CTOs and executive decisions. Planning and execute technical work that involves stakeholders outside of project boundaries such as across a client's technical organization
* Partner with account teams on planning, opportunity identification, stakeholder relationships, and pre\-sales scope shaping
* Facilitating retrospectives, strategy sessions, and technical deep\-dives to improve team and project outcomes
* Identifying, mitigating, and resolving blockers to team progress
* Contributing to 8th Light by serving as a mentor, leading or designing workshops internally or for clients, representing 8th Light in the tech community, or supporting our hiring processes
* Demonstrating leadership in scalable system design, modular architecture, and platform\- or product\-oriented development
* Bringing depth in testing strategies, observability, fault tolerance, and secure engineering practices
* Applying architectural patterns to evaluate tradeoffs and drive clear, documented design rationale

**Strongly Preferred Skills**
-----------------------------



We work across many areas, and encourage anyone with the experience listed above to apply. We would particularly like to encourage applicants with experience in the following areas:


* Platform engineering: building reusable software foundations, internal developer platforms, and infrastructure that other teams build on
* Data Engineering: including platforms like Databricks for data processing and analytics
* Delivering production agentic systems, including RAG pipelines, vector search, and agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, and n8n
* DevSecOps \& DevOps
* MLOps
* Infrastructure as Code


Building a truly diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace is an ongoing journey, and we’re excited to keep learning and growing together. We have a proud tradition of hiring talented colleagues with real\-world career experiences.


**How You’ll be Supported**
---------------------------



At 8th Light, we believe our people are our greatest asset. Their growth, well\-being, and success shape our future.


* Our wellness package is designed with the Whole YOU in mind and includes:
* A robust L\&D programme featuring unlimited access to thousands of books, courses, and expert\-led training on the O'Reilly learning platform.
* Annual financial stipend and time allotment for learning \& development
* Coworking support for our global team
* 12 weeks of new parent leave available for eligible employees

  


**A Note on Compensation**
--------------------------



At 8th Light, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that is transparent, fair, and helps us attract and retain top talent in alignment with our company’s strategic growth goals and clients’ needs.



We benchmark our salaries using Geographic Structures to establish competitive pay ranges within the regions where 8th Lights live. Our pay ranges for our Principal Engineer position within London is: £92,818\-£116,122 GBP



Reach out to recruiting@8thlight.com for more relevant information pertaining to your local market.


**8th Light Hubs and Geographies**
----------------------------------



8th Light's culture is rooted in strong connections that extend across our teams, regions, and beyond client work. We are a distributed team across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom, with hubs in Chicago, London, Los Angeles, New York, and Seattle.


* **London Co\-working:** Employees working from our London hub follow a hybrid model, which includes a minimum of one day per week in our Waterloo Office. This co\-working day is designed to encourage collaboration and further strengthen our community.In most cases, our consulting engagements do not require travel.


We hope to see you apply!



\#LI\-Hybrid

**A Note on Your Privacy**
--------------------------



At 8th Light, one of our core values is ***Honesty that builds trust*** — and that shapes how we approach hiring. We want you to have a clear picture of *who we are*, *what we're looking for*, and *how we handle your information* throughout the process.

jobs.title: Protection and Control Design Engineer
jobs.description:
**Base Location**: Melksham, Oxford, Reading, Slough or Portsmouth  

**Salary:** £64,085 \- £76,581 \+ a range of other benefits to support your family, finances and wellbeing.  

**Working Pattern:** Permanent \| Full Time \| Flexible First options available



We are looking for an enthusiastic and diligent engineer to join the SSEN Protection \& Control (P\&C) Team working across the Southern  

Distribution Network.



As a Protection \& Control Engineer, you’ll work with a passionate team on projects from 6\.6kV to 132kV, taking designs from concept through construction and energisation. You’ll collaborate with stakeholders to deliver compliant, cost\-effective solutions on time. You’ll also engage in innovation, standardisation, technology assessments, and work with suppliers on new products and services.



Join us now to help tackle Net Zero challenges and embrace opportunities from new technologies and services.


**You will:**


* Develop scoping documentation and Main Connections \& Protection (MC\&P) Diagrams.
* Review Protection \& Control (P\&C) designs from third parties for 11kV, 33kV, and 132kV networks for SSEN.
* Specify P\&C equipment such as relays, CTs, and VTs.
* Produce detailed designs, including AC/DC schematics, and carry out protection grading studies with relay file/settings creation.
* Review Commissioning Plans, attend panel meetings, and witness FAT and on\-site commissioning as required.


**You have:**


* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) in a relevant field is required.
* Proven experience working on Distribution Networks from 11kV to 132kV, ideally a UK Distribution Network.
* Background as a Protection \& Control Design Engineer, including work at 11kV, 33kV, and 132kV.
* Experience in protection relays, relay panels, CT \& VT sizing, protection grading studies, and producing accurate AC/DC schematics.
* Strong knowledge of UK electrical standards, CDM regulations, and a commitment to safety with experience in risk mitigation.


Regular travel is required and as a result we can only accept applications from candidates that hold a current driving license.


**About SSE**



SSE’s purpose is to be restless every day until we make electricity clean, affordable and available for all.



We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. This includes electricity transmission and distribution networks, onshore and offshore wind farms, hydro\-electric power and flexible thermal generation. We also provide products and services for businesses and other customers.



Our investment plan will see SSE invest £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure to 2030\.



SSEN Distribution, part of the wider SSE group, powers 3\.9 million UK homes and businesses. Our team of more than 4,200 skilled engineers, customer service advisors and technical specialists keep customers connected to a safe, reliable supply of electricity while investing in and developing the flexible networks needed for our low carbon future.


**Flexible benefits to fit your life**



Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest\-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.


**Work with an equal opportunity employer**



SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. Please contact laura.morrison@sse.com / 01738 341814 to discuss how we can support you.



We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry.


**Ready to apply?**



Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. We'll be in touch after the closing date to let you know if we'll be taking your application further. If you're offered a role with SSE, you'll need to complete a criminality check and a credit check before you start work.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Context**


Engineering • Leeds • Full\-Time • Hybrid  

  

Are you a people\-first engineering leader who thrives on turning complex technical challenges into elegant, user\-centric software?  

  

As our Senior Engineering Manager, you will sit at the intersection of high\-level business strategy and hands\-on execution. You will lead the engineering organisation responsible for the full BigChange product suite—from our legacy monolith to our rapidly evolving microservices architecture and mobile product ecosystem.  

  

Reporting to executive leadership, you will lead high\-performing development teams, translate strategic vision into actionable technical roadmaps, and embed an AI\-first engineering culture that elevates delivery velocity, code quality, and team capabilities.  

  

About BigChange:  

  

BigChange is at an inflection point. As a pioneer of AI\-powered field service software serving over 250,000 users worldwide, we are transforming how trades and field service businesses operate. Headquartered in Leeds and part of the global Simpro Group network, our platform connects jobs, people, and performance across plumbing, HVAC, fire \& security, facilities management, electrical contracting, and more.  

  

Trusted by over 2,200 high\-growth businesses, we've processed billions in invoiced work and scheduled tens of millions of jobs. We've featured multiple times on the Sunday Times Tech Track 100, and we're just getting started. We’ve recently launched BigChange Lightning—an AI intelligence layer that deploys autonomous agents across field service operations—and we are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the teams building what comes next.**What You’ll Do**

**People Leadership \& Talent Development**
-------------------------------------------

* Grow \& Mentor: Run regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and merit cycles, providing honest, constructive feedback and creating tangible career pathways for individual contributors and leaders alike.
* Build a High\-Trust Culture: Drive hiring, onboarding, and retention efforts in Leeds to foster an inclusive, collaborative environment where engineers feel motivated to stay and do their best work.
* Be a Pillar of Support: Act as a trusted sounding board and support system for your team through both professional and personal challenges.

**Technical Requirements**

* Legacy Modernization \& Strategy: Expertise in bridging legacy monoliths (.NET 4\.6\.2, WebForms, jQuery) with modern architecture (C\# .NET 8, Micro\-frontends, Microservices on AWS EKS).
* Full\-Stack Platform Management: Ability to lead diverse development streams across Web (React, WebForms), Mobile (iOS/Swift, Android/Kotlin, Kotlin Multiplatform), and Backend systems.
* Cloud \& DevOps Leadership: Proven experience managing cloud infrastructure (AWS EC2, EKS) and robust CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps.
* Data Architecture: Proficiency in overseeing multi\-model data environments, including relational (MS SQL, PG SQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB) databases, alongside data integration pipelines (Snowflake, FiveTran).
* Observability \& Security Integration: A proactive approach to system health (New Relic), security compliance (Snyk, Auth0\), and incident management (PagerDuty, FlagSmith).

**Technical \& Mobile Platform Strategy**

* Set Technical Vision: Establish and communicate a technical vision that aligns with business goals, making pragmatic architectural decisions across web, cloud, and mobile platforms.
* Platform Evolution: Oversee our continued migration from an AWS EC2 monolith toward AWS EKS microservices, ensuring system reliability, security, and long\-term scalability.
* Mobile Ecosystem Leadership: Drive high technical standards across our native and cross\-platform mobile apps, mastering the nuances of mobile performance, deployment, and app store ecosystems.
* Champion Engineering Excellence: Establish high standards for code quality, continuous testing, and proactive management of technical debt with an AI\-first lens.

**Delivery, Operations \& AI\-First SDLC**

* Transform to an AI\-First Team: Lead the transition from traditional agile delivery to an AI\-first software development lifecycle—leveraging developer tooling and CI/CD intelligence to fundamentally change how engineers work and what they achieve.
* Measure Progress: Utilize industry\-standard framework metrics (such as DX Core 4\) to track team performance, remove delivery bottlenecks, and validate the efficiency gains of our AI transformation.
* Cross\-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with Product Management, Commercial teams, and executive leadership to balance feature delivery (especially mobile\-first initiatives) with platform maintenance and technical debt.
* Incident \& Vendor Leadership: Take the lead during high\-priority technical incidents, coordinating calm, swift resolutions, while managing key vendor relationships and external software partnerships where required.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Proven Engineering Leadership: 8\+ years of total software engineering experience with a track record of successfully managing, scaling, and transforming engineering teams within a fast\-paced SaaS environment.
* Mobile \& Systems Architecture Depth: Hands\-on expertise in modern mobile application development (iOS, Android, React Native, or Flutter) alongside proven experience navigating hybrid environments combining legacy systems and cloud microservices.
* AI Conviction: Genuine conviction about AI in engineering—you've moved teams beyond AI as a curiosity to AI as a core capability multiplier in developer workflows and product features.
* Pragmatic Debt Navigator: A track record of navigating legacy systems and technical debt pragmatically without stalling product velocity or feature delivery.
* Executive Communicator: Strong presence and communication skills—you easily translate complex technical challenges for executive stakeholders and bridge the gap between technical and business goals.
* Empathetic Leader: A genuinely people\-first manager who takes team morale, psychological safety, and individual growth seriously.
* Location: Located in or able to regularly commute to our headquarters in Leeds for on\-site leadership presence.

**Our Core Values**

 **We Are One Team**

**We Are Customer Centric**  

**We Are Growth Minded**  

**We Are Accountable**  

**We Celebrate Success**


Simpro, AroFlo, BigChange \& ClockShark are equal opportunity employers with a best\-of\-class onboarding program and supportive team environments. This means that we want everyone to feel welcome and offer equal opportunities for everyone, regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation, or any other non\-performance factor.


If you'd like to join a fun and progressive organisation, where there are opportunities to develop your career, please apply now with your CV/Resumer.

*Please note: no agencies will be accepted in the recruitment of this role. Any CVs provided to Simpro Software by agencies will be treated as a gift.*

jobs.title: Head of Software Engineering - C#.NET, Java, AWS, AI
jobs.description:
Role Overview  

Experian Software Solutions (ESS) is the global product and engineering function delivering world\-class software solutions. ESS is structured around core business areas: Analytics, Decisioning, Identity \& Fraud (ID\&F), and Solutions. ESS is comprised of \~1,100 people across 14 countries, almost 80% of whom are engineers.


We looking for an experienced Head of Software Engineering to provide strategic engineering leadership across the ID\&F global organisation, combining people leadership, technology modernisation, and delivery accountability. You will be a senior partner to business and technology stakeholders, shaping how engineering teams operate, innovate, and deliver at scale.

**You will be required to travel to our London office once a week to meet senior stakeholders.**


As the Head of Software Engineering, you will

* Build and lead high\-performing, globally distributed engineering teams, setting clear direction, priorities, accountability, and fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Drive delivery excellence by translating strategic objectives into executable plans, measurable outcomes, and sustainable operating rhythms that ensure consistent, high\-quality delivery.
* Champion an AI\-native engineering culture by embedding AI, automation, and data\-driven decision\-making into software development, delivery practices, and operational processes.
* Provide technical leadership with expertise in Java Full Stack, .NET, AWS, EKS, Claude, Cursor, and modern engineering and deployment practices to guide solution design and technical strategy.
* Lead technology modernisation initiatives, simplifying legacy environments and accelerating the adoption of new platforms, tools, architectures, and ways of working.
* Act as a trusted advisor and solution provider for complex business and technology challenges, applying structured thinking, sound judgment, and pragmatic decision\-making.
* Partner closely with product, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders to align priorities, remove blockers, manage dependencies, and deliver scalable solutions.
* Ensure all engineering decisions and execution activities align with governance, security, compliance, enterprise risk standards, and organisational objectives.
* Own workforce planning and talent strategy, including hiring, succession planning, capability development, diversity initiatives, and coaching people managers to build strong leadership pipelines.
* Manage budgets, vendor relationships, and resourcing strategies while representing engineering in senior leadership forums, providing visibility into risks, dependencies, performance, and strategic progress.

  

  

Experience and Skills  

* Strong people leadership experience, building, coaching and developing global engineering teams, driving engineering best practice and providing technical leadership.
* Proficient in .NET, AWS, EKS, Devops, Claude, Cursor based engineering and deployment practices. Any experience in Java is highly desirable.
* Experience using AI tools and driving adoption across engineering teams.
* Experience working within a secure development environment.
* Expertise in building strong relationships with teams and leaders globally and influencing decision making using a data driven approach.
* Foster a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and learning, encouraging teams to challenge the status quo and adopt better ways of working
* Demonstrate a strategic mindset while staying close to execution and driving delivery of solutions.
* Solves problems with a business\-first and technology\-informed mindset and adapts quickly and works effectively through ambiguity

  

  

About Experian  

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.


Benefits package includes:

* Hybrid working \- 40% office based
* Great compensation package and discretionary bonus
* Core benefits include Pension, Bupa healthcare, Sharesave Scheme and more
* 25 days annual leave with 8 bank holidays and 3 volunteering days. You can purchase additional annual leave.


Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award\-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25\), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site to understand why. Experian is also proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.


Grade: C/EB7

To apply for roles or verify opportunities, please visit experian.com/careers.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer - AI Engineering - New Capabilities
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
-----------------------

**At IFS, we're building the next generation of AI\-native enterprise software, transforming how some of the world's largest organisations manage assets, operations and critical services.**

**This is an opportunity to work at the forefront of modern AI engineering, building intelligent products that combine Large Language Models (LLMs), agentic AI and cloud\-native technologies to solve complex, real\-world business challenges at enterprise scale.**

**We're looking for engineers who are passionate about building production AI systems and excited by the opportunity to shape the future of enterprise software.**

**Please note that this role requires demonstrable, hands\-on experience designing, building and shipping production AI applications.**

*Candidates whose AI experience is limited to using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor or GitHub Copilot to assist software development, without demonstrable experience building AI\-powered products or systems, will not meet the requirements for this role.*

  

IFS is a billion\-dollar revenue company with 7000\+ employees on all continents. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award\-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting\-edge.


At IFS, we’re flexible, we’re innovative, and we’re focused not only on how we can engage with our customers but on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We help solve some of society’s greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust.


We celebrate diversity and understand our responsibility to reflect the diverse world we work in. We are committed to promoting an inclusive workforce that fully represents the many different cultures, backgrounds, and viewpoints of our customers, our partners, and our communities. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view.


By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a **global, diverse environment;** you will be joining a **winning team** with a **commitment to sustainability;** and a company where we get things done so that you can **make a positive impact** on the world.


We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can **\#MakeYourMoment** so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI\-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference.


If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.

**Job Description**
-------------------


We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer to embed directly with customers on IFS PSO, our enterprise scheduling and optimization platform (.NET 10/C\# backend, Angular frontend) used to solve complex resource planning and scheduling problems at scale. This is a hands\-on technical role that combines software engineering, applied optimization and direct customer engagement.


You will sit at the intersection of our optimization engine and our customers: modeling real\-world planning problems, and shipping working solutions fast, embedded with customer teams under tight deadlines.


This role suits an engineer who wants to solve hard optimization problems in the field, work directly with customers, and feed what they learn back into the core product.


We're AI\-first: you'll be expected to make full use of AI\-assisted and agentic workflows day to day, and we're looking for someone genuinely enthusiastic about using them to model problems and ship solutions faster.


Key Responsibilities

* Partner directly with customers to translate real\-world scheduling and planning problems into optimization models.
* Configure, extend, and debug the core scheduling engine and related components against live customer datasets.
* Build and iterate on new solutions with customer teams, often under tight deadlines.
* Feed field learnings back to core product and engineering teams to improve the platform.
**Qualifications**
------------------

* Strong software engineering background, ideally C\#/.NET; comfortable reading and modifying a large codebase.
* Hands\-on experience with optimization techniques, constraint programming, mathematical/linear programming, or algorithm development.
* Comfortable working directly with customers: gathering requirements, explaining trade\-offs, and presenting results.
* Bias toward shipping, with a willingness to develop and iterate quickly under ambiguity.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work through ambiguous, real\-world constraints.


Preferred / Bonus Experience

* Experience with Angular/TypeScript or other modern frontend frameworks.
* Background in workforce or resource scheduling domains.
* Experience with large\-scale data modelling.
* Familiarity with enterprise SaaS platforms or vertical\-specific optimization products.


Technology Stack (Representative)

* Backend: .NET 10, C\#
* Frontend: Angular, TypeScript
* Optimization: Constraint programming, mathematical/linear programming, heuristics, algorithm development.
* Deployment: On\-site and embedded customer environments, cloud\-hosted platform
* Practices: Git, automated testing, DevOps


What Success Looks Like

* Customer scheduling and planning problems modeled accurately and solved within performance targets.
* Working solutions shipped to customers, on tight timelines.
* Optimizer performance and quality issues diagnosed and resolved efficiently.
* Field learnings translated into concrete product and engineering improvements.
* Strong, trusted relationships built with customer teams.
**Additional Information**
--------------------------

*We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.*

jobs.description:

**Location:** UK / Hybrid  
**Department:** Development  
**Reports to:** Head of Development  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time

About Compliance Chain

Compliance Chain is a growing digital technology company providing SaaS and expert consultancy solutions across the built environment.

Our platform brings together compliance, supply chain assurance, performance management and social value solutions, helping organisations manage complex operational requirements through one connected digital ecosystem.

We are still in the early stages of our journey, but we have established products, clients and a growing market presence. As we continue to scale, technology is at the heart of our ambition to become the market\-leading SaaS platform within the built environment.

We are looking for a **Senior Full Stack Developer** to join our development team and play a key role in building, improving and scaling our product suite.

The Role

As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will be responsible for delivering high\-quality software across both the front\-end and back\-end of our platform.

This is a hands\-on role for someone who takes pride in **excellent delivery**, writes maintainable and scalable code, and wants to have a genuine impact on the products they work on.

You will work closely with our Head of Development, product and operational teams to understand requirements, solve technical problems and turn ideas into reliable, user\-focused solutions.

As a senior member of the team, you will also be expected to contribute to technical decisions, support other developers and help us continually improve how we develop and deliver software.

Key Responsibilities

* Own the development and delivery of features across our SaaS product suite.
* Work across both **front\-end and back\-end development**.
* Design, develop and maintain scalable, secure and maintainable software.
* Translate business and product requirements into effective technical solutions.
* Work closely with product and operational teams to understand requirements and deliver against them.
* Take ownership of development tasks from initial planning through to deployment.
* Investigate and resolve bugs, technical issues and performance problems.
* Contribute to architectural and technical decisions.
* Review code and provide constructive feedback to other developers.
* Help establish and maintain strong development standards and best practices.
* Support the continuous improvement of our development processes, tooling and ways of working.
* Consider security, performance, scalability and usability throughout the development lifecycle.
* Work with our Azure infrastructure and contribute to the continued scalability and resilience of the platform.
* Help identify technical debt and opportunities to improve the existing product.
* Support the Head of Development in shaping the technical roadmap and future development capability.
* Stay up to date with relevant technologies and development practices.

Our Technology Stack

Our core technology stack includes:

**Front End**

* Angular
* TypeScript
* HTML / CSS

**Back End**

* C\#
* .NET
* REST APIs

**Database**

* MySQL

**Cloud \& Infrastructure**

* Microsoft Azure
* Azure\-based application and infrastructure services

We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to work within an existing stack. We want someone who understands **why** technology decisions are made and can help us improve the way we build our platform.

What We're Looking ForEssential

* Strong commercial experience as a **Full Stack Developer**.
* Strong experience with **C\# and .NET**.
* Strong experience with **Angular / TypeScript**.
* Solid experience working with **MySQL or relational databases**.
* Experience developing and consuming **RESTful APIs**.
* Experience working with **Microsoft Azure**.
* Strong understanding of software development principles and best practices.
* Experience working with version control, preferably Git.
* Strong understanding of application security, performance and scalability.
* Experience working within an Agile or similar development environment.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* A genuine commitment to delivering high\-quality software.

Desirable

* Experience working with SaaS products.
* Experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with automated testing and test\-driven development.
* Experience designing system architecture.
* Experience integrating third\-party APIs and services.
* Experience working with cloud\-based infrastructure.
* Experience working within a regulated or compliance\-focused environment.
* Experience mentoring or supporting junior/mid\-level developers.

The Person

Technical ability is important, but we're looking for someone who fits how we want to operate as a business.

You will be someone who:

* **Takes ownership** – you don't wait to be told about problems; you identify them and help solve them.
* **Cares about quality** – you take pride in producing reliable, maintainable and well\-tested software.
* **Is delivery focused** – you understand that great development is ultimately about delivering value to customers and the business.
* **Thinks commercially** – you understand the difference between building something technically interesting and building something that solves a genuine customer or business problem.
* **Communicates well** – you can explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical colleagues.
* **Challenges constructively** – you're comfortable questioning requirements or approaches when you believe there is a better solution.
* **Works collaboratively** – you support your colleagues and contribute to a positive development culture.
* **Is proactive** – you look for ways to improve the product, processes and team rather than simply completing assigned tickets.
* **Is adaptable** – you are comfortable working in a growing business where priorities can evolve.
* **Is committed to excellent delivery** – you care about getting things right, not simply getting things done.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success will mean:

* Consistently delivering high\-quality features and improvements.
* Taking ownership of development work from requirement through to release.
* Contributing positively to the technical direction of the platform.
* Improving the quality, scalability and maintainability of our codebase.
* Helping the wider development team raise its technical standards.
* Identifying and addressing technical issues before they become larger problems.
* Helping Compliance Chain deliver a stable, secure and scalable SaaS platform.
* Ultimately, contributing to a product that our customers genuinely value and rely upon.

Why Join Compliance Chain?

This is an opportunity to join a business at an exciting stage of its growth.

You won't be joining a large organisation where your role is limited to maintaining one small part of an established system. You'll have the opportunity to **make a tangible impact on our products, technology and the way we operate**.

You'll work alongside an experienced and growing team, have visibility across the wider business and play an important role in helping us build technology capable of supporting our next stage of growth.

If you're a developer who wants responsibility, enjoys solving problems and takes genuine pride in delivering excellent software, we'd like to hear from you.

Pay: £45,000\.00\-£70,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Company pension
* Discounted or free food
* Private medical insurance
* Sick pay

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Liverpool L3

jobs.title: Engineering (Multiple Roles and Locations) Industrial Placement, 2027
jobs.description:
**Choose Wisely, Apply Confidently**

To maximise your opportunities at securing an Industrial Placement with us this year, we strongly advise that you **apply to no more than 3 adverts** . (For clarity, multiple roles within a single advert are considered one application.)


We encourage you to concentrate your efforts on the roles that best align with your skills, interests and university experience, as this will strengthen your application and give you the best chance of success.


**Roles Available in Location** : Ware, Montrose, Worthing, Stevenage, Barnard Castle


**Education required** : See individual roles for degree requirements


**Please read the degree requirements for each role carefully before applying.**

**Other requirements** : You will have completed a minimum of 2 years of your undergraduate degree but will not have graduated at the start of your placement. You must be enrolled at a UK (United Kingdom) or ROI (Republic of Ireland) University for the duration of your placement.


**Pre\-application activity:** Before applying, you'll need to obtain an application code by completing a short activity in Connectr, our candidate engagement platform.


This activity is designed to encourage considered applications. Once completed, you'll receive your unique application code required to proceed with your application.


**If you have already graduated with a** **bachelor’s degree and are currently studying a postgraduate Masters, you are not eligible for this programme.**

**Language requirement** : Written and spoken fluency in English


**Expected Start date** : July 2027


**Duration** : 1 year (approximately)


**Salary** : A salary of £26,400 plus a bonus.


**Workplace Arrangements:** See individual roles.


**Application Closing** : Roles are expected to close on **06/10/2026** , however, candidates will be reviewed regularly, and the advert may close at any point. **Please ensure you review and complete the application stages below.**

**Are you looking to gain valuable real world work experience and help positively impact the lives of others?**

A GSK internship offers you the opportunity to kickstart your career – to take on a real role with genuine impact. You’ll take on challenging tasks within live projects or assignments. You’ll also get to learn from others in your team and other parts of GSK whilst developing your skills and gaining valuable experience for wherever the future takes you.


**What do we offer you?**

* A competitive salary, with an annual bonus based on company performance.
* Employee recognition programs, which reward exceptional achievements.
* Access to our cutting\-edge wellbeing platform: personalise your experience, help reduce stress, increase focus, build connections and resilience. You will also have access to a confidential helpline 24/7, mindfulness, health screenings and financial wellbeing support.
* Access to Private Healthcare Insurance, including 24\-hour access to an online GP.
* Optional Support: Includes identity protection, long\-term care insurance, home, auto, and pet insurance
* Opportunities to work with Employee Resource Groups, providing opportunities to network, gain mentorship, and develop personally and professionally.
* Access to IPUnite which is a community of Early Careers programme participants offering development, networking and social connections to help you make the best of your programme. You will also be invited to join LinkedIn groups and pre\-joining webinars, to enable you to connect and network with new students.
* 2 volunteering days per year

Typical skills you can expect to learn on this placement will include:


* Teamworking through working with multidisciplinary teams
* Communication (written \& verbal)
* Time management
* Problem\-solving
* Networking
* Data analysis and management
* Technical skills (detailed within each role description)

**The Roles (8 available)**

**This advert contains multiple roles. Please read each role carefully before proceeding as you will be asked to provide a preference in the application process.**

**Role 1 – Engineering – Ware**

Degree requirements: any Engineering discipline, including (but not limited to) Mechanical, Chemical, Automation, Electrical, Mechatronic, Robotics or related.


Workplace arrangements – Full time onsite required


Overview of the Department


This is an exciting opportunity to gain hands\-on experience within a world\-class pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. You will work alongside experienced engineers, supporting projects that improve equipment reliability, manufacturing performance, sustainability and digital innovation.


Key Placement Activities


* Support engineering projects from concept through to implementation and qualification.
* Assist with the installation, commissioning and improvement of manufacturing equipment and utilities.
* Contribute to equipment reliability and maintenance activities, helping to improve safety, performance and operational efficiency.
* Work with automation, control systems and digital technologies to support manufacturing improvements.
* Use data analysis and visualisation tools to identify trends and support data\-driven decision making.
* Participate in continuous improvement projects, applying structured problem\-solving techniques.

**Role 2 \- Chemical Engineering – Montrose**

Degree requirements: Related science/engineering degree


Workplace arrangements: Full time onsite


Overview of the Department


The Manufacturing Science and Technology Engineering Associate supports engineers in monitoring process performance, analysing manufacturing data, and driving continuous process improvements within a pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. The role contributes to process mapping activities, evaluation and implementation of new or modified equipment and technologies, and supports deviation investigations to ensure operational excellence and compliance.


Working closely with cross\-functional teams, the position helps optimise manufacturing processes, improve throughput, and enhance process control to deliver reliable and efficient production outcomes. The role also provides opportunities for professional engineering development while strengthening collaboration, communication, problem\-solving, and risk assessment capabilities.


Key Placement Learnings


* Support MSAT engineers with process monitoring, performance analysis, and data\-driven decision making to optimise manufacturing performance.
* Assist with process mapping, workflow evaluation, and identification of process improvement opportunities.
* Participate in the assessment, implementation, and validation of new or modified equipment and technologies.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives focused on process efficiency, quality, throughput optimisation, and process control.
* Support deviation investigations, root cause analysis, and risk assessment activities to ensure robust manufacturing processes.
* Collaborate with manufacturing, engineering, quality, and technical teams while maintaining accurate documentation and supporting compliance requirements.

**Role 3 \- Process Engineering Automation \& Modelling – Stevenage**

Degree requirements: Any computational degree, e.g., Computer Science, Data Science or a STEM degree with computational interests and experience with programming


Workplace arrangements: Flexible working via performance with choice (office and home working available)


Overview of the Department


Process Engineering \& Analytics (PE\&A) is a multidisciplinary, digital\-first centre of excellence that transforms data, knowledge, and technology into a sustained competitive advantage for delivery across medicines and vaccines. By combining engineering, modelling, automation, analytics, and advanced digital capabilities, the department supports the broader business ambition to accelerate drug development with reduced risk and greater efficiency. Engineers and scientists work collaboratively to solve real\-world challenges across multiple modalities, including vaccines, biopharmaceuticals, and small molecules, and at all stages of development from laboratory and pilot\-scale environments through to commercial manufacturing. PE\&A enables medicine development teams to adopt and embed innovative digital solutions that support pipeline delivery, scalable impact, and long\-term value creation.


Key Placement Learnings


* Develop expertise in building and deploying control and orchestration systems that enable efficient, scalable, and automated process development workflows.
* Create and apply process models and simulation tools to support process understanding, virtual experimentation, and data\-driven decision\-making across pharmaceutical development.
* Contribute to the democratisation of modelling capabilities by developing accessible digital solutions that enable scientists and engineers to leverage advanced modelling approaches in their day\-to\-day work.
* Explore and implement AI\-driven and agentic workflows to automate complex tasks, accelerate insight generation, and support in\-silico experimentation and process optimisation.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams of engineers, scientists, and digital specialists to deliver innovative modelling, automation, and digital transformation solutions to real\-world development challenges.
* Strengthen technical communication, problem\-solving, and project delivery skills through the development and presentation of technical outputs, while adhering to departmental safety, quality, and compliance standards.

**Role 4 \- Medicine Development and Industrialisation – Sustainability \- Ware or Montrose**

Degree requirements: Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Data Science or other Science\-related discipline


Workplace arrangements: Flexible working via performance with choice (office and home working available)


Overview of the Department


GSK has ambitious environmental sustainability goals to have a net zero impact on climate and a net positive impact on nature by 2030 across our entire end to end value chain. The Medicine Development and Industrialisation team is responsible for defining and delivering technical aspects of the sustainability strategy, namely Ecodesign (how we design and develop our products \&


processes to make them more sustainable) within legacy, next generation and new products within the GSK Global Supply Chain (GSC) product portfolio.


Within this role, you will assist in delivering the technical aspects of the GSK sustainability strategy. You will do this by supporting a team of Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) specialists to develop and identify environmental impact reduction plans, working to deliver GSK’s commitment to a nature positive world, by reducing our environmental impacts across, carbon, water, materials, and


biodiversity. Furthermore, you will engage in delivering reduction strategies and project initiatives on identified hotspots, from raw materials, our processes (product \& packaging), to patient use, which are significant to our ambition.


Key Placement Activities


* Support the development of a standard approach to LCA, managing data, documents,
* and outputs.
* Assist with streamlining and automation of product LCA.
* Develop your scientific/technical knowledge of GSK’s pharmaceutical products and
* processes.
* Learn how to drive positive change in sustainability, building relationships across
* multiple interfaces in a matrix environment.
* Build your teamworking and communication skills by working collaboratively both with
* co\-workers and other functions.
* Enhance your written skills through technical report writing

**Role 5 – Mechanical Engineering – Montrose**

Degree requirements: Mechanical Engineering


Workplace Arrangements: Full time on site required


Overview of the Department


GSK Montrose manufactures a range of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) for respiratory, dermatological and HIV conditions. The Production Engineering team provides support to five key manufacturing areas producing multiple APIs. The team consists of Mechanical Engineering, Mechanical Inspection, HVAC Engineering, Reliability Engineering and Engineering Maintenance. On a daily basis, the team reacts to resolve any plant breakdown situations. Longer term actions focus on improving efficiency, operability and maintenance of plant. The department also supports the utilities and infrastructure strategy and provides solutions to engineering problems throughout the business.


Key Placement Learnings


* Ownership of maintenance life cycle plans (establish, update, review)
* Perform failure investigations
* Develop technical specification of maintenance contracts
* Technical input and approvals under the Plant Modification Procedure
* Make recommendations on technically complex issues through evaluating engineering problems that have a potential business impact.
* Take account of legal, regulatory and financial implications of engineering standards and changes.
* Ensure that asset care activities are performed in a compliant manner.
* Understand appropriate commitments/requirements of the Quality Management System.
* Follow the principles of Good Manufacturing Practice.

**Role 6 – Mechanical Engineering – Worthing**

Degree requirements: Any Engineering discipline


Workplace Arrangements: Full time on site required


Overview of the Department


There are several Mechanical Engineering opportunities available at the Worthing site.


Within the Manufacturing area, you will be working with highly competent engineers within a highly regulated environment, on equipment which produced numerous APIs.


Within the packaging department, you will experience high speed packaging lines and the importance of a strong reliability programme to maintain successful Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).


In our production and technical teams, you will support day to operations by conducting root cause analysis to meet our high specifications in quality and Environmental Health and Sustainability (EHS).


The utilities and facilities team supports Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) critical systems (water, HVAC, steam, compressed etc.), industrial utilities (waste treatment, chillers, cooling towers) and is the interface with our 3rd party service providers for both our main manufacturing site and our R\&D facility.


Key Placement Learnings


* Supporting delivery of the Mechanical, Inspection and Reliability programmes
* Investigating new engineering technologies to improve plant and maintenance techniques
* Development and implementation of maintenance best practice
* Specifying new equipment and components
* Performing root cause analysis investigations and contributing to safety and quality risk assessments
* Carrying out continuous improvement activities to ensure good manufacturing practice
* Gaining a thorough understanding of the equipment, plant and processes used at the site including mechanical design of systems and the ability to problem solve
* Leading and managing groups of peers or contractors
* Developing skills in project management and planning projects such as plant modifications, building turnarounds and production line safety improvements

**Role 7 \- Facilities Engineering – Barnard Castle**

Degree requirements: Currently studying an Undergraduate Degree in Engineering: Mechanical Engineering, Facilities Engineering, Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering.


Workplace Arrangements: Full time on site required


Overview of the Department


RSC Assembly Engineering manage and improve the Assembly platforms to enable maximum production opportunity. Managing maintenance, breakdowns, obsolescence programs, capital projects and equipment performance to maximise business benefit and strategic objectives.


Key Placement Activities


* Change management (Change controls)
* Identification and development of business cases for continuous improvement Root cause analysis
* Supporting design for equipment upgrades
* Leading meetings
* Document updates
* Stakeholder management
* Change management

**Role 8 – R\&D Engineering Services – Stevenage**

Degree requirements: Any Engineering Degree


Overview of the Department


R\&D Engineering Services delivers facilities management, engineering and capital project services that support Research \& Development. Working closely with suppliers, the team ensures research environments are safe, reliable, compliant and sustainable, supporting more than 13,000 people across 14 sites in six countries, covering 4\.7 million square feet with an annual budget exceeding £400 million.


As part of the R\&D Engineering Services Global and Europe Engineering teams, you will gain exposure to engineering standards and compliance, asset lifecycle management, energy and sustainability initiatives, capital planning and cross\-functional projects. You will work alongside experienced multi\-disciplinary engineers who will provide coaching and mentoring throughout your placement, while contributing to projects ranging from equipment installations and calibration to cyber security and environmental initiatives that support GSK’s 2030 Environmental and Sustainability Targets.


Key Placement Learnings


* Build an understanding of site equipment, processes and engineering systems, developing strong problem\-solving skills.
* Use specialist engineering software to support engineering and maintenance activities.
* Support the delivery and continuous improvement of engineering, inspection and reliability programmes.
* Research, specify and implement new equipment, technologies and best\-practice maintenance solutions.
* Perform root cause investigations and contribute to safety, quality and risk assessments.
* Develop project management, planning and leadership skills while working

**Role 9 – Chemical Engineering – Ware**

Degree requirements: Chemical Engineering


Overview of the Department


The Chemical Engineering teams at Ware support several initiatives, such as the manufacturing of Oral Solid Dose products for global supply and New Product Introduction. The Manufacturing Science and Technology department then monitor the performance of products and platforms within the Oral Solid Dose, Respiratory and Micronising value streams, overseeing all aspects of product lifecycle management.


You could be placed within either of these departments, supporting the transfer and development of manufacturing process from R\&D to GSC, including preparation activities and set\-up, troubleshooting/problem solving and process improvements. Additional duties may include introduction and scale up of newly developed R\&D assets to ensuring robust and repeatable manufacture of commercialised pharmaceutical products, as well as ensuring that equipment is capable of handling product materials and that such platforms are optimised to allow for efficient performance.


Key Placement Learnings


* Lead problem solving and continuous improvement for product processing issues.


* Support platform team and product owners in delivery of Product Lifecyle Management.


* Identify and implement solutions to improve product quality, as well as safety and efficiency gains.


* Support the development and implementation of manufacturing processes for new products.


* Develop skills in technical report writing, stakeholder management, data analysis \& visualisation.


* Actively monitor process and product performance to optimise/escalate as required


* Execute/Support key technical activities e.g. trials and validation activities


* Strengthen your understanding of product lifecycle management and technical capabilities of Respiratory platforms


**Role 10 – Process Engineering – Stevenage**

Degree requirements: Chemical Engineering


Overview of the Department


The Process Engineering placement sits within the Drug Substance Development (DSD) department. As a member of DSD, you will use your engineering knowledge and expertise to develop and deploy state\-of\-the\-art processes and technology to enable the delivery of GSK medicines.


Key Placement Activities


* Design and perform scale up/down experiments in chemical engineering unit operations to develop understanding against fast paced project timelines
* Think creatively to optimise engineering solutions and de\-risk scale\-up processes.
* Ensure that experimental work is communicated effectively at internal R\&D meetings and develop your teamworking skills.
* Participate in technology transfer activities as appropriate to GSK manufacturing partners.
* Author or contribute to internal documentation relevant to the role.
* Comply with applicable Data Integrity, Quality, cGMP (current Good Manufacturing Practice) and regulatory requirements in all aspects of work and fully embrace all aspects of safety when working in the laboratory.
* Gain practical familiarity with process simulation/modelling techniques such as MATLAB, DynoChem and gPROMS, and awareness of PAT tools such as NIR, Raman, IR.

**Apply now!**

These placement opportunities have the following recruitment stages – you must successfully pass each stage to be offered a placement year with GSK for 2027:


1\. Complete Connectr activity – obtain your personal code


2\. Eligibility Form – enter your personal code


3\. GSK Digital Assessment


4\. Some technical roles may require a short technical assessment


5\. Virtual Assessment Centre or Virtual Interview


**Note:** Your Connectr application code is unique and must not be shared. Using someone else's code, or sharing your own, may result in your application being withdrawn.


You can find hints and tips on our recruitment process and get guidance from real GSK mentors on our Early Careers Hub here .


We’re 100% open to all talent. We want to recruit the right people for GSK from the widest possible backgrounds, so we can better serve the inclusion of our patients and because it’s the right thing to do. You can learn more about Inclusion at GSK here .


For more information about GSK and our careers please visit our website here .


Need help with your application? Please email us at UK.InternRecruitment@gsk.com or call us on 01582 692870 and let us know how we can help you.


\#Internships \#UKEarlyCareers \#GSKIndustrialPlacements \#GSKEngineeringPlacements \#GSKGlobalSupplyChainPlacements \#GSKResearch\&Development \#GSKSTEMPlacements \#GSKWare \#GSKMontrose \#GSKScotland \#GSKStevenage\#GSKWorthing\#GSKBarnardCastle\#GSKNorthEast

  

  

**Skills**

Asset Life Cycle Management, Data Integrity, Digital Fluency, GxP Regulations, Lean Management, Manufacturing Technologies, Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, Problem Solving, Risk Awareness, Standards Compliance  

**Why GSK?**  

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2\.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.


People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.


GSK is an Equal Opportunity Employer. This ensures that all qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information (including family medical history), military service or any basis prohibited under federal, state or local law.


We believe in an agile working culture for all our roles. If flexibility is important to you, we encourage you to explore with our hiring team what the opportunities are.


Please don’t hesitate to contact us if you’d like to discuss any reasonable adjustments to our process which might help you demonstrate your strengths and capabilities.


For UK Intern roles (including Industrial Placements) you can either call us on 01582 692870, or send an email uk.InternRecruitment@gsk.com


For UK Apprentice and Graduate Programme roles you can either call us on 0203 862 2277, or send an email **uk.EarlyCareers@gsk.com**

GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer - AI Engineering - New Capabilities
jobs.description:
**Company Description** **At IFS, we're building the next generation of AI\-native enterprise software, transforming how some of the world's largest organisations manage assets, operations and critical services.**

**This is an opportunity to work at the forefront of modern AI engineering, building intelligent products that combine Large Language Models (LLMs), agentic AI and cloud\-native technologies to solve complex, real\-world business challenges at enterprise scale.**

**We're looking for engineers who are passionate about building production AI systems and excited by the opportunity to shape the future of enterprise software.**

**Please note that this role requires demonstrable, hands\-on experience designing, building and shipping production AI applications.**

*Candidates whose AI experience is limited to using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor or GitHub Copilot to assist software development, without demonstrable experience building AI\-powered products or systems, will not meet the requirements for this role.*

  

IFS is a billion\-dollar revenue company with 7000\+ employees on all continents. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award\-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting\-edge.


At IFS, we’re flexible, we’re innovative, and we’re focused not only on how we can engage with our customers but on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We help solve some of society’s greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust.


We celebrate diversity and understand our responsibility to reflect the diverse world we work in. We are committed to promoting an inclusive workforce that fully represents the many different cultures, backgrounds, and viewpoints of our customers, our partners, and our communities. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view.


By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a **global, diverse environment;** you will be joining a **winning team** with a **commitment to sustainability;** and a company where we get things done so that you can **make a positive impact** on the world.


We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can **\#MakeYourMoment** so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI\-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference.


If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.

 **Job Description**  

We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer to embed directly with customers on IFS PSO, our enterprise scheduling and optimization platform (.NET 10/C\# backend, Angular frontend) used to solve complex resource planning and scheduling problems at scale. This is a hands\-on technical role that combines software engineering, applied optimization and direct customer engagement.


You will sit at the intersection of our optimization engine and our customers: modeling real\-world planning problems, and shipping working solutions fast, embedded with customer teams under tight deadlines.


This role suits an engineer who wants to solve hard optimization problems in the field, work directly with customers, and feed what they learn back into the core product.


We're AI\-first: you'll be expected to make full use of AI\-assisted and agentic workflows day to day, and we're looking for someone genuinely enthusiastic about using them to model problems and ship solutions faster.


Key Responsibilities

* Partner directly with customers to translate real\-world scheduling and planning problems into optimization models.
* Configure, extend, and debug the core scheduling engine and related components against live customer datasets.
* Build and iterate on new solutions with customer teams, often under tight deadlines.
* Feed field learnings back to core product and engineering teams to improve the platform.

 **Qualifications*** Strong software engineering background, ideally C\#/.NET; comfortable reading and modifying a large codebase.
* Hands\-on experience with optimization techniques, constraint programming, mathematical/linear programming, or algorithm development.
* Comfortable working directly with customers: gathering requirements, explaining trade\-offs, and presenting results.
* Bias toward shipping, with a willingness to develop and iterate quickly under ambiguity.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work through ambiguous, real\-world constraints.


Preferred / Bonus Experience

* Experience with Angular/TypeScript or other modern frontend frameworks.
* Background in workforce or resource scheduling domains.
* Experience with large\-scale data modelling.
* Familiarity with enterprise SaaS platforms or vertical\-specific optimization products.


Technology Stack (Representative)

* Backend: .NET 10, C\#
* Frontend: Angular, TypeScript
* Optimization: Constraint programming, mathematical/linear programming, heuristics, algorithm development.
* Deployment: On\-site and embedded customer environments, cloud\-hosted platform
* Practices: Git, automated testing, DevOps


What Success Looks Like

* Customer scheduling and planning problems modeled accurately and solved within performance targets.
* Working solutions shipped to customers, on tight timelines.
* Optimizer performance and quality issues diagnosed and resolved efficiently.
* Field learnings translated into concrete product and engineering improvements.
* Strong, trusted relationships built with customer teams.

 **Additional Information** *We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.*

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer - Managed Service
jobs.description:
We’re an award\-winning consultancy known for delivering exceptional products and services through technology. We work closely with organisations to help them accelerate value delivery and create outstanding customer experiences. Our purpose is simple: to empower organisations to make a real difference for people, society, and the planet through technology that’s efficient, user\-friendly, and solves problems fast.


At Burendo, we believe that together, we can achieve incredible things.


What sets us apart is how we work. We pride ourselves on having a pragmatic attitude to delivery—we think big, plan practically, adapt quickly, and always focus on results, no matter how complex the challenge. We’re passionate about making great things happen by embracing innovation, challenging the status quo, and fostering collaboration at every step. jobs.title: Group Maintenance Manager / Multi-Skilled Maintenance Engineer
jobs.description:
The role

Barworks is looking for an experienced and highly capable Group Maintenance Manager to keep our venues safe, compliant and running smoothly. This is a senior, hands\-on position for a practical all\-rounder who can diagnose problems quickly, complete a wide range of repairs and take ownership of maintenance across five busy hospitality sites.

You will work directly with our Operations Director and CEO, while managing your own priorities with a high degree of independence. Support and decisions will always be available when needed, but day to day you will be trusted to assess issues, act quickly and see work through properly.

Key responsibilities

* Take ownership of planned, preventive and reactive maintenance across all five venues.
* Diagnose and complete repairs involving electrical systems, plumbing, fixtures, fittings, fabric and general building maintenance, working only within your competence and qualifications.
* Respond promptly to urgent breakdowns and participate in the agreed out of hours emergency call out arrangement.
* Prioritise work based on safety, compliance, operational impact and guest experience, keeping venue teams informed throughout.
* Create and maintain practical maintenance schedules, asset information, service records and clear records of completed work.
* Identify recurring faults and recommend durable, cost\-effective solutions rather than repeated short\-term fixes.
* Source parts and materials, obtain and compare quotations, and manage maintenance costs responsibly.
* Appoint and coordinate approved specialist contractors where work requires additional certification, equipment or capacity; monitor quality, cost and completion.
* Support statutory inspections, servicing and compliance activity, escalating risks or overdue actions immediately.
* Carry out routine checks and support venue opening, refurbishment and improvement projects where required.
* Build strong working relationships with General Managers, kitchen teams and senior leaders across the group.
* Maintain tools, equipment and any company vehicle safely, securely and in good working order.

What we are looking for

* Substantial hands\-on maintenance experience in hospitality, leisure, retail or another fast\-moving multi\-site environment.
* Strong practical experience across both electrical and plumbing work, supported by relevant recognised trade qualification or qualifications, or demonstrably equivalent competence.
* A sound understanding of safe systems of work and the limits of your own competence, with the judgement to bring in a specialist contractor when required.
* The ability to diagnose faults calmly, make sensible decisions and complete work to a consistently high standard.
* Excellent organisation and the confidence to manage competing priorities across several live venues.
* A self\-sufficient and accountable approach, with clear communication and good record keeping.
* Flexibility to travel between East and Central London and respond to genuine operational emergencies outside normal working hours.
* A full UK driving licence.

Additional experience we would value

* Gas Safe registration or relevant gas qualifications.
* PAT testing competence or certification.
* Commercial refrigeration or air\-conditioning experience.
* Commercial kitchen equipment and appliance fault\-finding or repair experience.
* Experience with extraction, cellar, drainage, HVAC, fire safety or access\-control systems.
* An existing van and professional tool set. A suitable company vehicle \& tool set can be provided if required.

We are keen to cast a wide net. You do not need to hold every specialist qualification listed above to apply. For the right person, we are open to discussing support towards relevant additional qualifications and training. Specialist skills and the breadth of work you can safely undertake will be reflected in the salary offered.

What we offer

* Salary of £60,000 to £75,000, depending on experience, qualifications and specialist capability.
* 28 days' holiday per year, including bank holidays.
* Workplace pension.
* Staff discount and meals while working.
* Confidential 24\-7 Employee Assistance Programme support.
* Company mobile phone.
* A suitable company vehicle where required.
* Support towards relevant additional training or qualifications for the right candidate.

Working arrangements

This is a mobile role across five operational venues. The successful candidate will organise their working week around planned maintenance and business priorities and will also take part in an agreed emergency call out arrangement. The practical details of availability, response expectations, time off and any additional call out arrangements will be confirmed with the successful candidate.

How to apply

Please send your CV together with a short summary of your core trades, qualifications, experience working across operational sites, and any experience with refrigeration, commercial appliances, gas or PAT testing.

Pay: £60,000\.00\-£75,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Company pension

Work Location: In person
