jobs.title: QA Engineer
jobs.description:
**A bit of background on Rotageek**
-----------------------------------


Rotageek helps businesses optimise staff scheduling through data\-driven technology. By combining machine learning and advanced algorithms, we help organisations forecast demand, improve workforce management and give employees greater control over their schedules.


Our solutions drive operational efficiency, improve customer experiences and help reduce staff turnover across the retail and healthcare sectors. Rotageek is now part of the ELMO Software group, strengthening our ability to deliver industry\-leading workforce management solutions as part of a broader HR technology ecosystem.


Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we’ll let you in on a secret: there’s no such thing as a “perfect” candidate.


Rotageek is a place where everyone can grow. So, however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.

**Our values: what we live by**
-------------------------------


**Start With People**: You champion the customer experience, create psychological safety and help the whole team deliver with confidence.


**Own It, Together**: You take responsibility for quality outcomes, collaborate across disciplines and help turn incidents into learning.


**Clear Is Kind**: You make defects, risks, coverage and quality decisions clear, actionable and respectful.

**Why this role is so important**
---------------------------------


Quality is central to the trust our customers place in Rotageek. As a QA Engineer, you’ll help make sure our product works for the people who rely on it every day, from the journeys they take through the product to the data and insights they use to make decisions.


You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product and Data colleagues from the beginning of the delivery process. You’ll help the team identify risk early, design effective coverage and make confident release decisions.


This is not a role where QA waits at the end of the process. You’ll combine automation, exploratory testing and customer thinking to find the risks that matter most and turn learning into better ways of working.


You’ll also have the opportunity to use AI\-assisted testing tools to broaden ideas, generate scenarios and accelerate automation, while applying the human judgement needed to validate the results.

**️ What you’ll be doing**
--------------------------

* Collaborate on requirements and designs early, helping the team make features clear, testable and valuable for customers.
* Plan testing for features and epics, identifying risk, dependencies, coverage needs and realistic timelines.
* Execute exploratory, functional, regression and smoke testing across important user journeys and real\-world scenarios.
* Apply risk\-based testing, focusing depth where customer impact, data sensitivity or failure consequences are highest.
* Design and maintain reliable automated tests at the right level, integrating them into CI/CD for fast feedback.
* Manage test data and environments so testing is repeatable, representative and appropriately isolated.
* Investigate and manage defects through to resolution, with clear reproduction steps, appropriate prioritisation and thoughtful root\-cause analysis.
* Validate performance, reliability, usability and accessibility at feature level.
* Work with Data Engineering colleagues to validate data integrity, completeness, consistency, transformations and customer\-facing analytics outputs.
* Use test results, defect trends, logs and production signals to communicate quality, risk and release readiness.
* Contribute to incident learning, test reviews, retrospectives and improvements to our tools, coverage and processes.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

* Professional experience in QA or software testing within an agile product team.
* Practical experience with exploratory, functional, regression and automated testing.
* Experience creating and maintaining automated tests and integrating them into CI/CD workflows.
* Strong defect investigation, reproduction, triage and root\-cause analysis skills.
* An understanding of test data, test environments, quality metrics and risk\-based coverage.
* Awareness of performance, usability, accessibility, security and reliability considerations.
* Clear communication and confidence working with Engineering, Product, QA and Data stakeholders.
* A customer mindset: you care about whether a feature works for the person using it, not just whether the implementation matches the specification.
* The judgement to use AI and automation to increase coverage and speed while retaining human responsibility for quality.

**Nice to have, but not essential**
-----------------------------------

* Experience testing data\-heavy products, analytics features, reporting workflows or business intelligence experiences.
* Strong SQL and experience validating datasets, transformations, aggregates, completeness, consistency or lineage.
* Experience testing data pipelines, ingestion workflows, event\-driven integrations or cloud data platforms.
* Familiarity with data contracts, semantic layers, warehouse models or tools such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, dbt or ThoughtSpot.
* Experience testing multi\-tenant systems, row\-level security, permissions, PII masking or GDPR\-sensitive workflows.
* Experience helping Engineering teams design for testability and observability.


You don’t need experience with every tool listed above. We’re more interested in your testing judgement, curiosity and ability to learn.

**How you’ll work**
-------------------

* You engage early, rather than waiting for a finished build.
* You automate where it gives reliable value and use exploratory testing where human judgement adds something unique.
* You think like a customer and focus on the journeys and outcomes that matter.
* You are pragmatic about scope: thorough on high\-risk areas without creating low\-value over\-testing.
* You communicate clearly about coverage, uncertainty, defects and release readiness.
* You share knowledge, improve the test suite and raise blockers early so the team can keep moving.

**The impact you’ll make**
--------------------------

* The team gets fast, trustworthy feedback without treating QA as a late\-stage gate.
* High\-risk customer journeys have the right balance of automated and exploratory coverage.
* Releases are made with a clear view of quality, risk and customer impact.
* Data quality issues are found before they become misleading product or analytics experiences.
* We learn from defects, incidents and customer feedback, improving the way we build and test.
* Engineering, Product and Data colleagues see you as a partner who improves delivery.

**The tools and ways of working**
---------------------------------

* Test automation for web, API and service\-level scenarios in a .NET product environment.
* CI/CD\-integrated testing, Git and test reporting or quality dashboards.
* SQL and structured test data, with an interest in validating data flows and transformations.
* Logs, metrics and observability tools for diagnosis and production feedback loops.
* Agile planning, quality discussions, defect management and collaborative release decisions.
* AI\-assisted testing tools used with human review, validation and responsible data handling.

**Why you’ll love it here**
---------------------------

* Competitive salary, dependent on experience.
* Flexible, hybrid working, with collaboration across the team and time to focus when you need it.
* 25 days’ holiday, plus one extra day after three years, and your birthday off.
* UK bank holidays, plus Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve afternoons off.
* Private medical insurance with enhanced mental health, dental and optical coverage via AXA.
* Employee Assistance Programme — support when you need it.
* Life insurance at 2x salary and matched pension contributions of 5%.
* Two volunteer days per year — give back to causes that matter to you.
* Access to Mintago for financial wellbeing, discounts and expert advice.
* Retail discount scheme — perks and savings just for being part of our team.

**The hiring process: let’s make it personal!**
-----------------------------------------------

**Screening call:** A virtual chat with one of our team to learn more about your experience, what excites you about the role and how you align with our people\-first culture.

**Competency interview:** You’ll meet the hiring manager and talk through your approach to quality, automation, risk\-based testing, defect investigation and working with Engineering, Product and Data.

**Final stage interview:** You’ll meet members of the wider team and explore how you would help us improve coverage, release confidence and customer outcomes.

* **RESPONSIBILITY** \- We get involved, bring our perspective, and are always open to new ideas. We take personal responsibility
* **COMMUNITY** \- We value a sense of belonging, trusting each other and encouraging authenticity. We contribute to our community

  

  

**ROLES \& RESPONSIBILITIES*** Design and own backend services that move money and manage multi\-currency balances across a range of domains, including onboarding, KYC and KYB, payment initiation, FX, settlement, and other supporting services.
* Lead cross\-functional delivery with product, compliance, and operations from problem framing through launch.
* Lead the build of the partner integrations and settlement infrastructure your domain depends on.
* Own production health for your domain, including reliability, observability, on\-call, and incident response.
* Lead design reviews, set technical direction for your domain, and mentor mid\-level engineers.
* Use agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) daily across the SDLC, and lead modernization from legacy services into the modern stack alongside architects and team leads in your domain.

* Strong backend proficiency in C\# / .NET preferred; other OOP languages welcome (Java, Kotlin, Go, or equivalent).
* SQL and relational database fundamentals.
* Writing and maintaining tests.
* Daily use of agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) across the SDLC.
* Production experience with AWS, including hands\-on deployment, CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices, and native services such as SQS, DynamoDB, S3, ECS, and Lambda.
* Strong system design and architecture experience, including service\-oriented or microservices and event\-driven patterns.
* Payments, FX, or regulated\-industry experience.
* Track record of technical leadership: mentoring engineers, leading design reviews, and making architecture decisions in your domain.
* Strong written and verbal communication.

**Nice\-to\-have**

* Experience with ledgers, double\-entry accounting, or other financial\-data systems.
* Experience hiring, interviewing, or onboarding engineers.
* Experience leading modernization or platform migrations.
* Experience with caching solutions like Memcached or Redis.
* Experience using project management and documentation tools like Jira and Confluence.
* Knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman or Bruno.
* Writing automated tests alongside development with AI tools (Claude Code or equivalent).

### **PERKS \& BENEFITS**

Maritime Transport is looking for a motivated **Apprentice Full Stack Developer** to join our development team at our **Felixstowe Head Office**. This role will be supplemented with an Apprenticeship in Software Development.


You will work with modern web\-based applications built using C\#, .NET and Angular, gaining hands\-on experience in coding, testing, reviewing, maintaining and researching solutions within an agile, team\-based environment.


Maritime Transport is a strong, growing business with a secure future and a reputation for recognising and rewarding hard work. Based in a modern office environment, our development function plays an important role in supporting key operational systems across the business.


We operate and are legally responsible for more than 4,500 assets across over 40 UK locations, including heavy goods vehicles, trailers, company cars and plant machinery. Our core platforms support the management, maintenance and compliance of these assets throughout their operational and financial lifecycle.


This role would suit someone who is organised, eager to learn, comfortable solving problems and able to think quickly in a fast\-paced business environment.

  

* Competitive salary
* Full training given
* Opportunities to progress

* Clear and confident communication with technical and non\-technical colleagues.

* RabbitMQ or similar messaging technologies.
* AutoMapper or similar mapping tools.

* Full UK driving license.

* A strong team player who enjoys working collaboratively.

You will work towards a recognized Software development qualification, such as a ***Level 4 Software Development*** apprenticeship ***or suitable equivalent***. Dedicated study time will be provided, alongside ongoing mentoring and development support from experienced Developers.


The successful candidate will enjoy a competitive salary and remuneration package and excellent benefits.

Maritime is a family\-owned UK\-based transport company and since its inception in 2001 has grown to be a market\-leader offering container transport and curtain\-sided distribution services. Join a winning team.

jobs.description:
London, Greater London, United Kingdom


€
7,500 \- 9,000

Tech \& Digital

  


**About the Role**


Technology is advancing rapidly—every organization is digitizing, adopting AI, and rethinking how work is done. That shift is exactly what our Product \& Technology Office exists to shape. We're building the platform that will power the future of workforce solutions: world\-leading STEM talent services, managed services, and a growing suite of AI\-enabled products.


As an Enterprise Architect, you'll be responsible for ensuring the coherence of our technology portfolio. Not just one domain, but all of them—business, data, applications, integration, infrastructure, and security—across our proprietary products, third\-party platforms, and enterprise systems. You won't manage people to achieve this; instead, you'll lead through the strength of your architectural standards, your design authority, and your ability to bring engineering, product, and technology teams together toward a shared target state.


Three things will define your first year: scaling our platform for growth, ensuring our products work seamlessly across regions and brands, and designing how AI is safely integrated into what we offer our clients. All of it built with security in mind from day one.


**What You'll Do**


* Define and maintain the target\-state architecture across business, data, application, integration, infrastructure, and security domains—and then keep it up to date as the system evolves.
* Define the architectural principles, standards, and reusable patterns that engineering and product teams actually adopt.
* Maintain a single, integrated technology roadmap that sequences changes, eliminates duplication, and reduces technical debt—while aligning with the domain roadmaps driven by domain leaders.
* Architect for scalability: multi\-tenancy, entity separation, shared services, and the non\-functional standards that allow us to onboard new brands without having to rebuild the platform each time.
* Design how our products function across regions—data residency, localization, currency, regulation—using configurable patterns rather than forked codebases.
* Partner with the VP of Data \& AI to develop reference architectures for AI and agentic capabilities in client\-facing services, covering model access, orchestration, evaluation, and human oversight.
* Embed security, privacy, and resilience into every design from the very beginning, working closely with the Director of Information Security \& Privacy.
* Lead a design authority focused on the decisions that matter—cross\-domain decisions, major programs, exceptions—rather than routine approval.
* Mentor architects and engineers throughout the company, raising the bar for design thinking without needing a direct reporting relationship to do so.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to the CTPO and senior leadership, and represent our architecture to clients, partners, and auditors in situations where it is contractually relevant.

**Nice to have**


* Experience in HR tech, staffing, or a comparable regulated, multi\-entity service business.
* Familiarity with recognized assurance and control frameworks used in supplier or client audits.
* Experience leading or contributing to a formal architecture design authority or governance board.

**Why Join Us**


You'll help build the technical backbone of a truly international, rapidly scaling HR tech company—not from the sidelines, but as the person responsible for ensuring everything fits together. If you're looking for architecture work with real commercial impact and the autonomy to drive it through expertise rather than hierarchy, this is the role for you.

  

#### **Here's what we offer you**


Salary that matches your experience
  

You will receive a salary range that matches your knowledge and experience. We reward you fairly for your commitment and development.
Vacation pay and days off
  

You will receive 8\.33% vacation pay and are entitled to 27 vacation days per year based on full\-time employment. This gives you plenty of time to recharge your batteries.
Hybrid working
  

We support hybrid working and apply a 60/40 split, whereby full\-time employees spend three days at the office and two days working from home.
Premium\-freepension
  

We pay your entire pension premium. This means you accrue pension without having to contribute to it yourself. As a result, you are left with a higher net salary.
Performancebonus
  

Depending on your performance and that of HeadFirst Group, you may receive an annual bonus of one or two months' salary.
Monthly extras
  

You will receive a monthly allowance for internet, a vitality budget, a contribution towards lunch, and support in setting up your home office.
#### **What we expect from you**


**What You'll Bring**


* Proven experience as an Enterprise Architect (or in an equivalent senior architecture role) across the domains of business, data, applications, integration, infrastructure, and security—not just a single area of expertise.
* A track record of leading through influence and technical expertise rather than formal management—and getting engineering and product teams genuinely aligned with a target state.
* Experience in designing multi\-region, multi\-brand, or multi\-tenant products, including practical patterns for localization and regulatory variations.
* A hands\-on understanding of how to responsibly integrate AI and agentic capabilities into products—including data governance, evaluation, and human oversight, not just the technology itself.
* A "security\-by\-design" mindset, comfortable working alongside information security and privacy functions rather than treating them as a final gate.
* Strong communication skills — able to clearly explain architectural trade\-offs to both engineers and executives.

jobs.description:
**.buttontext6d0b46980d8b0627 a{ border:** 1px solid transparent; } .buttontext6d0b46980d8b0627 a: focus{ border: 1px dashed \#16726d !important; outline: none !important; }
  
  

Research Software Engineer
  
**Requisition ID:** 29757
  
  

**Location:**  

Newcastle, GB
  
  

**\#job\-location.job\-location\-inline { display:** inline; }
  
**Contract Type:** Fixed Term
  
**Working Pattern:** Full Time
  
**Posted Date:** 14 Sept 2026
  
**.buttontext5b73eb8ce7144827 a{ border:** 1px solid transparent; } .buttontext5b73eb8ce7144827 a: focus{ border: 1px dashed \#16726d !important; outline: none !important; }
  
  

**Salary:** £36,636 \- £37,694 per annum
  
  

Newcastle University is a great place to work, with excellent benefits. We have a generous holiday package; plus the opportunity to buy more, great pension schemes and a number of health and wellbeing initiatives to support you.
  
  

**Closing Date:** 27 September 2026
  
  

The Role
  
  

We are delighted to be seeking a motivated individual to join the School of Computing at Newcastle University. The postholder will work on an EPSRC\-funded project, providing specialist software\-development and systems\-integration expertise to develop and deploy a decision\-grade Digital Product Passport (DPP) platform for buildings.
  
  

The project will integrate Newcastle University’s Digital Product Passport infrastructure with Cardiff University’s digital\-twin and energy\-analytics work, using real project data and partner workflows to support better retrofit and net\-zero decisions. The DPP platform will provide trusted and reusable information about building materials and components, including their provenance, condition and reuse potential, and make this information available to digital\-twin and analytics systems.
  
  

You will implement, integrate, test and deploy the DPP platform and its supporting technical infrastructure. This will include developing data structures and semantic models, provenance and data\-quality mechanisms, APIs and integration interfaces, and supporting secure deployment, testing and technical validation.
  
  

The successful applicant will possess excellent technical, communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to develop reliable software systems and solve complex systems\-integration problems. They should be self\-motivated, capable of managing their own technical activities, and able to work effectively with academic researchers, public\-sector stakeholders and industry partners.
  
  

This post is available from 1 October 2026 on a full\-time, fixed\-term basis for 12 months. Some travel to partner sites and project meetings in Wales will be required.
  
  

For all informal enquiries, please contact Dr Ellis Solaiman (ellis.solaiman@ncl.ac.uk).
  
  

Key Accountabilities
  
  

Implement and deploy the Digital Product Passport prototype and supporting technical infrastructure for the project
  
Develop and maintain data structures and semantic models that support consistent interpretation of material and building information across organisations and systems
  
Implement provenance, data\-quality and trust mechanisms so that evidence can be traced, checked and relied upon across project handovers
  
Develop and maintain APIs, data contracts and other integration interfaces so that the DPP can exchange information reliably with digital\-twin and analytics systems
  
Support secure deployment, configuration, testing, debugging and operation of the demonstrator, including cloud\-based components where appropriate
  
Populate and technically validate Digital Product Passports using real partner data, including project records, BIM and supply\-chain information
  
Work with academic, industrial and public\-sector partners to translate agreed technical requirements into working software and integration solutions
  
Support technical evaluation of data quality, interoperability, provenance robustness, integration performance and deployment readiness
  
Produce clear technical documentation, reference architecture material, deployment guidance and reusable software and tooling to support replication and wider adoption
  
Contribute to project demonstrations, technical workshops and delivery milestones as required
  
  

The Person (Essential)
  
  

Knowledge, Skills and Experience
  
  

Strong practical software\-development experience, with the ability to design, implement, test and maintain reliable software systems
  
Experience developing data\-centric, distributed or integrated software systems
  
Experience with data modelling, interoperability, metadata, semantic technologies, knowledge graphs or closely related approaches
  
Experience implementing system interfaces such as APIs and working with structured data exchanged between different software systems
  
Understanding of data provenance, data quality, security, auditability or trusted\-data mechanisms
  
Good programming skills in one or more relevant programming languages
  
Attention to detail and ability to work at high levels of accuracy
  
Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the initiative and creativity to resolve technical challenges effectively.
  
Ability to present complex technical information effectively to a range of audiences
  
Ability to work with colleagues and external partners and to translate technical requirements into implemented solutions.
  
  

Desirable
  
  

Experience with Digital Product Passports, digital twins, BIM, construction data, circular\-economy systems or supply\-chain data
  
Experience with ontology\-based or semantic\-web technologies and machine\-readable data standards
  
Experience with auditable provenance technologies, including blockchain or distributed\-ledger approaches
  
Experience with secure cloud deployment, distributed systems or production\-style research software infrastructure
  
Experience integrating software with external analytics, decision\-support or energy\-performance systems
  
  

Attributes and Behaviour
  
  

Commitment to working positively as a member of a multi\-skilled project team
  
Ability to negotiate and prioritise multiple, competing responsibilities and to work to deadlines
  
A practical and solution\-focused approach to software development and systems integration
  
Commitment to producing reliable and maintainable software and technical documentation
  
Ability to work constructively with academic, industry and public\-sector partners
  
Commitment to continued professional development
  
Support the University’s core values and demonstrate the ability to implement these within your role or department
  
  

Qualifications
  
  

MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience
  
  

Newcastle University is a global University where everyone is treated with dignity and respect. As a University of Sanctuary, we aim to provide a welcoming place of safety for all, offering opportunities to people fleeing violence and persecution.
  
  

We are committed to being a fully inclusive university which actively recruits, supports and retains colleagues from all sectors of society. We value diversity as well as celebrate, support and thrive on the contributions of all of our employees and the communities they represent. We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer and encourage applications from individuals who can complement our existing teams, we believe that success is built on having teams whose backgrounds and experiences reflect the diversity of our university and student population.
  
  

At Newcastle University we hold a Gold Athena Swan award in recognition of our good employment practices for the advancement of gender equality. We also hold a Race Equality Charter Bronze award in recognition of our work towards tackling race inequality in higher education REC. We are a Disability Confident employer and will offer an interview to disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria for the role as part of the offer and interview scheme.
  
  

In addition, we are a member of the Euraxess initiative supporting researchers in Europe.
  
  

**Requisition ID:** 29757

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Our priority is to match the right person to the right role, and we never want salary to be a barrier to applying. Regardless of your current pay, we’ll ask about your salary expectations during the application process, and our Talent Team will have an open, honest conversation during the talent call to understand your skills and explore our salary options. If you have questions around salary, please feel free to ask us!

 **Location**: Chiswick, London \- Hybrid

**Sponsorship:** We are unable to offer sponsorship for this role

### **The Role**

  

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will play a key role in the development and maintenance of our data infrastructure, ensuring efficient and scalable data pipelines.


You will be responsible for hands\-on implementation and optimization of data systems on the Google Cloud Platform (GCP), contributing to critical projects while mentoring junior Engineers.


This role focuses on delivering technical solutions, applying best practices, and driving innovation within the data engineering team.

### **Why So Energy?**


So Energy was created in 2015 because we knew energy suppliers could be **better**. Since then, we’ve grown rapidly but sustainably, with 300,000 customers and over 450 Energists (what we call our people). But we’re not done! We’re on the road to a net\-zero future, and thanks to our partnership with ESB, we’re well on the way. We’re customer\-centric, tech\-led, and passionate about sustainability.


We’re driven to do our best for our customers, for each other, and for our planet. That’s why we’ve built a workplace culture that’s supportive, empowering, inclusive, and full of opportunities to grow and make an impact.


At So Energy, we take pride in our values\-driven culture. We live and breathe by our **six core** **values** that guide everything we do:

* **Clear**
* **Honest**
* **Ambitious**
* **Inquisitive**
* **Caring**
* **Sustainable**

### **What you’ll be getting up to in this role:**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines using modern data engineering tools and technologies on our GCP stack.
* Build and optimize our lake house on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Implement data ingestion, transformation, and loading processes for various data sources (e.g., databases, APIs, cloud storage).
* Ensure data quality, consistency, and security throughout the data pipeline.
* Leverage GCP services (e.g., Dataflow, Dataproc, BigQuery, Cloud Storage) to build and maintain cloud\-native data solutions.
* Implement infrastructure as code (IaC) principles using Terraform to automate provisioning and configuration.
* Manage and optimize cloud resources to ensure cost\-efficiency and performance.
* Design and implement efficient data models following a star schema approach to support analytical and operational workloads.
* Collaborate with data analysts to develop advanced analytics solutions.
* Conduct data quality analysis to drive better data management on outputs in our Curated Layer.
* Mentor junior data engineers and provide technical guidance.
* Contribute to the development of data engineering best practices and standards.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver complex data projects.

### **You’re a great match if:**

**Technical Skills**

* You're an expert in GCP services including BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Composer, Cloud Storage, and Cloud Functions. GCP Professional Data Engineer Certification is highly favourable.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL for complex data transformation and query optimization.
* Proven experience in Python for scalable data pipeline development and orchestration following best practices.
* Experience implementing Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to automate GCP resource management.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment practices.
* Experience with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
* Experience building and optimizing batch and streaming data pipelines.
* Understanding of data governance principles, GCP security (IAM, VPC), and compliance requirements.

**Soft Skills**

* Demonstrates a growth mindset by actively seeking to learn from peers and stakeholders, fostering a culture of open communication and shared knowledge.
* Works effectively across teams, including Data Science, Engineering, and Analytics, to understand their needs and deliver impactful data solutions.
* Actively participates in design discussions, brainstorming sessions, and cross\-functional projects, always striving for continuous improvement and innovation.
* Builds strong relationships across the organization, using empathy and active listening to ensure alignment on goals and deliverables.
* Approaches challenges with a growth mindset, viewing obstacles as opportunities to innovate and improve processes.
* Applies a structured and analytical approach to solving complex problems, balancing immediate needs with long\-term scalability and efficiency.
* Demonstrates resilience under pressure, maintaining a positive and solution\-focused attitude when faced with tight deadlines or ambiguity.
* Actively seeks feedback and lessons learned from past projects to continuously refine problem\-solving strategies and improve outcomes.
* Shares expertise generously, guiding team members in adopting best practices and helping them overcome technical challenges.
* Leads by example, demonstrating how to approach complex problems pragmatically while promoting curiosity and a willingness to explore new tools and technologies.
* Encourages professional development within the team, supporting individuals in achieving their career goals and obtaining certifications, especially within the Google Cloud ecosystem.


Research shows that some underrepresented people are less likely to apply for a role unless they are 100% qualified. We believe your experience, skills, and passion will set you apart. We encourage you to apply and tell us about your journey, even if you don’t tick all the boxes.

### **What’s in it for you?**

##### **Smart Working Charters:**

* **Hybrid Working** – Every team has its own SPARK Working Charter. Ask your Talent Partner for more details.

##### **Growth \& Development**

* **Dedicated Learning \& Development Team** – Supporting your development through workshops, coaching and learning opportunities.
* **Learning Platform** – Access thousands of learning resources to help you build new skills and support your career development.
* **Educational Sponsorships** – Supporting professional development through initiatives such as Code First Girls.

##### **Pay \& Reward**

* **Up to 10% Performance Bonus** – Based on both company and personal performance.
* **Annual Salary Reviews** – Helping ensure we remain competitive in the market.
* **Real Living Wage Employer** – Proud to be an accredited Real Living Wage employer.

##### **Time Off That Matters**

* **Your Birthday Off** – Because birthdays should be celebrated.
* **Three So Giving Days** – Paid time to support a cause that's important to you.
* **Enhanced Family Leave** – Supporting you through every stage of family life.

##### **Health \& Wellbeing**

* **Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)** – Confidential support available 24/7, 365 days a year, including access to professional guidance and structured counselling support.
* **Wellbeing Resources via Perkbox** – Access a range of wellbeing articles, tools and guidance, alongside employee perks and discounts, all in one place.
* **Physical Wellbeing** – Free eye tests and annual flu vaccinations.
* **Menopause Policy** – Providing support and guidance for colleagues experiencing menopause.

##### **Belonging \& Recognition**

jobs.title: Senior Identity and Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

At Aberdeen, our ambition is to be the UK’s leading Wealth \& Investments group.


Strengthening talent and culture is one of our strategic priorities. We strive to make Aberdeen a great place to work so that we can attract and retain the industry’s best talent.


Our people put our stakeholders at the heart of everything they do by helping us to make a positive difference to the lives of our clients, customers, colleagues, shareholders, and society.


We are focused on growing our direct and advised wealth platforms and repositioning our specialist asset management business to meet client demand. We are committed to providing excellent client service, supported by leading technology and talent.


Aberdeen comprises three businesses, interactive investor (ii), Investments, and Adviser, each of which focuses on meeting and adapting to our clients’ evolving needs:

* interactive investor, the UK’s second largest direct\-to\-consumer investment platform, enables individuals in the UK to plan, save, and invest in the way that works for them.
* Our Adviser business provides financial planning solutions and technology for UK financial advisers, enabling them to create value for their customers.
* Our Investments business is a specialist asset manager that focuses on areas where we have both strength and scale to capitalise on the key themes shaping the market, through either public markets or alternative asset classes.
**About the Department**


Digital Engineering delivers the platforms, applications and services that power customer and colleague experiences across Aberdeen. Working closely with product, security and business teams, the department modernises technology, strengthens resilience and supports innovation. The team promotes collaboration, continuous improvement and engineering excellence, helping enable our clients to be better investors.

**About the Role**


We are looking for a Senior Identity \& Full\-Stack Engineer to take technical ownership of our customer\-facing identity platform while contributing to application, API and cloud engineering initiatives. Based in Edinburgh, this permanent opportunity combines identity platform leadership with hands\-on software engineering across Microsoft Azure and modern digital technologies. You will play a key role in improving security, reliability, automation and user experience across our digital estate. This is an opportunity to shape critical services, influence engineering standards and continue developing your expertise in a collaborative environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and evolve Aberdeen’s customer\-facing Identity Provider (IDP) and IDaaS platform, ensuring reliability, security and continuous improvement.
* Design and implement authentication, SSO, federation, user lifecycle and access governance solutions using OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, SAML and SCIM.
* Build and support cloud\-native applications, APIs and integrations on Microsoft Azure, taking solutions from design through to production support.
* Drive automation and engineering excellence through Terraform, GitHub, CI/CD pipelines and scripting tools.
* Troubleshoot complex incidents, perform root\-cause analysis and strengthen operational resilience across digital services.
* Mentor engineers and contribute to technical leadership, standards and best practices across Digital Engineering.
**About the Candidate**

**Essential skills and experience:**

* Experience operating and supporting Identity Provider or Identity\-as\-a\-Service platforms, ideally Okta but other Identity platforms will be considered.
* Strong knowledge of OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, SAML, SSO, MFA and identity security controls.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Azure, identity integration and cloud\-native services.
* Strong software engineering capability across C\# .NET APIs, backend services and secure integrations.
* Experience with Terraform, GitHub, CI/CD automation and scripting tools.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to collaborate, mentor and support colleagues.
**Desirable:** Okta administration, SCIM provisioning, access governance, GraphQL, Playwright, TypeScript, Terraform\-based infrastructure provisioning, AI\-assisted engineering tools and regulated financial services experience.


We are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you have a disability and would like to apply to one of our UK roles under the Disability Confident Scheme, please notify us by completing the relevant section in our candidate questionnaire. One of our team will reach out to support you through your application process.

**Our benefits**


There's more to working life than coming home with a good salary. We have an environment where you can learn, get involved and be supported.


When you join us, your reward will be one of the best around. This includes 40 days’ annual leave, a 16% employer pension contribution, a discretionary performance\-based bonus (where applicable), private healthcare and a range of flexible benefits – including gym discounts, season ticket loans and access to an employee discount portal. You can read more about our benefits here.

**Our business**


Enabling our clients to be better investors drives everything we do. Our business is structured around three distinct areas – our vectors of growth – focused on our clients’ changing needs. You can find out more about what we do here.

**An inclusive way of working**


Whatever way you like to work, if you have the talent and commitment to join our team, we’d like to hear from you.


At Aberdeen we’ve adopted a ‘blended working’ approach. This approach combines the benefits of face\-to\-face collaboration, coaching and connecting in our offices with the flexibility of working from home. It enables colleagues to find a balance that works for their roles, their teams, our clients and our business.


An inclusive culture, where diverse perspectives drive our actions, is at the core of who we are and what we do. If you need assistance with your application, or a reasonable adjustment to your interview arrangements – for example, because you are neurodivergent, or have a physical, sensory, cognitive, mental, visible or invisible disability – please let us know and we’ll be happy to help.

**We’re committed to providing an inclusive workplace where all forms of difference are valued and which is free from any form of unfair or unlawful treatment. We define diversity in its broadest sense – this includes but is not limited to our diversity of educational and professional backgrounds, experience, cognitive and neurodiversity, age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion or belief and ethnicity and geographical provenance. We support a culture that values meritocracy, fairness and transparency and welcomes enquiries from everyone.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**If you need assistance or an adjustment due to a disability please let us know as part of your application and we will assist.**

jobs.title: Asset Engineer
jobs.description:
Team
**Engineering**
Business Unit
**National Grid Ventures**
Requisition No.
**5404**
City
**Ashford, GB, TN25 6AF**
Date posted
**13 September 2026**  

**Asset Engineer**
==================


### **About the role**


National Grid Ventures Interconnectors is playing a critical role in connecting the UK's energy system with neighbouring countries, helping to deliver a more secure, resilient and low\-carbon energy future. Through our portfolio of High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) interconnectors, we enable the import and export of electricity, supporting the UK's transition to net zero while developing the infrastructure needed to meet future energy demands.


We're looking for an **Asset Engineer** to join our Asset \& Engineering team. In this role, you'll be responsible for the effective management, performance and maintenance of critical interconnector assets, helping to ensure exceptional levels of reliability, availability and operational resilience across our portfolio.


Working closely with site\-based and central teams, you'll use your technical expertise to develop asset strategies, drive maintenance excellence, improve asset health and support continuous improvement initiatives. You'll play a key role in ensuring our assets perform safely, efficiently and in line with all regulatory and operational requirements.


This position is based at our IFA1 site in Sellindge so candidates would be ideally be based within a hours commute.


### **What you'll do**


As an Asset Engineer, you will:


* Deliver asset health assessments and asset management activities in line with National Grid policies and standards.
* Develop and implement asset maintenance strategies to maximise asset performance, reliability and lifespan.
* Translate OEM technical guidance and engineering standards into practical maintenance plans, work instructions and Maximo task lists.
* Produce and manage maintenance plans and outage scopes to ensure maintenance activities are completed safely and effectively.
* Support the management of asset defects, equipment failures and technical investigations, identifying root causes and implementing corrective actions.
* Analyse asset performance data and provide recommendations to improve reliability and operational efficiency.
* Work collaboratively with site operations teams, engineering specialists and external partners to drive best practice across the interconnector portfolio.
* Coordinate with Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) on warranty, performance and asset integrity matters.
* Maintain accurate asset records and support continual improvement of asset data within Maximo.
* Promote a strong culture of safety, compliance and continuous improvement across all engineering activities.
### **What you'll need**


* Experience in engineering and asset management, ideally within the utilities, energy, infrastructure or industrial sectors.
* Strong understanding of asset management principles and maintenance strategies.
* Knowledge of high\-voltage electrical systems or other critical infrastructure assets.
* Ability to interpret technical documentation, engineering drawings and OEM manuals.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to make informed technical decisions.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience using asset management systems such as Maximo or similar platforms.
* Understanding of risk management processes and regulatory compliance requirements.
* A proactive approach to continuous improvement and operational excellence.
* HNC in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent).
* Full UK Driving Licence.
### **What you'll get**


A competitive salary between **£47,442\.00 \- £56,173\.50 per annum**– dependent on capability.

  

  

As well as your base salary, you will receive a bonus based on personal and company performance and a competitive contributory pension scheme where we will double match your contribution to a maximum company contribution of 12%. You will also have access to a number of flexible benefits such as a share incentive plan, salary sacrifice car and technology schemes, support via employee assistance lines and matched charity giving to name a few.

  

This role closes on **28th September at 23:59**, however we encourage candidates to submit their application as early as possible and not wait until the published closing date as this can vary.


We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace for all. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates – we make appointments purely on merit, assessed against objective selection criteria. We support flexible working and will make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process should you have any physical or mental impairment which may affect your ability to participate in the process.


Please note that in most cases, National Grid is unable to offer sponsorship for employment under the UK points\-based immigration system. As such, applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK without requiring sponsorship now or in the future under the UK points\-based immigration system. However, in exceptional circumstances where there is a clear and demonstrable need for specialist skills that cannot be sourced from the local labour market, National Grid may consider offering sponsorship. All applications are welcome from candidates who meet these requirements, regardless of race, nationality, or ethnic origin.

jobs.title: Software Developer | Energy Trading Operations
jobs.description:
**About Marex**

Marex Group plc (NASDAQ: MRX) is a diversified global financial services platform providing essential liquidity, market access and infrastructure services to clients across energy, commodities and financial markets. The group provides comprehensive breadth and depth of coverage across four core services: clearing, agency and execution, market making, and hedging and investment solutions. It has a leading franchise in many major metals, energy and agricultural products, with access to 60 exchanges. The group provides access to the world's major commodity markets, covering a broad range of clients that include some of the largest commodity producers, consumers and traders, banks, hedge funds and asset managers. With more than 40 offices worldwide, the group has over 3,000 employees across Europe, Asia and the Americas.


For more information visit https://www.marex.com/


Vacancy Number: VN3065 \& VN3127


**Department description**

Marex has unique access across markets with significant share globally both on and off exchange. The depth of knowledge amongst its teams and divisions provides its customers with clear advantage, and its technology\-led service provides access to all major exchanges, order\-flow management via screen, voice and DMA, plus award\-winning data, insights, and analytics.


This role sits within the Technology department reporting to the Global IT Service Manager. Technology is central to the success of our organisation. The 290\+ strong global Technology Department and delivers differentiation, scalability and security for the business. Technology provides digital tools, software services and infrastructure globally to all business groups. Software development and application support teams work in agile ‘streams' aligned to specific business areas. Our other teams work enterprise\-wide to provide critical services including our global service desk, network and system infrastructure, IT operations, design, enterprise architecture and information security.


The Software Development function creates and maintains applications, frameworks and other software components to deliver to business requirements. Developers conceive, specify, design, engineer, document, test, and deliver bug fixes as needed to provide high quality software solutions. Each Development team is aligned to one of Marex's business divisions and works for that division under Head of Technology and corresponding Application Support team.


**Role Summary**


As a Software Developer specializing in C\# .NET or React, you will be a pivotal member of our Software Development team, contributing to the creation and enhancement of secure, responsive web applications tailored for front\-to\-back trading technology. Your expertise in C\# .NET or React and your strong emphasis on testing will be instrumental in delivering robust and reliable applications. In this role, you will use your architectural experience to help mature our existing software and efficiently migrate legacy platforms to the cloud, working closely with the platform engineering team to ensure seamless integration and deployment.


**Responsibilities**


***Role specific:***


* Design, code and test all components of modern web applications.
* Contribute to the overall architecture and design of the technology created/maintained by the development delivery team.
* Develop solutions to a high standard that is maintainable, testable and meets the requirement's acceptance criteria.
* Adhere to development best practices and processes.
* Communicate with team members, introduce ideas and keep abreast of the latest technologies.
* Liaise with business users to gather application requirements.
* Ensure delivered systems are of production quality. Ensure software is adequately documented for handover to the business.
* Follow coding standards and defined development process.
* Resolve third line support issues in a professional and timely manner.
* Be pragmatic \& delivery focused.
* Ensure solutions are not over engineered, always lean towards simplicity over unnecessary complexity


***All staff:***


* Ensuring compliance with the company's regulatory requirements under the FCA, NFA, AMF, AFM, MAS.
* Adhere to the operational risk framework for your role ensuring that all regulatory or company determined parameters are complied with.
* Role model for demonstrating highest level standards of integrity and conduct and reflecting Company Values.
* At all times complying with the FCA's Code of Conduct
* To ensure that you are fully aware of and adhere to internal policies that relate to you, your role or any other activities for which you have any level of responsibility
* To report any breaches of policy to Compliance and/ or your supervisor as required
* To escalate risk events immediately
* To provide input to risk management processes, as required.

***Competencies, Skills, Experience \& Qualifications:***


**Skills and Experience:**

**Essential:**


* Experience in C\# .NET, React/Angular, JavaScript, Typescript
* Experience of NoSQL or RDMS databases
* Infrastructure as Code, Terraform or equivalent
* Modern CI/CD and DevOps practices
* Cloud technology, ideally AWS (Amazon Web Services)
* Knowledge of BDD/TDD
* Agile and scrum development methodologies
* Methodical approach to software architecture and design, and employing the right design choices for a given project
* Enforcing engineering standards using SOLID, GoF patterns
* Applying best practices for security, scalability, resiliency and performance
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills


**Desirable:**

* Docker, Kubernetes, Messaging frameworks
* Event\-driven or streaming architectures
* Observability
* Working in a regulated environment and knowledge of the financial markets
* Understanding of commodities trading concepts


**Competencies:**


* A collaborative team player, approachable, self\-efficient and influences a positive work environment
* Demonstrates curiosity
* Resilient in a challenging, fast\-paced environment
* Excels at building relationships, networking and influencing others
* Strategic collaborator with insight and agility, able to anticipate future challenges, ensuring operational effectiveness


**Conduct Rules****,** You must:


* Act with integrity
* Act with due skill, care and diligence
* Be open and cooperative with the FCA, the PRA and other regulators
* Pay due regard to the interests of customers and treat them fairly
* Observe proper standard of market conduct
* Act to deliver good outcomes for retail customers


**Company Values**

**Be collaborative** \- by working together across the organisation, we foster teamwork, can better respond to challenges and successfully deliver for our clients


**Act with integrity** \- we pride ourselves on our honesty and high ethical standards. We apply these values when working with all our clients, colleagues and other stakeholders


**Be adaptable and entrepreneurial** \- we embrace change as markets evolve to constantly increase our efficiency and create innovative solutions for our clients. We are interested in the world around us and inquisitive about understanding the challenges and opportunities our clients face.


**Be respectful** – how we treat each other, and our clients says everything about who we are. We always act respectfully and treat people fairly in everything we do.


**Nurture talent** – we aim to grow our own talent and make Marex the place ambitious, hardworking and talented people choose to build their career. This means giving and taking stretch opportunities, taking risks, and committing to career development and support – for ourselves, and our teams.


Marex is fully committed to being an inclusive employer and providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process for all. We will provide reasonable adjustments to remove any disadvantage to you being considered for this role. We value the differences that a diverse workforce brings to the company. We welcome applications from candidates returning to the workforce. Also, Marex is committed to avoiding circumstances in which the appearance or possibility of conflicts of interest may exist within the hiring process.


If you would like to receive any information in a different way or would like us to do anything differently to help you, please include it in your application.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer - Open Banking Europe
jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior Engineer \- Open Banking Europe
Overview:  

Software engineers working on Mastercard’s Open Banking platform play a key role in the development and maintenance of the products that secure high quality connectivity to banks across Europe. Building on the strong foundation of our state\-of\-the\-art bank connectivity APIs, the engineers create turn\-key solutions that take the burden of handling account information and payment initiation services from customers that want to spend their efforts building great products that leverage the full potential of the Open Banking standard.  

  

Role:  

Open Banking engineers work at the bleeding edge of the account information and payment initiation technologies, often solving problems that are yet to be tackled within the industry in areas of API security, data accessibility, processing, and analysis. You will be joining a group of highly skilled individuals working together as a team to push the limits of what is possible to achieve with open banking.  

  

You will have many colleagues around different countries, with your nearest peers being located primarily in Denmark, Ireland and Poland.  

  

About you:  

We are looking for motivated individuals that are looking to be a part of an established team comprised of both industry veterans as well as newcomers. What they all have in common is the understanding that in order to achieve great things, being able to work together as a team is a must.  

You will be spending most of your time in the Microsoft domain, meaning APIs built in C\# with .NET (latest version) and ASP.NET deployed to the cloud (Azure, AWS). Deep knowledge of at least some of these areas is a requirement. However, we believe that learning is a part of the job, so if you for example have extensive experience building ASP.NET apps, but not in the cloud, do not hesitate to apply regardless.  

  

Beyond that, it is expected that you have experience building software using modern development standards, meaning it should not come as a surprise that we utilise all the tools at our disposal from standard ticketing systems (Azure DevOps), VCS, test automation, to CI/CD pipelines.  

Additionally, if you have experience with provisioning infrastructure as code (Terraform) as well as interest in computer security (Certificates, HTTPS) it would be a great benefit. Prior experience from working in closely regulated industries (financial, medical, etc.) is welcome, but not required.  

  

And above all, we hope that you love solving problems!**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: Java Software Engineer (AWS)
jobs.description:
HL Tech is the technology hub of Hargreaves Lansdown, a privately owned UK financial services group trusted by approximately 2 million clients and supporting more than £172 billion in savings and investments.


We are part of HL's product and engineering organisation, not an outsourcing company or shared service centre. Our teams in Poland and the UK jointly design, build and run the platforms used by HL clients.


You will join Trade Execution, the team responsible for systems connecting clients with financial markets, including trade routing, order execution and broker integrations. The role combines new development with the modernisation and support of established trading components.


#### **General information**


* Possible work locations:
remote/hybrid
* Salary gross (CoE):
13 700 – 19 500 PLN
* Salary net (B2B):
15 000 – 21 500 PLN
* Remote:
Anywhere in Poland, with access to our Warsaw office at WeWork Mennica Tower, Prosta 20 (your choice)
* Stack:
Java, Spring Boot, AWS, Kubernetes, REST APIs and microservices
* Team:
Trading \| Trade Execution
* Languages
English C1 \| Polish B2
* All work must be performed from Poland. Occasional office visits may be requested depending on team collaboration needs.
#### **What makes this role different?**


* Your work directly supports trade routing and execution for millions of investors.
* Own services end\-to\-end, from design and implementation through deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement.
* Work with distributed, highly available and event\-driven systems where reliability and observability matter.
* Contribute to technical decisions, service boundaries and implementation approaches, not just feature delivery.
* Help modernise an established trading platform while building new functionality.
* Work directly on HL products in a collaborative Poland\-UK engineering team.


We are looking for engineers who take ownership beyond delivery, enjoy solving production problems and care about reliability as much as they care about building new features.


#### **Technology**


* Java \| Spring Boot \| AWS
* REST APIs \| Microservices
* Kubernetes \| ECS \| EKS
* S3 \| SQS \| SNS \| Lambda
* CI/CD \| Trunk\-Based Development
* Observability \| Automated Testing

#### **What you will do**


* Build and improve backend services using Java and Spring Boot
* Design and implement REST APIs and multi\-service flows
* Develop and operate cloud services in AWS
* Write secure, maintainable and testable code, supported by automated unit, integration and end\-to\-end tests
* Support business\-critical production systems and investigate incidents
* Use metrics, tracing, logging and monitoring to improve reliability and observability
* Contribute to solution design, technical discussions and code reviews
* Collaborate with Product and engineering colleagues across Poland and the UK to design, build and improve trading services
#### **Requirements**


**Must\-have**


* Strong commercial experience building backend applications in Java using Spring Boot
* Practical AWS experience gained in production environments
* Experience designing and integrating REST APIs and microservices
* Experience owning services in production, including monitoring, incident investigation and reliability improvements
* Experience working with distributed, event\-driven or highly available systems
* Understanding of observability practices, including metrics, tracing, logging and monitoring
* Understanding of testing, maintainability, security and engineering best practices
* Experience with containers and Kubernetes
* English at C1 level and Polish at B2 level or higher


**Nice\-to\-have**


* Financial services, investment or trading systems experience
* JPA or Hibernate
* Terraform or other Infrastructure as Code tools
* Exposure to TypeScript, Node.js or React
#### **Benefits**


* Annual bonus
* 50% tax relief for qualifying creative work under a Contract of Employment
* PPE with a 4% HL contribution and no required employee contribution
* Private healthcare and life insurance
* MyBenefit cafeteria
* Two additional volunteering days
* Training and development opportunities
* Buddy Programme


**Read more about our benefits**

#### **Equal opportunities**


We are an inclusive employer that values diversity in our workforce. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and are committed to fair and equitable hiring practices. Recruitment decisions are based on the skills and experience relevant to the role.

jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

To create revolutionary, story\-driven RPGs which go straight to the hearts of gamers — this is our mission. Want to dive deeper into our company’s culture? Explore our social media and check out our YouTube channel and Beyond the Game Blog where we share behind\-the\-scenes insights and stories direct from our team members!

 **Job Description**  

Join CD PROJEKT RED and help shape the future of QA Engineering across our projects and Shared Development Services initiatives. We’re looking for a **Senior QA Engineer** to help build and scale technical quality solutions, automation frameworks and testing infrastructure used across multiple Unreal Engine projects.


You will be part of the QA Engineering team within Shared Development Services (SDS) \- a shared technical group focused on improving quality, testability and development workflows through automation, reusable tooling and standardized testing platforms.


While the priority for this role will initially be supporting the development of Witcher 4 this is not a project\-dedicated position. Your work will contribute to long\-term cross\-project QA Engineering solutions and shared technical capabilities used across the studio.


This is an opportunity to join at the early stages of a highly innovative game and play a key role in shaping scalable QA engineering practices from the ground up. You will work closely with development teams to build and maintain automated testing solutions, testing environments and shared technical tooling supporting multiple teams and gameplay systems.

**Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with Engineering, Tech Art, Art, QA, DevOps, and central development services teams to support integration and deployment of automated testing solutions, shared tooling, and testing environments across projects.
* Design, develop, maintain, and extend automated test frameworks and testing infrastructure for Unreal Engine systems and reusable gameplay modules.
* Support migration, integration, and validation of shared automation solutions between different projects and development environments.
* Investigate, debug, and resolve technical issues related to automation, integrations, testing environments, CI/CD pipelines, and build infrastructure.
* Participate in the code review process and contribute to maintaining high engineering standards across QA automation codebases.
* Work closely with development teams to improve testability, reliability, scalability, and long\-term maintainability of shared systems.
* Proactively monitor and maintain CI/CD pipelines, ensuring rapid identification and resolution of build and test failures.

 **Qualifications*** 4\+ years of experience in QA Engineering, test automation, or software testing, preferably within the gaming industry.
* C\+\+ experience, especially within Unreal Engine environments.
* Knowledge of working with automated testing, tooling, and testing infrastructure in Unreal Engine environments.
* Experience developing and maintaining automated test frameworks and testing solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze, debug, and troubleshoot complex technical issues across systems, integrations, and development environments.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple disciplines and teams.
* Comfortable owning tasks and asking for input when needed with a strong sense of curiosity toward solving technical challenges.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience shipping an Unreal Engine\-based game for Xbox or PlayStation consoles.
* Prior experience with Unreal Engine, or a very strong understanding of Unreal from the development side, not limited to automated test work.
* Experience with containerization and cloud technologies (e.g., Docker, AWS, GCP).
* Experience with programming and scripting skills using languages such as Python, TypeScript or C\#.
* Experience with performance profiling, debugging or validation tooling within Unreal Engine environments.
* Experience with asset processing and validation pipelines, digital content authoring tools, or other proprietary game engine tools.
* Experience supporting shared tooling, reusable systems, or cross\-project technical initiatives.
* Experience working with CI/CD systems and automation pipelines.

 **Additional Information** **Working mode**


In\-office in a hybrid or full\-time capacity in Warsaw, Poland.

**Health \& Well\-Being**

* Private medical healthcare — a selection of medical plans with dental care and unlimited rehabilitation to choose from, which are also accessible for your partner and relatives.
* Life insurance — comprehensive pension and insurance plans to protect you and your loved ones.
* Annual screenings for cancer prevention covered by the company.
* Psychological and psychiatrist care — free mental health support and various well\-being initiatives.
* Sports card — gain access to a wide number of sporting and fitness facilities across the city.
* Menstrual leave — employees who menstruate can take one extra day off when experiencing period pain.
* RED Parents Network — support for working parents, including childcare benefits, and family\-friendly events.
* RED Summer Camp for Kids — a fun summer program for children aged 5–12, majoritively paid by the company.

**Perks \& Professional Growth**

* A welcome pack filled with goodies — to help you feel right at home once you join the team.
* Trainings, lectures, and courses — workshops and trainings for each employee, knowledge\-sharing initiatives, online tutorials, and e\-learning classes are all available. There’s always something to learn!
* REDs have access to the cafeteria platform through which they can receive subscription benefits, additional medical packages or vouchers and codes to shops, cinemas, and public transport reimbursement.

Gifts for newborn rebels and regular chances to nab some cool swag!  
* 

**Social Activities \& Life in the Office**

* Dog\-friendly office — dog owner? Bring your pooch with you and look after them while working! There’s always a furry friend or two to meet at the studio.
* Social events — we host regular gatherings at the studio where we can all unwind, play games, and just have some fun together.
* Healthy selections — canteens.
* Truly international working environment — a chance to meet and work with a diverse selection of people from all around the world.
* Sustainability is an ongoing commitment for us, and our campus has electric car charging points, green zones, and much more. Read all about it on our Beyond the Game Blog.
* A designated space for your bicycle, as well as bicycle repair equipment and showers available whenever you need them.
* An onsite, well\-equipped gym with a climbing wall, daily Gym Assistant support, and yoga and boxing classes.
* No dress\-code — we like to keep it casual.

 **Estimated pay range for this position:** 17 800 – 27 800 PLN gross monthly.  

Final offers are dependent on job\-related factors like experience and qualifications.

**Are you an experienced backend developer with a curious mindset?** Do you have a passion for building intuitive, cutting\-edge solutions with state\-of\-the\-art technology?


At LeoVegas, we’re on a mission to deliver the greatest iGaming experience to our customers and technology is at the heart of making that happen.


As part of our Retention domain, you’ll play a key role in developing the platforms and features that keep players engaged and coming back for more.


This is a great opportunity to join a fast\-moving, flat\-structured team as a Senior Backend Engineer, where your work will directly shape value\-generating features across our products.


The Retention team powers the organisation with communication capabilities, ranging from indirect and direct communication with the players to a custom\-built toolbox that enriches the player journey with bonuses, loyalty programs, and seamless cross\-channel experiences. As one of the most crucial parts of the player lifecycle, the Retention domain ensures our players return for new, exciting, and rewarding experiences.

* Building scalable, robust and efficient solutions in our full\-stack team and ensure the continuous delivery in our microservice architecture.
* Being involved in technical discussions to challenge, propose, evaluate, and take a guiding and supportive approach to business needs.
* Working closely with our operational units and stakeholders.
* Driving your own initiatives with a high\-quality mindset.
* Working within the full chain of development, having end\-to\-end responsibilities.
* Collaborative work across the organisation with other domains.
* Making sure our IT ecology is scalable and ready for upcoming expansions.

 **OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:**


ESSENTIAL SKILLS

* Minimum of 6\+ years of experience working as a back\-end developer with Java and/or Kotlin
* Experience with messaging tools (i.e. Kafka)
* Experience with microservice architecture
* You have experience with common Java frameworks such as Spring and JPA
* MySQL relational databases are not something new for you
* Experience with AI tools like Claude

  

NICE TO HAVES

* Experience with OpenAPI
* Experience with BigQuery
* Experience with Kubernetes

 **WHO WE ARE**


At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the iGaming industry. We’re a team of almost 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast\-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide.

 **BENEFITS**

* Hybrid work policy (3 days a week from the office)
* 4 weeks of Workation (T\&C apply)
* Benefits package \- 800 PLN net (B2B)/gross (UOP) monthly with access to the cafeteria platform (private medical care, insurances, sports card)
* Training budget
* ICAS assistance program that can provide help and guidance during challenging moments.
* Our office provides complimentary snacks and drinks; on Mondays, we serve complimentary breakfast.
* Team and office social events throughout the year
* Free parking for bicycles and motorcycles
* Free gym in the building
* Equipment: MacBook Pro \+ smartphone (iPhone 16/17 or Samsung Galaxy S25\)

 **JOIN US!**


In our pride, we like to empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait around for things to happen. We pounce and make it happen!


Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride \- give us a roar!
