jobs.title: Erfaren .NET-utvecklare till penningtvätt
jobs.description:
**Att jobba som .NET\-utvecklare**


Vill du använda din erfarenhet inom .NET för att utveckla lösningar som spelar en viktig roll i arbetet mot penningtvätt?


Hos oss blir du en del av Team Norrsken i Piteå, ett erfaret och välfungerande team med stort ansvar för verksamhetskritiska lösningar. Här får du möjlighet att påverka tekniska vägval, utvecklas tillsammans med kunniga kollegor och arbeta inom ett område som får allt större betydelse.


Några anledningar till att välja rollen:

* Ett uppdrag med tydligt syfte – du arbetar med lösningar inom bland annat antipenningtvätt och bidrar till utvecklingen av system som möter regulatoriska krav.
* Erfarna kollegor nära dig – du blir en del av ett kompetent team med seniora systemutvecklare, teamcoach, systemansvarig, mjukvaruarkitekt och produktägare.
* Påverka både lösning och arbetssätt – du får vara delaktig från krav och design till utveckling, test och förvaltning.
* Möjlighet att fortsätta utvecklas – på sikt finns möjligheter att bredda dig mot exempelvis arkitektur, Teamcoach, systemansvar eller systemspecialist.
* Gemenskap på kontoret i Piteå – teamet värdesätter samarbete, kunskapsutbyte och gemensamt ansvar, samtidigt som det finns möjlighet till ett flexibelt hybridarbete.


Vi är 9 personer i teamet som består av systemutvecklare, Scrum Master/Teamcoach, systemansvarig, mjukvaruarkitekt samt systemspecialist. I teamet verkar även från verksamheten en produktägare (PO).


Vi arbetar agilt med dagliga avstämning. Uppgifter och prioriteringar hanteras i Azure DevOps. Din huvudsakliga arbetsplats är vårt kontor centralt i Piteå. Vi ser ett värde i att arbeta tillsammans på plats, samtidigt som rollen erbjuder möjlighet till hybridarbete.


Tillsammans förvaltar och vidareutvecklar vi system inom bland annat antipenningtvätt, där produkten Actimize är en viktig del. I takt med utökade regulatoriska krav väntar fortsatt design och utveckling av tjänster inom området.


Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att:

* utveckla och förvalta IT\-lösningar i C\#, .NET och .NET Framework
* delta i kravarbete och omsätta verksamhetens behov till tekniska lösningar
* bidra i designarbete med hänsyn till arkitektur, livscykel och roadmap
* arbeta med SQL Server, Stored Procedures, Git och enhetstester
* genomföra testaktiviteter och bidra till ökad testautomation
* felsöka och lösa incidenter och problem samt analysera bakomliggande orsaker
* dokumentera lösningar och bidra till förbättringar av teknik, processer och teamets arbetssätt.

**För att lyckas i rollen**


Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet från en liknande roll och gedigen erfarenhet av backendutveckling i C\#och .NET. Du har även erfarenhet av MS SQL, SQL Server, Stored Procedures, Git, enhetstester och agila arbetssätt. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift.


Som person är du självgående, analytisk och lösningsorienterad med förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i teknik och verksamhet, förstå krav och omsätta dem till väl genomtänkta lösningar. Eftersom vi arbetar nära varandra behöver du också vara kommunikativ, dela med dig av kunskap och våga be om hjälp. Du bidrar med ett prestigelöst och positivt förhållningssätt där teamets gemensamma resultat står i fokus.


Det är meriterande med eftergymnasial utbildning inom relevant område samt erfarenhet av testautomation, händelsedrivna system, REST/SOAP, CI/CD, Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy och felsökning i Splunk eller AppDynamics. Även kunskaper inom TypeScript/JavaScript, React.js och AI\-utveckling är meriterande.

**Vad händer nu?**


Vi jobbar med löpande urval så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet. För att göra rekryteringsprocessen så rättvis och objektiv som möjligt kommer det att ingå intervjuer, tester, bakgrundskontroll samt digital referenstagning.


Om du har frågor kopplat till rekryteringsprocessen, vänligen ta kontakt med madelene.skogh@skandia.se eller rekryterande chef på margit.ronn@skandia.se.


Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

**Mer om Banken**


Vi har varit pionjärer inom digital bankverksamhet sedan starten 1994, som Sveriges första helt digitala bank. Med en passion för innovation och kundfokus har vi vuxit till att erbjuda ett brett utbud av produkter och tjänster inom områdena Låna, Spara och Betala – med särskilt fokus på bolån.


Vår verksamhet är fördelad mellan Stockholm och Linköping. I Stockholm finns majoriteten av vår verksamhet, medan vår kundservice har sitt hjärta i Linköping. Tillsammans är vi cirka 270 medarbetare anställda på banken som varje dag skapar smarta lösningar för våra kunder.

**Vårt erbjudande inkluderar:**
  

* **Låna:** Transparenta och attraktivt prissatta bolån
* **Spara:** Sparande i fonder och aktier samt på sparkonto
* **Betala:** Lönekonto samt smidiga kort\- och betalningstjänster.

Vi tror på att människor som utvecklas, presterar och mår bra är nyckeln till framgång. Hos oss är kompetensutveckling och lärande självklara delar av vardagen – framåt tillsammans!

jobs.title: Fullstack ShopFloor Engineer
jobs.description:
About Horse Powertrain
  
This role is employed by Aurobay Technologies, Sweden, a division of Horse Powertrain Limited and is based in Sweden. Horse Powertrain Limited is an independent new powertrain solutions business, with over 125 years of heritage from Renault and Geely. We develop and produce world\-class hybrid and combustion engines and transmissions to move our industry forward, offering many different paths to net zero.
  
Horse Powertrain has 19,000 dedicated and determined employees, working in 17 manufacturing plants, and 5 R\&D centers on three continents.
  
Why join us?
  
At Horse Powertrain, you’ll have opportunities to grow your career while making a difference. This is a dynamic, international environment, staffed by caring and collaborative people. If you’re ready to create excellence with us, you’ll be appreciated and rewarded. As a Fullstack ShopFloor Engineer, you will bridge between factory automation and enterprise systems by developing scalable Java\-based middleware and fullstack solutions. You’ll work with modern technologies to connect production hardware, MES systems, and cloud platforms in a high\-tech manufacturing environment.
  
  

Skills and Experience
  
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent real world experience as the employer sees as relevant.
  
Minimum 3\-5 years of experience in IT manufacturing systems or similar roles.
  
Expertise in factory IT systems like MES (PRIME), SAP modules, PLM (Teamcenter), and data analytics tools like Databricks.
  
Strong understanding of IT infrastructures, including on\-premise server setups, public cloud platforms (e.g., Azure), and hardware specifications for smooth system operations.
  
Familiarity with shopfloor tools like PVS (Production Visualization Screen), PhotoViewer, and Q\-DAS.
  
  

Your role at Aurobay
  
  

**As a Fullstack ShopFloor Engineer you will:**  

Develop and maintain IT solutions that interface factory systems, hardware, and enterprise software using fullstack and server\-side technologies, with a focus on Java for middleware solutions (VD).
  
Build and expand modular middleware using Java for connecting factory hardware (e.g., Atlas Copco tools, PLCs, nutrunners, cameras) with enterprise systems like MES, SAP, and Teamcenter.
  
Deploy and optimize applications for both public cloud platforms (e.g., Azure) and on\-premise servers, ensuring compliance with hardware specifications and network dependencies.
  
  

Equal opportunities employer
  
We are an equal opportunities employer. We encourage candidates from underrepresented groups to apply, especially women, people from ethnic minority backgrounds, and people with disabilities. Research has shown that women and people from ethnic minority backgrounds are less likely to apply if they don't match 100% of the criteria. As a company, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment. If you believe you have the skills and passion to excel in this role, we would love to hear from you. Let's explore the possibilities together.
  
How to apply
  
Deadline to submit your application is September 30, but the selection process will be running continuously. Please note that due to GDPR, we do not accept applications via email.
  
We can’t wait to see what you can bring to our team!
  
  

Questions

jobs.title: Teknisk Produktägare Integration & Automation till Balder
jobs.description:
Vi är Balder. Vi vill påstå att vi inte är som alla andra fastighetsbolag. Att vi vågar utmana branschens gamla sanningar.
  
Som Teknisk Produktägare för Integration \& Automation blir du navet som knyter ihop Balders systemlandskap, från vårt nya ekonomisystem och dataplattform till masterdata och externa tjänster. Rollen sitter centralt i vår tekniska organisation, nära både verksamheten och utvecklingsteamen, och växer i takt med att vi expanderar till fler nordiska länder.
  
  

Om rollen
  
**Rollen växlar mellan att tänka stort och jobba i detalj:** en dag handlar det om riktning och roadmap i vår Azure\-miljö, en annan om att en integration faktiskt levererar som den ska. Du är den som sätter riktningen gentemot både verksamheten och de som bygger lösningarna.
  
  

**Snabbversionen:**  

Du kommer äga roadmap och arkitektur för hela integrations\- och automationsområdet.
  
  

Du kommer agera lösningsarkitekt – från kravställning till teknisk design och implementation.
  
  

Du kommer leda och kvalitetssäkra arbetet hos utvecklare, konsulter och leverantörer.
  
  

Du kommer etablera gemensamma standarder och följa upp drift, incidenter och teknisk skuld.
  
  

”Vi har gått från att köpa in hela integrationsleveransen till att själva äga arkitekturen, riktningen och de tekniska vägvalen, med konsulter som en förlängning av teamet. Samtidigt gör vi en stor teknikresa med nytt ERP, masterdata, dataplattform och flera nya verksamhetssystem. Det är en väldigt spännande miljö att få vara med och bygga.”
  
– Henrik, Enterprise Architect
  
  

Vad vi söker
  
För att du både ska trivas och kunna leverera hos oss så tror vi att du har flerårig erfarenhet av integrationsarkitektur, integrationsutveckling eller tekniskt produktägarskap inom integration – oavsett om det tagit dig tre eller tio år dit. Det viktiga är att du har varit med hela vägen: samlat krav, designat, utvecklat och levererat en integrationslösning från start till mål, med djup förståelse för API\-design och olika integrationsmönster.
  
  

**Krav:**  

Bakgrund som integrationsarkitekt, senior integrationsutvecklare, Solution Architect eller Tech Lead.
  
  

Erfarenhet av Azure Integration Services (API Management, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid, Azure Functions)
  
  

Dokumenterad erfarenhet av lösningsarkitektur och teknisk design för integrationslösningar
  
  

Erfarenhet av kravställning och teknisk ledning av utvecklare eller externa leveransteam
  
  

Du har utvecklat i något kodspråk (t.ex. C\#. NET), är van vid att testa API: er och läsa API\-dokumentation och har erfarenhet av olika typer autentisierignsmetoder.
  
  

**Meriterande:**  

Erfarenhet av Power Platform, Nodinite eller Infrastructure as Code.
  
  

Erfarenhet från fastighetsbranschen eller andra verksamheter med komplexa systemlandskap.
  
  

Vem är du?
  
Du är tekniskt skicklig och hands\-on men det är affären och verksamhetsnyttan som styr dina val, inte tekniken i sig. Långsiktigt ägarskap kommer naturligt för dig, och du är social nog att navigera i prioriteringar mellan olika intressenter. Din nyfikenhet gör att du hellre skapar ordning där den saknas än förvaltar något som redan är på plats.
  
Låter detta som en tjänst för dig?
  
Kul! Vi arbetar med löpande urval så skicka in din ansökan redan idag. Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med inledande provanställning om 6 månader. Tjänsten är placerad på vårt kontor i Göteborg, med arbete på plats fem dagar i veckan.
  
I denna process ber vi dig inte skicka med personligt brev, utan vill i stället att du besvarar våra urvalsfrågor. Vi använder oss av rekryteringstester för att hjälpa oss göra ett så bra och objektivt urval som möjligt.
  
Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Elin Kothe, TA\-Konsult, på elin.kothe@balder.se
  
  

Hjärtligt välkommen till oss och en bransch som är full av möjligheter!

jobs.title: Junior Software Developer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Junior Software Developer who wants to grow in modern software development and help build digital solutions for restaurants and foodtech.
  
This role is for you if you have a solid foundation in programming and want hands\-on experience building, testing, and maintaining software with experienced developers and other team members.
  
You’ll work across multiple product areas and contribute to solutions used in everyday restaurant operations—such as POS, online ordering, kitchen screens, self\-service kiosks, payments, and integrations.
  
About the role
  
As a Junior Software Developer, you’ll be part of our development team—developing, improving, and maintaining our digital products.
  
You’ll participate in the full development lifecycle, from understanding requirements and planning solutions to writing code, testing, troubleshooting, and following up on deliveries.
  
You’ll work closely with senior developers, product owners, QA, and other team members to deliver solutions with high quality, great user experience, and stable operations.
  
What you’ll do
  
Develop and maintain features in our web and backend solutions.
  
Write clean, structured, and testable code.
  
Participate in planning, estimation, and technical discussions.
  
Troubleshoot and analyze bugs in development and production.
  
Write and update unit and integration tests.
  
Contribute to building AI solutions.
  
Work with APIs, databases, and system integrations.
  
Review code with colleagues and give/receive feedback constructively.
  
Continuously improve development practices, code quality, and documentation.
  
  

What we’re looking for
  
Post\-secondary education in software development, computer science, or equivalent knowledge.
  
Basic programming experience (e.g., JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, C\#, Python, or similar).
  
Understanding of object\-oriented programming, data structures, and core software architecture.
  
Basic knowledge of databases, REST APIs, and Git version control.
  
Understanding of testing, debugging, and agile development methods.
  
Ability to communicate in English, both written and spoken.
  
A drive to learn, take ownership, and grow with the team.
  
  

Nice to have
  
Experience with React, Node.js, Java, TypeScript, or other modern frameworks.
  
Experience with cloud services, CI/CD, or containers.
  
Experience with SQL, relational databases, or message\-based integrations.
  
Personal projects, open\-source contributions, or relevant internship/work experience.
  
Experience building web applications, SaaS solutions, payments, POS systems, or e\-commerce platforms.
  
Interest in AI tools and how they can be used for development, testing, and product innovation.
  
  

Who you are
  
You’re curious and solution\-oriented—you like understanding how things work. You take initiative, ask questions when something is unclear, and use feedback to improve.
  
You work in a structured way and care about code quality, testing, and documentation, while also enjoying collaboration and sharing knowledge.
  
You don’t need to know everything from day one. The key is a strong technical foundation, genuine interest in software development, and the desire to grow in the role.
  
About us
  
We build digital systems used every day by restaurants and foodtech companies—POS, online ordering, self\-service kiosks, payments, integrations, and customer\-facing tools.
  
Our products operate in environments where stability, performance, and usability are critical. That’s why we work closely with customers and product teams to create solutions that make restaurant operations easier and more efficient.
  
Here, you’ll develop as a developer, work on real products, and be part of a team building the future of the digital restaurant experience.

jobs.title: Senior .NET-utvecklare
jobs.description:
#### **Senior .NET\-utvecklare med fokus på VB.NET och SQL Server på Kaplans Auktioner**


Vi söker en engagerad .NET\-utvecklare med god erfarenhet av VB.NET och SQL Server. Vår centrala interna applikation är uppbyggd i en kombination av Windows Forms och WPF (med XAML och MVVM). Rollen innebär ett varierat ansvar som omfattar både löpande förvaltning och nyutveckling inom båda ramverken. I rollen arbetar du nära verksamheten för att omsätta interna krav till stabila och affärsnära systemlösningar.


Teamet består idag av tre personer. Vi tillämpar en "Office First"\-filosofi, vilket innebär att arbetet sker på plats i våra lokaler – något vi värdesätter för att främja samarbete, dynamik och ett naturligt kunskapsutbyte.

###### **Ansvarsområden**

* Utveckla, underhålla och optimera våra applikationer, som är uppbyggda i en blandning av Windows Forms och WPF (med XAML \+ MVVM) i VB.NET.
* Ansvara för databasutveckling i SQL Server med primärt fokus på att skriva, optimera och underhålla lagrade procedurer (stored procedures) samt komplexa queries.
* Delta aktivt i allt från kravställning och design till utveckling, test, implementation och support.
* Säkerställa hög kodkvalitet genom versionshantering (Git) och kodgranskningar, samt förvalta och förbättra våra CI/CD\-pipelines i Azure DevOps.
* Dokumentera lösningar för att bidra till kontinuerliga förbättringar i systemen och vårt gemensamma arbetssätt.

###### **Kvalifikationer**

* Flera års erfarenhet av VB.NET (.NET Framework) och Windows Forms i komplexa miljöer.
* God förståelse för eller erfarenhet av att arbeta med WPF, XAML och designmönstret MVVM.
* Stark kompetens inom SQL Server, med särskilt god erfarenhet av databasutveckling och optimering av lagrade procedurer.
* Goda kunskaper i Git samt erfarenhet av Azure DevOps (inklusive pipelines och CI/CD).
* God förmåga att sätta dig in i befintlig kod, förstå komplex affärslogik och se hur systemen bäst kan utvecklas framåt.

###### **Personliga egenskaper**

* Strukturerad och noggrann med ett öga för detaljer och kvalitet.
* Självständig och ansvarstagande med en naturlig drivkraft att föra projekt i mål.
* Kommunikativ lagspelare som trivs med att diskutera tekniska lösningar med både utvecklare och kollegor inom verksamheten.
* Nyfiken och lösningsorienterad med en vilja att ständigt lära dig nytt och utvecklas i din roll.

jobs.title: .Net Developer
jobs.description:
**Vi letar efter en senior utvecklare som både drivs av teknik och affär. Din starka kompetens inom .Net, kombinerat med dina soft skills är det som kommer få dig att lyckas i rollen hos oss!**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------





#### **Det här letar vi efter**


Vi letar efter en senior utvecklare som både drivs av teknik och affär.


Med tanke på hur snabbt dagens teknik förändras så tror vi att du är nyfiken, öppen för att utforska nya arbetssätt och gillar att ständigt utvecklas. Här hade vi kunnat fylla på med många buzzwords, men vi tror att du har jobbat med .Net i dina senaste projekt. Har du en dragning mot DevOps eller Cloud så är det ett intressant plus! Vi tror att du som utvecklare är AI\-assisted i ditt arbete, vilket för oss innebär att du använder dig av AI i ditt dagliga arbete för att jobba smartare. För oss handlar det om att utvärdera hjälpmedel och verktyg för att ge kunden en skarpare leverans, inte bara att springa på nästa trendiga tjänst.


Att drivas av affären som konsult innebär för oss att använda din kommunikativa och relationsskapande kompetens för att på djupet förstå kundens behov. Vi tror att det är viktigt för att kunna skapa värde hos kunden, både direkt när du är på plats, men även för att skapa något som håller i längden och för framtiden.


Som Senior Backend\-utvecklare med .Net\-kompetens får du ofta en ledande roll i teamet, till exempel som Tech Lead eller Senior Utvecklare. Det innebär att du både bidrar tekniskt och stöttar andra i teamet – men också att du är med och skapar lösningar som håller över tid.


Om du är en person som vill kombinera dina soft skills med din tekniska expertis, då är vi rätt plats för dig!


#### **Det här är Crowd Collective**


Vi är fokuserade på utveckling (Backend/Fullstack) samt Data (Engineering, Science, ML och BI), givetvis med sikte på moderna tekniker, utvecklingen inom AI och kunskapsdelning. Våra projekt och uppdrag är varierande, både utifrån längd och bransch. Några av våra kunder bygger just nu e\-handelsplattformar, e\-learning\-lösningar, teknik för självkörande bilar och spelupplevelser.


Det här låter kanske som det du brukar höra från konsultbolag. Det som däremot gör oss annorlunda är vår organisering i Crowds. Det är mindre grupper av kollegor som regelbundet ses för att dela kunskap, bolla idéer och hjälpas åt med utmaningar vi stöter på i vardagen. Här finns det alltid någon att fråga, resonera med eller bara få ett nytt perspektiv från någon i en liknande sits.


Tanken med våra Crowds är enkel – du ska aldrig känna att du står ensam i din leverans. Du har ett gäng kollegor i ryggen som stöttar, utmanar och inspirerar, oavsett vilket uppdrag du sitter i. Och du är en viktig del i det själv också – din erfarenhet och dina insikter gör skillnad för dina kollegor. Antingen genom din coachande approach när en kollega söker stöd, eller mer strukturerat i form av mentorskap internt på Crowd Collective. Vår coachande attityd och ambition tar vi givetvis med oss ut till kunderna, där vi flera gånger byggt upp team med juniora medarbetare och coachat dem till självgående utvecklare.  

  



#### **Det här erbjuder vi dig**


Du kan räkna med starkt pensionspaket, 5000 kr i friskvårdsbidrag, tekniken du behöver, föräldralön, mentorskap och 6 veckors semester. Utöver det har du möjlighet att bli delägare hos oss, något vi gärna berättar mer om!


Nyfiken på att veta mer? Skicka in din ansökan så hör vi av oss så snart vi kan!

Som Fullstack\-utvecklare tror vi att du har gedigen erfarenhet inom moderna JavaScript\-ramverk som Next (React), Nuxt (Vue) eller Angular samt stark arkitekturell kompetens i backend (Node, Java, .Net och Python).


Vi tror att du som utvecklare är AI\-assisted i ditt arbete, vilket för oss innebär att du använder dig av AI i ditt dagliga arbete för att jobba smartare. För oss handlar det om att utvärdera hjälpmedel och verktyg för att ge kunden en skarpare leverans, inte att bara springa på nästa trendiga tjänst.


Att drivas av affären som konsult innebär för oss att använda din kommunikativa och relationsskapande kompetens för att på djupet förstå kundens behov. Vi tror att det är viktigt för att kunna skapa värde hos kunden, både direkt när du är på plats, men även för att skapa något som håller i längden och för framtiden


Som Senior Fullstack\-utvecklare får du ofta en ledande roll i teamet, till exempel som Tech Lead eller Senior Utvecklare. Det innebär att du både bidrar tekniskt och stöttar andra i teamet – men också att du är med och skapar lösningar som håller över tid.


Om du är en person som vill kombinera dina soft skills med din tekniska expertis, då är vi rätt plats för dig!

  

  

#### **Det här är Crowd Collective**


Vi är fokuserade på utveckling (Backend/Fullstack) samt Data (Engineering, Science, ML och BI), givetvis med sikte på moderna tekniker, utvecklingen inom AI och kunskapsdelning. Våra projekt och uppdrag är varierande, både utifrån längd och bransch. Några av våra kunder bygger just nu e\-handelsplattformar, e\-learning\-lösningar, teknik för självkörande bilar och spelupplevelser.


Det här låter kanske som det du brukar höra från konsultbolag. Det som däremot gör oss annorlunda är vår organisering i Crowds. Det är mindre grupper av kollegor som regelbundet ses för att dela kunskap, bolla idéer och hjälpas åt med utmaningar vi stöter på i vardagen. Här finns det alltid någon att fråga, resonera med eller bara få ett nytt perspektiv från någon i en liknande sits.


Tanken med våra Crowds är enkel – du ska aldrig känna att du står ensam i din leverans. Du har ett gäng kollegor i ryggen som stöttar, utmanar och inspirerar, oavsett vilket uppdrag du sitter i. Och du är en viktig del i det själv också – din erfarenhet och dina insikter gör skillnad för dina kollegor. Antingen genom din coachande approach när en kollega söker stöd, eller mer strukturerat i form av mentorskap internt på Crowd Collective. Vår coachande attityd och ambition tar vi givetvis med oss ut till kunderna, där vi flera gånger byggt upp team med juniora medarbetare och coachat dem till självgående utvecklare.


#### **Det här erbjuder vi dig**


Du kan räkna med starkt pensionspaket, 5000 kr i friskvårdsbidrag, tekniken du behöver, föräldralön, mentorskap och 6 veckors semester. Utöver det har du möjlighet att bli delägare hos oss, något vi gärna berättar mer om!


Nyfiken på att veta mer? Skicka in din ansökan så hör vi av oss så snart vi kan!

You will work with a team that dreams big, moves fast, and cares deeply about the craft and about each other. If you want to grow, stretch, and do work that truly matters, Gong is the place to do the best work of your career.

=========================

**Title** AI Engineer

**Department** Asset Management Platforms

We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together \- and supporting each other \- all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.

We partner with Investment Management, Asset Management Operations and Distribution teams across Europe and Asia to deliver modern platforms that enable investment professionals to make better investment decisions and improve client outcomes.

**About your role**  

The AI Engineer is a senior technical leader responsible for defining and delivering AI\-enabled software engineering capabilities across Asset Management Platforms (AMP). The role combines enterprise AI strategy, software engineering leadership, and practical adoption of AI\-assisted development to improve productivity, quality, and speed of delivery while maintaining Fidelity's standards for architecture, security, governance, and software quality.

* Lead decisions relating to model strategy, orchestration, retrieval architecture, and multi\-model AI adoption.

**Stakeholder Leadership**

* Build communities of practice and promote knowledge sharing across engineering teams.
* Communicate AI strategy and engineering outcomes to technical and business audiences.

**About you**


We're looking for an experienced software engineer who has designed and delivered production Generative AI/LLM solutions.

* Strong software engineering background across modern programming languages, cloud platforms, APIs, containers, automation, and observability.

Experience within Asset Management, Investment Management, or Financial Services environments is preferred.

jobs.title: Systems Development Engineer II, Amazon Robotics Infrastructure Engineering
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


The Amazon Robotics Infrastructure Engineering team is looking for a Systems Development Engineer to join our team. We build and operate the network and services that enable Amazon Fulfillment Centers, Middle and Last Mile facilities, including Air hubs, and PrimeNow to deliver packages to Amazon retail customers. From two million square foot automated robotics fulfillment centers to small last\-mile delivery stations in emerging markets, these networks are the backbone of Amazon Operations. Hundreds of thousands of associates rely upon these networks at thousands of locations, and are critical to the delivery of shipments to Amazon retail customers.  

  

Our mission is to design, deploy, and enable networks that sets the global standard for performance, availability, security and cost, enabling Fulfillment and Logistic operations to deliver on time, every customer order. We are looking for a Systems Development Engineer to create next\-generation network products. The team is focused on creating in\-house networks from leveraging open source tools and projects. We partner closely with IT support teams to ensure that simplicity in our product designs translate to operational readiness in the field. Information security rigor is at the core of everything we do. You will tackle complex, novel situations every day and have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams at Amazon in different locations. You should be comfortable with a high degree of ambiguity and relish the idea of solving problems that haven't been solved at scale before. It is expected that you will be technically pioneering, while at the same time being balanced and pragmatic in your approach. Along the way, we guarantee that you will learn a lot and make a positive impact on millions of people.  

  

The right candidate will have demonstrated experience leading large projects and have an expert level technical background in current networking technologies. You must be able to thrive and succeed in an entrepreneurial environment, and not be hindered by ambiguity or multiple priorities. This means you are not only able to develop and drive high\-level strategic initiatives, but can also roll up your sleeves, dig in and get the job done. As a Systems Development Engineer, you will anticipate bottlenecks, influence external vendors and internal team roadmaps, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As a Systems Development Engineer you will be expected to:  

* Write code for our most demanding, cross\-functional networking projects.
* Functionally decompose complex problems into simple, straight\-forward solutions.
* Fully and completely comprehend system inter\-connections and limitations.
* Effectively research and benchmark Amazon technology against other systems in the industry.
* Contribute intellectual property through patents.
* Assist in the career development of others, actively mentoring individuals and the community on advanced technical issues and helping managers guide the career growth of their team members.

  

A day in the life  

You will partner with Network, Software and Systems development Engineers to deliver automation for building and decommissioning the network infrastructure. Additionally create new tools or improve existing ones for network operators.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large\-scale infrastructure
* Experience with Linux/Unix
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C\+\+, C\#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with distributed systems at scale
* Experience with networking fundamentals including hands\-on experience with load balancers, switches, routers, etc.
* Experience working in an Agile environment

  

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Software developer
jobs.description:
Etsimme **Sovelluskehittäjää** vahvistamaan asiantuntijatiimiämme, joka toteuttaa merkittäviä digitalisaatiohankkeita. Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden työskennellä monipuolisissa asiakasprojekteissa, joissa pääset vaikuttamaan teknisiin ratkaisuihin ja kehittämään omaa osaamistasi.

**Sijainti:** Tampere, Helsinki, Jyväskylä, Turku, Oulu tai Lappeenranta. Voit myös halutessasi työskennellä etänä kotoa, mutta asiakkaan turvallisuusvaatimusten vuoksi osa työtehtävistä on suoritettava toimistolla tai asiakkaan tiloissa Helsingissä.

#### **Vastuualueet:**


Sovelluskehittäjänä:

* Työskentelet monipuolisesti suomalaisen julkishallinnon ja yksityisen elinkeinoelämän asiakasprojekteissa kehittäen moderneja, skaalautuvia sovelluksia.
* Osallistut mikropalveluarkkitehtuurien suunnitteluun ja toteutukseen.
* Toimit osana asiantuntijatiimiä, jossa yhdistyvät kehittäjät, arkkitehdit, analyytikot ja UX/UI\-suunnittelijat.
* Ohjaat asiakasta parhaisiin ratkaisuihin ja osallistut aktiivisesti tekniseen suunnitteluun.
* Toimit tiimissä osana suurempaa monen tiimin hanketta.

#### **Kenen kanssa työskentelet?**


Työskentelet osana *T*woday Digital Engineering asiantuntevaa noin 350 hengen praktiikkaa. Meillä on Suomen kärkitason osaajia ja rooleja devaajista arkkitehteihin sekä konsultteihin.


Tarjoamme sinulle osaavan, rennon ja innokkaan työympäristön, jossa sinun on mahdollista kehittää ammatillista osaamistasi ja vaikuttaa omaan urapolkuusi. Työkulttuuriamme kuvaa avoin ja välittävä asenne työntekijöitämme kohtaan.

#### **Odotamme sinulta:**

* Vähintään **3 vuoden kokemus**.
* Osaamista seuraavista teknologioista: **C\#, .NET, Vue, React, TypeScript**.
* Tuntemusta relaatiotietokannoista kuten **PostgreSQL, MariaDB tai Oracle**.
* Pilviosaamista: **Azure tai AWS**.
* Kokemusta **mikropalveluarkkitehtuureista** ja kontitetuista ratkaisuista.
* Kokemusta ketterästä sovelluskehityksestä.
* Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa ja vakituinen asuinpaikka Suomessa.
* Englannin kielen osaaminen.
* Olet oma\-aloitteinen ja sinulla on kyky viedä asioita eteenpäin.
* Olet sopivasti ulospäin suuntautunut persoona ja osaat toimia osana tiimiä.
* Kykenet organisoimaan sekä priorisoimaan omaa työtäsi.
* Uskallat esittää asiat kuten ne ovat.
* Osaat antaa rakentavaa palautetta ja kehittää tiimin toimintaa jatkuvasti.
* Sinulla on vähintään alempi korkeakoulututkinto suoritettuna.
* Olet taustaltasi nuhteeton, koska tehtävään valittavasta henkilöstä asiakkaamme vaativat perusmuotoisen henkilöturvallisuusselvityksen, jotta asiakasprojektiin osallistuminen olisi mahdollista. Lisätietoa turvallisuusselvityksestä ja sen vaatimuksista.

#### **Katsomme eduksi**


Jos sinulla on kokemusta jostain seuraavista osaamisista:

* Kokemusta WMS / RabbitMQ
* Skaalatusta ketterästä kehityksestä (esim. SAFe).
* Turvaverkoista (Tuve).
* Integraatioista.
* Julkisen organisaation hankkeista.
* Standardi / EU dokumentaation ymmärrys.
* Viranomaisdokumentaation ymmärrys.


Meille on tärkeää, että osaat toimia osana tiimiä ja kommunikoit aktiivisesti sekä avoimesti, olet asiakaspalveluhenkinen. Haluat tehdä työsi laadukkaasti ja oikein. Olet innokas kehittämään ja haastamaan itsesi sekä tiimisi can\-do \-asenteella.

#### **Miltä onnistuminen roolissa näyttää?**


Ensimmäisen kuuden kuukauden tavoitteesi kiteytettynä:

* Olet läpäissyt turvallisuusselvityksen.
* Olet päässyt hyvin osaksi työyhteisöä ja osoittautunut loistavaksi lisäksi tiimiimme.
* Olet sisäistänyt asiakkaan toimialan ja perehtynyt sisään hankkeeseen.
* Osaamisesi on osoittautunut relevantiksi asiakasprojekteissamme.


Auttaaksemme sinua menestymään, tarjoamme sinulle perehdytysohjelman, koulutuksia, sertifikaatteja sekä työyhteisön, joka omalla osaamisellaan ja tekemisellään tukee työssä oppimistasi ja urakehitystäsi. Lisäksi inklusiivinen kulttuurimme tarjoaa useita mahdollisuuksia tutustua uusiin työkavereihin sekä työn että hauskanpidon merkeissä.

#### **Mitä Twoday tarjoaa sinulle?**


Jäykkien organisaatiorakenteiden ja korkean hierarkian sijaan yksikkömme tarjoaa sinulle autonomiaa ja joustavuutta tukevan työympäristön.

##### **Etuihimme kuuluu:**

* **Markkinatasoinen työsuhde\-etujen paketti sisältäen:**


	+ Lounas ja virike\-etu
	+ Työterveyshuolto
	+ Auntie mielen hyvinvoinnin tukipalvelut
	+ Mahdollisuus valita omat työvälineesi
* **Vahva tuki ammatilliselle kehittymiselle:**


	+ Online\-oppimisympäristöt: Udemy
	+ Teknologiasertifioinnit, joista toisinaan palkitaan myös bonuksin
	+ Koulutukset ja community\-tapaamiset
	+ Yhteisölliset oppimissessiot työkavereiden kanssa (esim. hackathon tapahtumat)
* **Paljon vapaa\-ajan aktiviteetteja, kuten:**


	+ Koko firman tapahtumat
	+ Toimitustiimien omat tapahtumat
	+ Kaikille avoimia ja vapaasti perustettavia harrastekerhoja, mm. maastopyöräily, juoksu, lautapelit, neulonta, e\-urheilu, padel.

#### **Tehtävään hakeminen:**


Voit hakea tehtävään helposti LinkedIn\-profiilillasi tai CV:llä. Hakemuskirje on vapaaehtoinen. Palaamme sinulle mahdollisimman pian!


Paikka täytetään heti, kun sopiva henkilö löytyy.

**Onko sinulla kysymyksiä,** esimerkiksi hakemukseen tai toimiston esteettömyyteen liittyen, joihin toivoisit meidän vastaavan ennen hakemuksen jättämistä?


Voit ottaa yhteyttä rekrytointitiimiimme careers.fi@twoday.com ja palaamme sinulle mahdollisimman pian vastausten kera.


Huomioithan, että voimme edetä ainoastaan hakijoiden kanssa, joilla on työntekoon oikeuttava oleskelulupa Suomessa.

#### **Työskentely Twodaylla**


Twoday on johtava teknologiakonsultointiyritys, joka auttaa organisaatioita hyödyntämään tekoälyä ja edistyksellisiä teknologioita käytännössä. Meitä on noin 2 300 asiantuntijaa tekoälyn, datan, digitaalisen kehityksen ja pilvipalveluiden parissa. Autamme asiakkaitamme selkeyttämään monimutkaisia kokonaisuuksia, vähentämään epävarmuutta ja saamaan teknologiasta konkreettista liiketoimintahyötyä.


Tarkoituksemme on rakentaa parempaa huomista tekoälyn ja teknologian avulla. Tuemme niin yksityisen kuin julkisen sektorin organisaatioita muun muassa energia\- ja yhdyskuntatekniikan alalla, finanssi\- ja vakuutussektorilla, teollisuudessa, terveydenhuollossa sekä julkishallinnossa.


Suurin vahvuutemme ei kuitenkaan ole teknologia, vaan ihmiset sen takana. Joka päivä asiantuntijamme hyödyntävät osaamistaan, uteliaisuuttaan ja määrätietoisuuttaan auttaakseen asiakkaitamme ratkaisemaan monimutkaisia haasteita ja luomaan kestävää arvoa.

#### **Monimuotoisuus ja yhdenvertaisuus**


Haluamme rakentaa työyhteisön, jossa jokaista arvostetaan ja jossa kaikilla on yhtäläiset mahdollisuudet menestyä. Rekrytointipäätöksemme perustuvat osaamiseen, kokemukseen ja henkilön soveltuvuuteen tehtävään.

#### **Etkö täytä kaikkia vaatimuksia?**


Moni jättää hakematta, jos ei koe täyttävänsä jokaista ilmoituksessa mainittua kriteeriä. Meille tärkeintä on, että sinulla on tehtävässä tarvittavaa osaamista, aitoa kiinnostusta rooliin sekä halua kehittyä. Jos tehtävä herättää mielenkiintosi ja uskot voivasi menestyä siinä, kannustamme sinua hakemaan.

jobs.title: PhD Position(s) in Bioreceptive Design and Robotic 3D Printing for Living System Integration in Architecture
jobs.description:
SDU CREATE invites highly motivated candidates who wish to contribute to a regenerative built environment to apply for one or more PhD positions in Computational Design and Fabrication for Living System Integration in Architecture. The position(s) is expected to begin in January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The application deadline is 15 October 2026 at 23:59 CEST.  



**Scope of the work**

The PhD position(s) is linked to the Villum CEBE programme, Civil Engineering and the Green Transition in the Built Environment, funded by the Villum Foundation. Within Research Field 2, Design for Regeneration, Circularity and Longevity, the research will develop architectural interfaces that support the establishment and growth of living systems, particularly photosynthetic communities, as a strategy for regenerative architecture. The focus is on enveloping surfaces in the built environment.


The project will focus on designing, testing and demonstrating, at architectural scale, porous mineral interfaces combined with hydrogels. Computational design, fabrication and environmental monitoring will be combined with cultivation experiments and biological assessment, targeting mosses, algae and cyanobacteria in collaboration with partner researchers in biology.


We seek candidates with primary expertise in one of two complementary research profiles:


* **Bioreceptive Design and Robotic 3D Printing:** exploring how architectural geometry, material composition and 3D printing can create bioreceptive interfaces. The work will combine computational design, printable material development, toolpath generation and robot programming to develop porous mineral interfaces informed by biological requirements.
* **Living Material Design and Biological Performance:** developing hydrogels incorporating living organisms for integration into porous mineral interfaces. The work will combine formulation, cultivation, sensors, automated monitoring and data analysis to evaluate hygrothermal behaviour, biological growth, photosynthetic activity and material performance.

Both profiles require an interest in integrating biological systems and processes into architectural design and construction. The successful candidate(s) will collaborate within the team to develop and validate the resulting interfaces.


The candidate(s) will also contribute to the Centre’s activities, including teaching in the MSc CREATE programme and the BSc programme in Civil and Architectural Engineering through teaching, workshops and co\-supervision of student projects.  



**Focus Area and Research Project**

The research will investigate how material composition, porous morphologies and hygrothermal dynamics can support biological establishment and environmental performance, while addressing durability, maintenance and integration into building envelopes. Environmental measurements will help establish relationships between interface design, climatic exposure, biological development and performance.


The successful candidate(s) will contribute to selected areas according to their expertise, working within a team with complementary skills:


* Computational design of bioreceptive mineral interfaces for enveloping surfaces in the built environment
* Development and characterisation of printable mineral materials
* Robotic 3D printing, toolpath generation and fabrication process development
* Formulation of hydrogels incorporating living organisms and their integration into printed scaffolds
* Cultivation experiments and assessment of biological growth and photosynthetic activity
* Sensor integration, automated monitoring and data analysis to evaluate hygrothermal behaviour, ecological and microclimatic performance
Fabrication and evaluation of full\-scale architectural demonstrators, addressing durability, maintenance and sustained biological growth  
* 

**About SDU CREATE’s Research Environment**

The Centre for Computational Research in Emergent Architectural Technology and Engineering, SDU CREATE, is led by Associate Professor Roberto Naboni. The Centre investigates advanced concepts and applications in architectural engineering, focusing on computational design, construction robotics, and material innovation. SDU CREATE brings together an international research team working across architectural engineering, computer science, robotics, materials science, and biology. Its research develops sustainable, regenerative approaches to designing and constructing the built environment.


Located within the Faculty of Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark, SDU CREATE provides advanced laboratory facilities for robotic fabrication, additive and subtractive manufacturing, mixed reality applications in design and construction, and structural and mechanical testing. The facilities include industrial robotic systems, computational design platforms, and equipment for the experimental testing of materials, components, and structures. This environment supports interdisciplinary collaboration and partnerships with academic and industrial institutions in Denmark and internationally. The candidate(s) will work within a research culture that combines computational development with physical experimentation and full scale construction.


SDU CREATE is a partner in CEBE, a ten\-year national research initiative funded by the Villum Foundation, in which Danish technical universities collaborate to advance the sustainability of the built environment within planetary boundaries. Within this initiative, SDU CREATE leads research in Digitalisation and Automation, RF4, and contributes to research in Design for Regeneration, Circularity, and Longevity, RF2\. The programme provides a long\-term research framework, access to national research networks, and opportunities for collaboration with academic and industrial partners.  



**Responsibilities**

The successful candidate(s) will contribute to the development and delivery of CREATE’s research activities and laboratory\-based investigations. Responsibilities include:


* Conducting high\-quality research within the defined research project and contributing original, scientifically rigorous outcomes
* Conducting fabrication experiments and biological and environmental performance testing, including operation of robotic systems and laboratory equipment as relevant to the candidate’s research profile
* Participating in CREATE’s research team activities, contributing to the development of design, fabrication, and testing frameworks
* Developing and maintaining computational tools and workflows supporting the research activities
* Assisting in teaching bachelor’s and master’s level courses and workshops, including co\-supervision of thesis students and collaboration with interns in research\-related activities
* Disseminating research results through high\-impact peer\-reviewed publications and recognised international conferences
* Sharing research outcomes through curated and high\-quality outputs for digital platforms, exhibitions, and competitions
* Contributing to the further development and maintenance of CREATE’s laboratory infrastructures and experimental facilities
* Engaging with academic and industrial collaborators at the national and international level, including participation in the Villum CEBE research network
* Assisting senior staff in the preparation of applications for external research funding

Engagement in these activities will evolve with the experience of the candidate(s), contributing to the Centre’s excellence and supporting their academic development, ideally towards future career advancement.  



**Candidate Requirements**

Applications are invited from highly motivated candidates holding a Master’s degree in architecture, computational design, civil or architectural engineering, materials science, environmental engineering, biology, or other relevant disciplines related to the research areas. Candidates must demonstrate primary expertise in either **Bioreceptive Design and Robotic 3D Printing** or **Living Material Design and Biological Performance** , and the ability to contribute to shared design, fabrication and validation activities. Interdisciplinary experience connecting these areas is particularly valued.


Candidates must demonstrate:


* Documented interest and foundational knowledge in bioreceptive design, living system integration or related research areas
* Competence in Grasshopper and Rhino, advanced for the Bioreceptive Design and Robotic 3D Printing profile and at working level for the Living Material Design and Biological Performance profile, together with relevant programming skills such as Python or C\#
* For the **Bioreceptive Design and Robotic 3D Printing profile:** practical experience in computational design, toolpath generation and robotic 3D printing, together with an understanding of biological requirements relevant to design; experience developing porous geometries and printable mineral materials are particularly valued
* For the **Living Material Design and Biological Performance profile:** practical experience in material formulation and biological experimentation or cultivation, together with competence in experimental measurement and data analysis; experience with hydrogels, sensor integration, automated monitoring or hygrothermal characterisation are particularly valued
* Hands\-on laboratory experience, including physical prototyping or specimen preparation, and experimental testing relevant to the selected profile
* Demonstrated capacity to conduct, document and disseminate projects and research outcomes suitable for peer\-reviewed publication
* Strong proficiency in English, both written and oral
* Strong ability to work effectively within interdisciplinary teams and to coordinate and collaborate daily
* Strong communication skills across graphical, written and oral formats
A proven track record of involvement in research or innovation projects; experience in teaching assistance, peer\-reviewed publications or engagement with academic or industry stakeholders is evaluated positively  
* 

**Contact information**

For further information about the position(s) and SDU CREATE’s activities, please contact the Head of Centre, Associate Professor Roberto Naboni, at ron@iti.sdu.dk . For additional information on the Centre’s work, visit the website at www.create\-sdu.com .


If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support .  



**Application Procedure**

Applicants are advised to carefully read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and how to apply for academic staff before submitting their application. The application must be submitted in English and include the following documents, uploaded in the specified order as PDF files:


* Completed TEK PhD application form for 5\+3 applicants. The form is available on the Faculty website .
* Motivation letter and research statement, with a maximum combined length of five pages. The document should clearly describe the applicant’s proposed research direction and qualifications for the position and indicate their primary research profile.
* Detailed curriculum vitae, including academic and professional experience, research projects, teaching and supervision experience, awards, exhibitions, and computational and fabrication skills.
* List of publications, if applicable, including copies of publications the applicant wishes the committee to assess.
* Verified copies of official bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates and academic transcripts, provided in Danish or accompanied by an official English translation. Applicants currently enrolled in a master’s programme must include a statement indicating their expected completion date.
* Completed TEK PhD form for calculating grade point average. The form is available on the Faculty website .
* Official documentation describing the educational structure and grading system of the awarding institution, if the degree was obtained outside Denmark.
* Portfolio of up to 15 pages presenting selected research, teaching, or professional projects.
* Contact details for at least two referees, including their names and email addresses. The referees may be contacted during the selection process.
All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF\-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected.


SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file).  



**The application deadline is 15 October, 2026,** at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)  



**The assessment and selection process**

Read about the Assessment and selection process . An assessment committee will evaluate applications. Shortlisting may be applied. Only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. Interviews and tests may be part of the process.  



**Enrolment and employment terms**

Applicants must have a master’s degree equivalent to a Danish master's degree at the time of enrolment and employment. Employment as a PhD fellow is a 3\-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37\.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step. Salary and employment conditions are governed by the applicable collective agreement and the Protocol on PhD Research Fellows.


Employment is conditional upon approval for admission by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order) . Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC).


Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender\-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation.


Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self\-organizer”.  



The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).


Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.


Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: DevEx Engineer
jobs.description:
**Join AutoProff – Help Shape the Future of Automotive Tech!**

We’re looking for a **DevEx Engineer** to join our **Empower platform squad “Taycan”**. The squad is split between our HQ in Vejle and our Copenhagen office, so the role can be based in either location.



The Taycan squad helps engineers spend more time delivering product value and less time solving the same technical problems. We build shared capabilities that make the preferred engineering path easier to use.



As our new **DevEx Engineer**, you’ll work on the shared tooling, libraries and development patterns used by engineering squads across AutoProff. From scaffolding and shared libraries to patterns such as Outbox, Sagas and messaging, you’ll help make software development simpler and more consistent – so our product squads can spend less time solving the same technical problems and more time building great products.



You’ll work closely with platform engineers, service owners and engineers across our product squads, building solutions that are used across the engineering organisation rather than within just one product area.



Help build shared capabilities and DevEx foundations that enable teams to work effectively with agentic AI.



Use agentic AI in your own DevEx work and share practical learning with engineering teams.



We foster a developer\-friendly culture with room to explore new technologies and ways of working. You’ll have access to modern AI\-powered tools, join hackathons and take part in internal developer forums where we share ideas and discuss architecture, technology and engineering challenges.


**Let's dive into your key responsibilities, you will**


* Build and evolve shared libraries, scaffolding templates, and CI/CD tooling that remove recurring friction for product squads.
* Build paved paths for messaging patterns like Outbox and Sagas, observability, and rehydration/recovery tooling.
* Support developers in adopting shared standards for tracing, service integration, and AWS infrastructure.
* Work with engineers across product squads to understand recurring friction and turn it into DevEx priorities.
* Help squads adopt platform practices that make service ownership, operation, and reuse easier.
* Support developers in adopting shared standards for tracing, service integration, AWS infrastructure, and secure, reliable defaults


**The need\-to\-have**

* Strong engineering experience in .NET / C\#.
* Proficiency in AWS services (e.g., ECS, Lambda, SQS, S3\) and infrastructure\-as\-code (CDK/Terraform).
* Familiarity with microservices, event\-driven architecture, and distributed\-systems patterns such as Outbox, Sagas, and CDC.
* Hands\-on experience building shared libraries, observability tooling, and reusable APIs.
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills, able to support squads, gather feedback, and drive adoption.


**The nice\-to\-have skills**


* Experience in platform engineering or developer enablement roles.
* Familiarity with internal documentation practices, onboarding tooling, and automated scaffolding.
* Hands\-on work with service event rehydration, incident recovery tooling, or metadata standards.
* Practical experience using LLMs, generative AI, or agentic AI in software development.


We’re eager to hear from you! If this sounds like a great match and sparks your interest, don’t wait, apply today!


**About AutoProff**



AutoProff was founded in 2013 by the experienced car dealer Jesper Ratza in Denmark. The aim was to digitalize B2B used car trading, helping car dealers increase sales and improve profits.



in August 2022, AutoScout24, the leading specialized pan\-European online car marketplace, acquired a majority stake in AutoProff. The partnership has supported the rapid expansion of AutoProff's solutions across Europe and enables the creation of Europe's first fully integrated C2B\-B2B\-B2C dealing solution for used cars.



At AutoProff, we specialize in providing online B2B used\-car dealing solutions designed to improve the buying and selling experience for professional car dealers and their customers.



We are the emerging European leader with more than 150,000 B2B used cars on our online trading platforms annually.


With a focus on effective solutions, digitization and customer service, we are committed to being the home of B2B car dealing for European car dealers.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (C#/.NET, Azure)
jobs.description:
**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**

SimCorp is developing a new game changing Software\-as\-a\-Service solution for Performance Measurement and Attribution, which will allow Investment Managers to interact with, and analyze their investments in a modern web application. It is connected to a high\-performance computing calculation engine in the back\-end, thus combining more than 50 years of industry\-leading experience of SimCorp with a modern user experience and cloud computing, enabling users to do in minutes what used to take hours.  



We welcome applications from both early‑career and mid‑career software engineers.  



**WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR**

* Build solutions: collaborate closely with your team, Product Managers, Architects, peers and end\-users to deliver high\-quality, secure and valuable solutions in the Performance Product Area.
* Contribute across the entire development lifecycle \- from requirements analysis and design to implementation, test automation, documentation, and ongoing support.
* Coordinate and execute on development and maintenance of the investment performance solution in collaboration with product owners and other teams.
* Think beyond the code: Understand our strategy, goals and customer needs to enhance SimCorp’s impact.

You will work closely with experienced engineers who support your development. Over time, you will grow into taking ownership of larger components and may mentor more junior colleagues as your experience grows.  

* 

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* Solid knowledge of C\#, .NET Core/Framework, and object\-oriented design principles.
* Experience with APIs.
* Familiarity with modern engineering practices, including CI/CD pipelines and trunk\-based development. We use Git (Azure DevOps).
* Interest in cloud engineering. We use Microsoft Azure.
* You understand the importance of automated testing of business‑critical functionality and quality assurance practices.
* Willingness to dive into a complex domain, working with finance, investment performance \& attribution and investment\-related instruments.
* You are able to solve complex problems in a structured manner.
* You are enthusiastic about building state\-of\-the\-art software, and have the mindset needed to make others understand your ideas.
* Curiosity and adaptability to learn in\-house tools and frameworks \- including the APL programming language (no prior experience in APL required, we provide extensive training).
* You are good at coordinating with both programmers and non\-programmers, to ensure a full understanding of tasks.
* You have a Master’s degree or higher within Computer Sciences, Engineering, Finance, Physics, Mathematics, Economics or similar experience.

If you have knowledge of a financial domain it is plus, otherwise we will bring you up to speed using technical discussions, training and a comprehensive onboarding program.  

* 

**WHAT IS IT LIKE TO WORK HERE**

SimCorp plans work in an agile manner, using 4 planning intervals (PI’s) per year, each consisting of 5 sprints of 2 weeks each, followed by a 3\-week Innovation and Planning sprint, which can be used for mastering skills in various areas, or more freely investigating ideas with prototypes. It is important that our people learn and grow constantly, and SimCorp invests a lot to foster the continuous learning environment to support people on their journeys.  



* **Global hybrid work policy** \- We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* **Growth and** **innovation** \- Every 6 th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application.
* **Self\- Direction** \- High degree of self\-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.
* Inclusive and diverse company culture
* Pension and health benefits and bonus
* **Work\-life balance** – We strongly believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of our self’s, both in private life and as a colleague in the workplace
* **Empowerment** – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will involved in shaping our work processes
**NEXT STEPS**

jobs.description:
*Twoday is the leading digital transformation partner in Northern Europe with a global presence. With approximately 3,000 technologies, we collaborate with the most admired private and public organizations to deliver cutting\-edge digital solutions. Our deep industry expertise spans Data \& AI, software development, digital experiences, and business applications. Operating across the Nordics and Lithuania, our team generated a revenue of 280 million euros in 2023\. We serve over 8,000 customers, supporting their digital transformation journeys.*

**Do you want to develop stable and socially impactful solutions in the public sector?**


We are looking for a .net Developer with at least three years of experience to join Twoday as a permanent employee, working as a consultant with a public sector client. You will become part of an agile development team where quality, reliability and professionalism are key – and where your solutions will make a real difference to citizens and employees.


At Twoday, you will be part of a strong professional community, while working closely with the client and their teams on a daily basis.

**Your responsibilities as a .net developer will include:**

* Developing and enhancing .net\-based backend solutions
* Implementing functionality in both existing and new systems
* Working with APIs, integrations and data access
* Writing structured, testable and maintainable code in C\#/.net
* Collaborating with frontend developers, architects and business stakeholders
* Participating in analysis, estimation and planning of development tasks
* Contributing to technical improvements, quality and best practices
* Continuous learning and knowledge sharing with more experienced colleagues

**Your qualifications**


Your educational background is less important – what matters is a solid technical foundation and a willingness to grow. We expect that you:

* Have at least three years of experience as a .net developer
* Have hands\-on experience with C\# and .net/.net Core
* Have worked with backend development, such as:
* ASP.net
* REST APIs
* Integrations with other systems
* Have a basic understanding of:


	+ Architecture principles
	+ Performance
	+ Security
* Work in a structured manner and take responsibility for the quality of your work
* Thrive in an agile environment and collaborate well within a team
* Are fluent in Danish, both spoken and written, as the working language is Danish


It is an advantage, but not a requirement, if you also have experience with:

* Azure or other cloud platforms
* CI/CD and automated testing
* Public sector IT solutions

**Employment**


You will be employed by Twoday and work as a consultant for a public sector client. Twoday is your employer and provides a strong professional community, skills development and clear career paths – while you contribute daily to an important and meaningful project with the client.

**The process**

* Telephone interview with a Talent Acquisition Partner
* Teams interview with hiring manager
* Technical assessment
* Onsite interview with hiring manager

**About Twoday**


Twoday has modern offices in more than 30 locations across Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland and Lithuania. We offer an engaging work environment with high professional standards and a strong sense of community. With us, you will have the opportunity to develop both professionally and personally in an international and innovative organisation.

**Diversity \& Inclusion**


Don’t meet every requirement? Studies show that women and other underrepresented groups are less likely to apply unless they meet every qualification. Customer relationship management

* Responsible for timely and accurate reporting in CRM
* Responsible for gathering relevant information about market and competitors from the field
* Supports the finance function in money collection.
* Drives execution of her/his individual sales plan

* Bachelor or Master’s degree in economics, engineering or other relevant field
* Experience from/ familiar with solution selling methodology
* Experience from / familiar with KONE customers’ industries is a plus
* Sales and/ or customer service experience
* Masters the sales process
* Numbers and facts drive actions
* Is able to bring across customer needs, add value to customers’ businesses by offering solutions that meet their needs and is able to use value based pricing to guarantee healthy margins
