jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.description:
Job Description:

We are looking for a **Senior Software Developer** to join our team and contribute to the development of a cloud\-based ETL platform. You will design and develop data processing solutions using Microsoft Azure, Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions and MS SQL Server, while working closely with business stakeholders and external partners.

**What you’ll be doing:**
-------------------------

* Analyse business requirements and create solution concepts and technical designs as part of ETL platform development.
* Design, implement and develop ETL/ELT data processing pipelines using MS Azure Data Factory and Azure Functions within CEEDACH.
* Prepare and maintain mechanisms for the automatic import, validation and updating of the insured database based on business requirements, using MS Azure Cloud PaaS services and MS SQL Server.
* Onboard new partners and contracts to the ETL platform, including:
* Maintain the continuity and reliability of the cloud ETL platform dedicated to importing and processing partner data using Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions and Azure SQL.
* Monitor production pipelines and troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures and data quality issues.
* Cooperate with internal and external clients at various stages of project implementation.
* Cooperate and communicate with other AXA Partners departments in accordance with company rules and processes.
* Prepare and maintain required technical documentation.

**What you’ll bring:*** 5\+ years of experience writing complex queries using T\-SQL.
* English at B2/C1 level and Czech are required.
* Strong knowledge of data modelling, ETL/ELT development and data warehousing, with the ability to understand and organize data from various sources.
* Hands\-on experience with MS Azure Cloud PaaS services (Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions, Azure Blob Storage, Azure SQL / SQL Managed Instance)
* Experience with Python, particularly in data processing.
* Knowledge of CI/CD principles and experience with Azure DevOps or similar tools is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in IT or IT Management.
* Ability to work effectively under time pressure.
* Good communication skills.
* Knowledge of German is an advantage.
* Experience with .NET is an advantage.

**What we offer:**  

At AXA Partners, we’re appreciative of the people who work for us and our rewards package is reviewed regularly to reflect that. You can expect to receive:

  

* 25 days of vacation
* Meal vouchers worth 150 CZK from day one
* Home office 2 days per week (after training), including full equipment (laptop, monitor, docking station, etc.)
* Smart working allowance (1 200 CZK/month)
* MultiSport or Pluxee Flexi Pass (500 CZK/month contribution)
* Telemedicine – 24/7 online medical support for you and up to five family members
* Pension contribution (1,000 CZK/month)
* Fully covered life insurance
* Free European travel insurance, including coverage for extreme sports and roadside assistance
* Development programs and courses, including access to LinkedIn Learning
* A friendly team of colleagues
* Office refreshments

  

To apply, click on the ‘apply for this job’ button, you’ll then need to log in or create a profile to submit your CV. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunities Employer and don’t discriminate against employees or potential employees based on protected characteristics. If you have a long\-term condition or disability and require adjustments during the application or interview process, please send an email to AXA Partners Global HR Response \- globalhr@partners.axa

**Who we are:**
---------------


We’re AXA Partners, experts at designing and delivering assistance solutions and specialised insurance, credit, and lifestyle protection – with and for our partners worldwide. What sets us apart? The expertise and passion of our 8,500\+ people, and a strong network of over 55,000 professionals all over the world. Powered by them and our sector\-leading technology, we continuously evolve, adapt and thrive – offering solutions and services that make sure we’re always at people’s side, no matter what. Helping others is our passion. Combining the best digital technology with our warm, human touch, we’re always looking at new ways to offer seamless and reassuring experiences when it really matters. **Join a company that helps protect the forests! At AXA Partners, we plant a tree for every new recruit (with a permanent contract)**

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
#### **Join Axon and be a Force for Good.**



At Axon, we're on a mission to Protect Life. We're explorers, pursuing society's most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.  

  

Life at Axon is fast\-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you'll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

### **Your Impact**



As a senior engineer on the team, you will be intimately involved in architecture decisions that shape this product. You live and breathe cloud services that require high availability and fast, consistent performance.  

  

You operate in an AI\-first engineering environment, where you leverage advanced AI systems to inform design decisions, accelerate development, and improve system reliability. You are expected to drive adoption of AI\-enabled engineering practices across teams, ensuring scalable and efficient development workflows.  

  

You will work closely with product managers and designers to ensure we are building the right solution for our customers, while also mentoring engineers on both system design and AI\-first development practices.


### **What You'll Do**


**Work Location:** This role is based out of our Bucharest office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in\-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in\-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.

  

* Lead engineering architecture design reviews, incorporating AI\-driven insights and system modeling
* Set a high technical bar through code and architecture reviews, including evaluation of AI\-generated code and patterns
* Mentor engineers on scalable system design and AI\-first development practices
* Drive adoption of AI\-assisted development tools and workflows across the engineering organization
* Work across teams with Product, Design, and Engineering to create integrated solutions
* Improve engineering processes by embedding automation, AI tooling, and intelligent workflows into planning and execution
* Build services that adhere to high standards on availability and latency in a mission\-critical environment
* Leverage AI systems to optimize performance, observability, and operational efficiency

### **What You Bring**


* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* 6\+ years of professional software development experience
* Experience designing and delivering highly\-available, scalable cloud\-based systems
* Backend service experience in multiple managed languages such as Java, Scala, Go, C\#, or similar
* Experience with SQL or NoSQL data stores
* Experience evaluating and integrating AI\-assisted development tools into engineering workflows
* Strong understanding of how AI can be applied to improve developer productivity, system design, and operational efficiency


Don't meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long\-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.



Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you're excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


**Important Notes**


*The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.*


*Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.*


*We collect personal information from applicants to evaluate candidates for employment. You may request access, deletion, or exercise other CCPA rights at* ***axongreenhousesupport@axon.com*** *or via our* *Axon Privacy Web Form**. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our* *Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.*


*Axon's mission is to Protect Life and is committed to the well\-being and safety of its employees as well as Axon's impact on the environment. All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. Axon employees are empowered to report safety concerns as they arise and activities potentially impacting the environment.*


*We are an equal opportunity employer that promotes justice, advances equity, values diversity and fosters inclusion. We're committed to hiring the best talent — regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances — and empowering all of our employees so they can do their best work. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please email* *recruitingops@axon.com.* *Please note that this email address is for accommodation purposes only. Axon will not respond to inquiries for other purposes.*



Phishing alert: Axon will never ask you to pay for any part of the hiring process, including training, equipment, or background checks. We do not make job offers via text message, WhatsApp, or instant messaging platforms without a formal interview process. All legitimate job openings are listed on our official careers page at https://www.axon.com/careers. If you receive a suspicious offer or outreach from an email address that is not **@axon.com**, or if you are asked for sensitive personal information (bank details, Social Security Number) prematurely, please ignore the message and report it to recruitingops@axon.com.

jobs.description:
20\-09\-2026  

**Take a leading role at BRINEL as a Senior Full\-Stack Java Developer.** You will guide the development of scalable full\-stack applications using Java, Spring Boot, Angular or React. You’ll architect secure, high\-performance RESTful APIs, manage both SQL and NoSQL databases, and lead efforts in event\-driven system features. Your expertise will contribute to improving our CI/CD pipelines and ensuring top code quality.


**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the design, development, and maintenance of full\-stack applications using Java (Spring Boot) and Angular or React
* Architect and implement secure, performant RESTful APIs with seamless integration to internal and third\-party systems
* Manage SQL and NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MongoDB), including data modeling, migrations, and performance tuning
* Develop event\-driven features using messaging systems such as ActiveMQ or Kafka
* Collaborate on CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI), automating builds, tests, and deployments
* Drive code quality and maintainability through comprehensive testing, code reviews, and best practices adherence
* Contribute to system architecture and technical documentation, mentoring team members
* Work closely with QA, Product, and DevOps teams to deliver robust features from concept to release
* Mentor junior developers and promote a culture of continuous improvement

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field.
* 5\+ years of full\-stack development experience with demonstrated leadership
* 4\+ years backend experience with Java (preferably Java 17/21\) and Spring Boot
* 3\+ years frontend experience with Angular (14\+) or React (18\+)
* Strong understanding of REST, HTTP, and API integration best practices
* Experience with both SQL and NoSQL databases
* Familiarity with message brokers like ActiveMQ or Kafka
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD workflows and version control (Git, GitLab)
* Excellent communication skills and proven ability to work effectively within cross\-functional Agile teams
* Demonstrated experience with code reviews, technical documentation, and delivering high\-quality software

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience with AWS, Docker, or Kubernetes
* Familiarity with monitoring/logging tools (ELK, Prometheus, Grafana)
* Experience with IntelliJ IDEA

jobs.title: DEVELOPER L4
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** DEVELOPER L4
  
**City:** Istanbul
  
**State/Province:** Istanbul
  
**Posting Start Date:** 9/15/26
  
**Wipro Limited (NYSE:** WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future\-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever\-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.
  
  

Role Purpose
  
  

The purpose of this role is to design, test and maintain software programs for operating systems or applications which needs to be deployed at a client end and ensure its meet 100% quality assurance parameters
  
  

͏
  
  

Do
  
  

1\. Instrumental in understanding the requirements and design of the product/ software
  
  

Develop software solutions by studying information needs, studying systems flow, data usage and work processes
  
Investigating problem areas followed by the software development life cycle
  
Facilitate root cause analysis of the system issues and problem statement
  
Identify ideas to improve system performance and impact availability
  
Analyze client requirements and convert requirements to feasible design
  
Collaborate with functional teams or systems analysts who carry out the detailed investigation into software requirements
  
Conferring with project managers to obtain information on software capabilities
  
͏
  
  

2\. Perform coding and ensure optimal software/ module development
  
  

Determine operational feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, software development and proposed software
  
Develop and automate processes for software validation by setting up and designing test cases/scenarios/usage cases, and executing these cases
  
Modifying software to fix errors, adapt it to new hardware, improve its performance, or upgrade interfaces.
  
Analyzing information to recommend and plan the installation of new systems or modifications of an existing system
  
Ensuring that code is error free or has no bugs and test failure
  
Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities and status
  
Ensure all the codes are raised as per the norm defined for project / program / account with clear description and replication patterns
  
Compile timely, comprehensive and accurate documentation and reports as requested
  
Coordinating with the team on daily project status and progress and documenting it
  
Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned stakeholders
  
͏
  
  

3\. Status Reporting and Customer Focus on an ongoing basis with respect to project and its execution
  
  

Capturing all the requirements and clarifications from the client for better quality work
  
Taking feedback on the regular basis to ensure smooth and on time delivery
  
Participating in continuing education and training to remain current on best practices, learn new programming languages, and better assist other team members.
  
Consulting with engineering staff to evaluate software\-hardware interfaces and develop specifications and performance requirements
  
Document and demonstrate solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code
  
Documenting very necessary details and reports in a formal way for proper understanding of software from client proposal to implementation
  
Ensure good quality of interaction with customer w.r.t. e\-mail content, fault report tracking, voice calls, business etiquette etc
  
Timely Response to customer requests and no instances of complaints either internally or externally
  
͏
  
  

Deliver
  
  

No. Performance Parameter Measure
  
1\. Continuous Integration, Deployment \& Monitoring of Software 100% error free on boarding \& implementation, throughput %, Adherence to the schedule/ release plan
  
2\. Quality \& CSAT On\-Time Delivery, Manage software, Troubleshoot queries, Customer experience, completion of assigned certifications for skill upgradation
  
3\. MIS \& Reporting 100% on time MIS \& report generation
  
  

**Mandatory Skills:** .NET .
  
  

**Experience:** 5\-8 Years .
  
  

Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end\-to\-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA \- as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

* **Frontend**

	+ Expert knowledge of:
	
	
		- React.js

		- Hooks

	+ Good hands\-on experience with Node.js.

		- RESTful APIs

		- JSON

		- JWT / OAuth2

	+ Experience integrating with complex third\-party APIs and external platforms.
	+ Understanding of backend service architecture and microservices is preferred.**FinTech Experience**

		- Deposits
		- Withdrawals

		- Transaction status handling

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Senior QA Engineer to become our first dedicated internal QA professional and take ownership of quality across our products and services. This is a hands\-on, technical role with significant ownership. Our systems are primarily backend and API\-driven, so your focus will be on backend, API, integration, and end\-to\-end testing rather than simply testing the UI. You’ll work closely with developers and DevOps to understand how our systems work, identify risks early, investigate complex issues, improve test coverage, and ensure that releases are ready for production.

  

  

As our first dedicated QA hire, you’ll also have the opportunity to shape how QA is done across the company — from test strategy and automation to processes, tooling, and release quality. We’re looking for someone technical, pragmatic, and curious who enjoys going beyond the UI to investigate APIs, databases, logs, infrastructure, and real\-world system behavior.

  

  

**Your Day\-to\-Day Responsibilities:**


* Own and continuously improve our **QA strategy, processes, and testing approach**.
* Plan and execute **manual, exploratory, regression, integration, API, and end\-to\-end testing**.
* Test **REST APIs and end\-to\-end business flows** using Postman, cURL, or similar tools.
* Review requirements early and identify **risks, edge cases, ambiguities, and missing scenarios**.
* Define and maintain **test plans, regression coverage, and release criteria**.
* Build and maintain **automated regression and end\-to\-end tests** using Playwright or similar frameworks.
* Investigate and troubleshoot issues using **application logs, databases, metrics, and monitoring tools**.
* Work with **GCP and Azure** environments and cloud logging/monitoring tools.
* Use **SQL** to validate data and investigate issues, ideally with PostgreSQL.
* Collaborate closely with **developers and DevOps** on defects, environments, deployments, and technical investigations.
* Reproduce, isolate, document, and follow up on issues through to resolution.
* Provide **QA approval, risk assessment, and release readiness recommendations** for production releases.
* Help establish practical **QA standards, processes, and best practices** across the company.
  

  

**Skills We Cannot Do Without:**


* **3\+ years of QA experience** or equivalent senior\-level experience.
* Strong hands\-on experience with **backend/API, integration, manual, regression, and exploratory testing**.
* Experience owning **test strategy, test planning, regression coverage, and release readiness**.
* Strong experience testing **REST APIs and end\-to\-end business flows** using Postman, cURL, or similar tools.
* Ability to identify **risks, edge cases, and missing scenarios** during requirements and technical reviews.
* Experience building and maintaining **automated regression and end\-to\-end tests**, using Playwright or similar frameworks.
* Good **SQL skills**, ideally with PostgreSQL.
* Strong troubleshooting skills and experience working with **logs, databases, metrics, and monitoring tools**.
* Experience with **cloud environments, logging, and monitoring**, particularly GCP and Azure.
* Good understanding of **HTTP, REST, authentication, and distributed systems**.
* Programming/scripting experience, ideally with **JavaScript/TypeScript or similar**.
* Comfortable working closely with **developers and DevOps** on technical investigations and releases.
* Ability to make **QA approval and risk\-based release recommendations**.
* Strong communication skills in **Greek and English**.
  

  

**Nice to Have:**


* Experience with **Cloudflare, Elasticsearch**, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with **gRPC, Docker, Docker Compose, Linux, and VMs**.
* Experience with **performance/load testing** and basic security testing.
* Experience testing **mobile applications, cross\-browser compatibility, or web accessibility**.
* Experience with **physical devices, hardware\-integrated systems, or IoT**.
* Familiarity with **Node.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, or .NET** environments.

jobs.title: SAP Domain Architect Supply Chain Management (SCM)
jobs.description:
Ypto recherche de nouveaux collègues. Vous souhaitez renforcer nos équipes? Découvrez l'offre d'emploi ci\-dessous et postulez.

  

Please apply via the following link: https://ypto.recruitee.com/o/sap\-domain\-architect\-supply\-chain\-management\-scm


**Comment pouvez\-vous faire la différence ?**
----------------------------------------------

  

**About the shERPa Project**
  

NMBS is undergoing a company\-wide transformation through the shERPa program, implementing SAP S/4HANA as a greenfield solution. This program will standardize processes, improve operational efficiency, and enable digital transformation across all business units — including Supply Chain, Rolling Stock maintenance, Infrastructure and Operations.


**Quel est votre rôle à la SNCB ?**
-----------------------------------

  

**Job Purpose**


We are seeking a highly experienced Senior SAP Domain Architect Supply Chain Management (SCM) to define and lead the target architecture for NMBS’s end\-to\-end supply chain processes. This includes Demand en Supply Planning across all planning horizons (log\-, mid\- and short term), Inventory \& Warehouse Management, Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P), Logistics Execution, and the Maintenance Supply Chain — all in the unique context of NMBS responsible for safety\-critical materials, rolling stock availability, Finance, HR and Customer Relations.
  

You will design the future\-state SCM architecture on SAP S/4HANA, ensuring strong integration with Maintenance (PM), Finance, Engineering, and NMBS's depot logistics. You will guide complex transformations and support NMBS in building a resilient, transparent, and regulatory\-compliant supply chain.

  

This vacancy is for a payroll profile

  

**Key Responsibilities**


* Define the S/4HANA SCM target architecture tailored to NMBS’s depot operations, rolling stock maintenance flows, critical spare parts management, and logistics constraints.
* Lead full lifecycle S/4HANA SCM implementations as Domain Architect.
* Own solution design for Inventory Management (IM), , Warehouse Management (Stock room management/EWM), Transportation Management (TM) and SAP Business Network for Supply Chain.
* Optional Integrated Business Planning (IBP), Manufacturing and integration with PM
  

Architecture integrations with all the relevant systems within SCM and S/4HANA
  

Model processes and enterprise capabilities with ADOIT or ARIS for governance and compliance.
* Lead workshops with senior stakeholders (Supply Chain, Rolling Stock, Infrastructure Engineering, Finance).
* Oversee the results of the delivery teams, validate design decisions, and ensure adherence to future\-state architecture.
* Guide integration supporting safety\-critical stocking policies, long lead\-time parts, multi\-depot inventory, and material traceability.
* Support project execution using ServiceNow, Jira, Xray, Cloud ALM and Solution Manager.
**Un job fait pour vous ?**
---------------------------

  

* The candidate demonstrates proficiency at CEFR level C1 or C2 in Dutch or French, and at least CEFR level B1 in English.
* The candidate has a minimum of **15 years of professional experience** in SAP Supply Chain Management including SAP MM (basic), Inventory Management (IM), Warehouse Management (WM or EWM), mobile warehouse solutions, automated warehousing solutions, Transportation Management, and integration with SAP Plant Maintenance (PM).
* The candidate has led at least **one full lifecycle SAP S/4HANA** implementation project in the role of Domain Architect, supported by evidence in the CV or project references.
* The candidate has professional experience in at least one asset\-intensive, logistics\-intensive, or regulated industry (e.g. rail, utilities, or MRO).
* The candidate demonstrates **professional experience** with SAP Ariba and/or supplier collaboration platforms.
* The candidate demonstrates **advanced professional experience** with the enterprise architecture tools ADOIT and/or ARIS.
* The candidate confirms availability to work onsite in Brussels (near Brussels\-Midi station) at least two days per week.
  

**Diversity Statement**


Everyone is unique. That's why we believe it’s important that you can be yourself — It makes SNCB stronger. We therefore place great value on diversity and inclusion.


**Qu'avons\-nous à vous offrir ?**
----------------------------------

  

Choosing Ypto means choosing to contribute to the digital transformation of the Belgian railways. You will have a job with social impact and ample opportunity to make your own contribution. Alongside a healthy work\-life balance and a competitive salary, we offer:


* Hybrid working, with a balanced weekly mix of office and remote work, combined with flexible hours.
* 35 days of annual leave.
* A mobility package with a company car (also available via our mobility plan) or alternative mobility choices, complemented by a public transport season ticket.
* A target bonus.
* A comprehensive insurance package, with hospitalisation and dental care for the whole family.
* Coverage of outpatient medical costs.
* Group insurance, including a supplementary pension (cafeteria plan).
* Meal vouchers \& eco vouchers.
* Net allowances for hybrid working and an internet allowance.
**Où allez\-vous travailler ?**
-------------------------------

  

You will work near Brussels\-South station.


**What’s next ?**
-----------------

  

* You apply online : https://ypto.recruitee.com/o/sap\-domain\-architect\-supply\-chain\-management\-scm


* We take a close look at your CV and check whether it matches the profile you are looking for. We may call you briefly to ask about your motivation and experience.


* We invite you for a first (online) HR interview where you can demonstrate your motivation, experience and expectations.


* If the first interview is positive, we invite you for a second (technical) interview in Brussels. This interview will be with the team, where we’ll discuss the role and how your skills align with the team’s needs.


* If everything goes well, we will make you a contract offer.


* You start your new job!

  

We reserve the right to adjust or pause this procedure if necessary. Our recruitment team will select the profiles that best match the job requirements to ensure an optimal fit.


**Avez\-vous encore des questions?**
------------------------------------

jobs.title: OSI PI Engineer
jobs.description:
De functie combineert technische expertise in PI AF en PI Vision met een sterke focus op data\-contextualisatie, GxP\-compliance en betrouwbare dataflows. Vanuit een zelfstandige rol werk je nauw samen met het manufacturingteam, het PI\-team en de system owner.


**Wat ga je doen?**
-------------------


### **PI AF\-configuratie \& data\-contextualisatie**


Je configureert PI AF (Asset Framework) om data uit de manufacturingprocessen op een gestructureerde en betekenisvolle manier te contextualiseren. De configuraties worden afgestemd op de specifieke noden van de productieomgeving en ondersteunen een betrouwbare verwerking en interpretatie van procesdata.


Daarnaast werk je mee aan de monitoring van Run2Run\-processen via PI Vision\-displays. Hierbij ligt de focus op de front\-end en op het overzichtelijk beschikbaar maken van relevante productie\-informatie voor de gebruikers.


### **Validatie \& change management**


Je valideert ontwikkelde PI AF\-configuraties volgens de geldende GxP\-vereisten en de gedocumenteerde procedures voor PI AF change management. Daarbij zorg je ervoor dat configuraties op een gecontroleerde en gedocumenteerde manier worden voorbereid voor implementatie.


Na validatie implementeer je de configuraties in de PI\-productieomgeving. Wanneer procedures of werkwijzen wijzigen, draag je bij aan het actualiseren en onderhouden van de bestaande PI AF change managementdocumentatie. Afstemming met het manufacturingteam, het PI\-team en de system owner vormt hierbij een belangrijk onderdeel van de functie.


**Wie ben jij?**
----------------


Je beschikt over een masterdiploma of gelijkwaardige technische ervaring en hebt ongeveer 2 tot 5 jaar relevante ervaring opgebouwd binnen een technische of industriële omgeving. Je hebt een sterke kennis van OSI PI, met specifieke expertise in PI AF en PI Vision.


Ervaring binnen een GxP\-productieomgeving is belangrijk, net als een goed begrip van IT/OT\-systemen en de bijhorende datastromen. Je bent in staat om zelfstandig PI AF\-configuraties uit te werken voor concrete requirements en weet daarbij technische noden te vertalen naar een praktische en betrouwbare oplossing.


Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands en Engels. Kennis van Lean\-principes en ervaring met agile werkwijzen of tools zoals Jira en Confluence zijn een pluspunt.


**Wat maakt deze rol uniek?**
-----------------------------


* **Directe impact op manufacturing:** de PI AF\-configuraties en PI Vision\-oplossingen ondersteunen de datagedreven werking van de productieomgeving.
* **Techniek binnen een gereguleerde context:** de combinatie van OSI PI, GxP\-validatie en change management zorgt voor een uitdagende technische omgeving waarin kwaliteit en compliance centraal staan.
* **Zelfstandige verantwoordelijkheid:** de functie biedt ruimte om PI AF\-configuraties zelfstandig uit te werken en van validatie tot implementatie op te volgen.
* **Sterke samenwerking tussen disciplines:** je vormt de technische schakel tussen manufacturing, het PI\-team en de system owner.

**Laat je carrière knallen bij Enginity**
-----------------------------------------


Bij Enginity draait alles om technische expertise, persoonlijke groei en projecten die écht impact maken binnen industriële omgevingen. Als consultant krijg je de kans om jouw kennis in te zetten bij toonaangevende klanten, terwijl je blijft bouwen aan je eigen traject.


### **De kracht achter de knal**


Enginity maakt deel uit van de Cronos Groep en combineert de slagkracht van een sterk netwerk met de persoonlijke aanpak van een hecht team.


### **Kies je eigen traject**


Geen standaardpad, maar een carrière die mee evolueert met jouw ambities. Samen bekijken we welke projecten, opleidingen en uitdagingen aansluiten bij je expertise en groeidoelen.


### **Brandstof om vooruit te gaan**


Via gerichte begeleiding, kennisdeling en opleidingsmogelijkheden blijf je jezelf ontwikkelen in zowel technische als soft skills. Zo krijg je de ruimte om je expertise verder te verdiepen en breder inzetbaar te worden.


### **Meer dan collega’s: een familie**


Enginity staat voor een toegankelijke cultuur waarin mensen elkaar kennen, ondersteunen en versterken. We spreken niet voor niets over onze Enginity Family.


### **Hier geldt: 1 \+ 1 \= 3**


Door technische kennis, ondernemerschap en samenwerking te bundelen, ontstaan oplossingen die verder gaan dan het individuele project. Samen maken we het verschil bij klanten én binnen het team.


### **Klaar om te schitteren?**

jobs.title: Senior .NET Developer (Aftermarket Applications)
jobs.description:
**Your role**
-------------

We are looking for a passionate and committed Senior Backend .NET Developer.


You will be part of our internal software development team working in the Aftermarket domain. This surrounds applications for providing technical support, processing warranty, tools for our Field Service Engineer, our back office (planning and order processing), spare part list applications and Serialized Information Management.


As such you will be responsible for technical application ownership and developments. Next to this you will be involved in the full redesign of our existing applications and creation of new applications as business needs arise in our Customer Centers.


You will have the opportunity to work with a highly motivated international business and software developer team in a challenging and very dynamic environment.


You build the back\-end behind our operational applications, not the screens in front of it. Your initial focus is the system that links as\-built documentation, bills of material and product definitions to serialized equipment and the installed base which is used by internal teams, by Customer Centers and by dealers, with a growing number of applications depending on its APIs. From there you work across the rest of our backend landscape: warranty automation and order evaluation, engineering change bulletins, maintenance engines and the shared services the whole portfolio runs on.


Your working level is domain models, APIs, events and data: what a service owns, what its contract promises, which events it publishes, and how its data is shaped so that it still answers the questions we will ask of it in three years. You work in an agile team with developers, architects and a product owner, shaping design decisions rather than only implementing them.


The work here is engineering, not configuration. We build on C\# and .NET (8 or later) on Azure: Function Apps and App Services for compute, Kafka and Azure Service Bus for the event streams that feed us, and a deliberately mixed data layer SQL for the queryable subset, a graph store for the relationships between equipment, components and product definitions. Services run behind private endpoints with managed identity and RBAC, ship through Azure DevOps pipelines with infrastructure as code, and are instrumented with Application Insights.


**To succeed, you will need**
-----------------------------

You have built back\-end systems that other teams and other applications depend on, ideally in an operational or business\-critical context where downtime is measured in stopped work rather than a slow page. You think in trade\-offs rather than absolutes, and you keep digging until you know why something failed, not just that it did. You work comfortably in an agile team, have the confidence to say in refinement that something cannot be built the way it is specified, and use AI tooling with the judgement to verify what it produces. This is a senior role: we expect you to own a domain end to end and make decisions the rest of the team builds on.


You will not have every item on the list below. Cover most of the must\-haves and be genuinely curious about the rest.


**Must\-have**

* **C\# / .NET (8 or later, moving to .NET 10\):** recent, hands\-on experience building production\-grade applications, not prototypes, at a level where you own a service end to end.
* **Azure:** practical experience with several of: Function Apps, App Services, Service Bus, Event Hubs, Blob Storage, Azure SQL, Key Vault, API Management, Application Insights.
* **REST API design and implementation:** designing and consuming well\-structured, versioned APIs, and thinking about the contract before the code.
* **SQL databases:** data modelling, query performance, and integrating relational data into cloud applications.
* **Testing as part of development:** unit and integration testing as a habit, not a separate phase handed to someone else.
* **Experience migrating .NET Framework systems to modern .NET and retiring what they replaced.**

**Strong plus**

* **Apache Kafka:** consuming event streams from systems you do not control, and living with what they send you.
* **Graph databases:** Neo4j or equivalent, and the modelling instinct for when a relationship belongs in a graph rather than a join table.
* **Secure\-by\-default cloud development:** managed identity, private endpoints, RBAC and secret management as normal practice.
* **Observability:** structured logging, tracing, alerting, and being on the hook for a system you built.
* **Domain\-driven design:** bounded contexts and aggregates applied to a real domain rather than a textbook one.
* **Microservice architecture:** service boundaries, inter\-service contracts, and the operational cost of getting them wrong.
* **Event\-driven and message\-based architecture:** queues, topics, event streams, and the practical problems that come with them: ordering, idempotency, at\-least\-once delivery, replay, poison messages.
* **CI/CD with Azure DevOps:** YAML pipelines, release management, and infrastructure as code (Bicep, Terraform or ARM).

**In return, we offer**
-----------------------

At Atlas Copco Group you will join an international and diverse environment with specialists from different disciplines. Our culture is rooted in Swedish values, which includes a family feeling, respect and diversity. We invest in our employees' development and well\-being, and we provide a flexible work\-life balance. With our inclusive and caring environment, you get the support and inspiration you need to grow. Here, your ideas are embraced, and you never stop learning.


You will have a comprehensive onboarding program, including guidance by a personal godmother/godfather. You will also have access to global job opportunities, as part of the Atlas Copco Group. We offer an interesting compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, paid leave and retirement benefits.


**Job location**
----------------

This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on\-site at Airpower in Antwerp, Belgium (BE).

Functional area: Information Technology

jobs.title: Senior Netwerk Engineer
jobs.description:
**Tabaknatie is een logistieke dienstverlener in de Antwerpse haven, gespecialiseerd in de opslag en behandeling van goederen voor internationale klanten. Zowel op rechter\- als op linkeroever beschikken wij over gespecialiseerde magazijnen met een totale oppervlakte van meer dan 1\.000\.000m². Als Senior Netwerk Engineer maak je deel uit van ons IT\-departement en ga je aan de slag op ons hoofdkantoor in het centrum van Antwerpen.****WAT GA JE DOEN?**
===================


* Je bent binnen het team het aanspreekpunt voor het netwerk: van de core\-en access\-switchen in de kantoren en magazijnen tot de firewalls, WiFi\-dekking en de connectiviteit tussen onze sites.
* Je beheert, bewaakt en optimaliseert deze omgeving, en je werkt mee aan projecten zoals vernieuwingen, uitbreidingen en migraties.
* Operationeel beheer van de netwerkinfrastructuur: switching, routing, firewalling, WiFi en VPN.
* Opvolgen van incidenten en changes, inclusief root cause\-analyse en structurele oplossingen.
* Bewaken van documentatie, configuratiestandaarden en netwerkbeveiliging.
* Uitvoeren en begeleiden van projecten: van voorbereiding en planning tot implementatie en oplevering.
* Coachen van een junior collega: je neemt hem of haar stap voor stap mee in de netwerkmaterie en maakt van kennisoverdracht een vaste gewoonte.
* In het kader van NIS2, het mee bewaken van de netwerkbeveiliging: segmentatie, firewallbeleid, toegangsbeheer en hardening.

Je takenpakket stopt niet aan de grens van het netwerk. Je volgt actief de markt op voor nieuwe trends om mee te helpen bouwen van de roadmap. Afhankelijk van de noden van de organisatie schuif je mee aan bij bredere ondersteuning van de operationele teams op de werkvloer. Omdat onze operatie ook buiten de klassieke kantooruren doorloopt, ben je bereid om occasioneel onderhoud, upgrades en interventies vroeg ‘s ochtends, ‘s avonds of in het weekend uit te voeren. Ingrepen worden vooraf gepland en in overleg met het team afgesproken.
**WIE ZOEKEN WE?**
==================


Je hebt ruime ervaring als netwerk engineer en je weet waarover je praat. Je bouwt je advies op ervaring, onderzoek en overleg met je collega’s, niet op aannames. Daarnaast geef je graag je kennis door en hebt het geduld om een junior collega te laten groeien in plaats van het werk zelf over te nemen.
**Je beschikt ook over:**
=========================


* Ervaring met Cisco\-netwerkapparatuur is een must, net als aantoonbare ervaring in operationeel netwerkbeheer. Ervaring met Palo Alto\-firewalls is een plus.
* Kennis van of ervaring met informatieveiligheidsnormen zoals ISO 27001 of regelgeving zoals NIS2 is een plus.
* Een gestructureerde werking: je documenteert, plant je werk en houdt overzicht, ook wanneer er meerdere zaken tegelijk lopen.
* Een pragmatische en rustige houding. Bij een storing verlies je je kalmte niet en ga je methodisch te werk.
* Een professionele en heldere communicatiestijl, ook richting hoger management: je vertaalt techniek naar begrijpelijke taal, impact en opties. Dit in het Nederlands, maar ook Engels is een must.
* Een flexibele ingesteldheid en pakt daardoor aan wat nodig is, ook als het buiten je strikte specialisatie valt.
* Kennis van of ervaring in een magazijn\-, transport– of logistieke omgeving is een plus.
* Een rijbewijs B, om je te kunnen verplaatsen naar de verschillende sites en hoofdkantoren verspreid in de Haven van Antwerpen.

**Waarom voor Tabaknatie werken?**
==================================


Bij Tabaknatie zal je deel uitmaken van een hechte familie van getalenteerde professionals die elkaar ondersteunen en aanmoedigen om gezamenlijk grenzen te verleggen. We geloven in het creëren van een omgeving waarin iedereen zich gewaardeerd voelt en waar individuele groei en ontwikkeling worden gestimuleerd. Als wereldleider zijn we voortdurend in beweging, en dat houdt ons werk boeiend en uitdagend. Geen dag is hetzelfde bij Tabaknatie, en dat maakt ons uniek in onze branche. We omarmen verandering en innovatie, waardoor onze medewerkers de kans krijgen om hun vaardigheden te ontwikkelen en nieuwe mogelijkheden te ontdekken. Kiezen voor een carrière bij Tabaknatie betekent kiezen voor een werkplek waar je je gewaardeerd voelt, waar je kunt groeien en waar je deel uitmaakt van een familie die zich inzet voor succes. Sluit je aan bij ons team en ervaar zelf waarom onze medewerkers zo trots zijn om bij Tabaknatie te werken.

jobs.title: ATS Research Fellowship: Applied Physics and Engineering
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, physicists and engineers are probing the fundamental structure of the universe. Using the world's largest and most complex scientific instruments, they study the basic constituents of matter \- fundamental particles that are made to collide together at close to the speed of light. The process gives physicists clues about how particles interact, and provides insights into the fundamental laws of nature. Find out more on http://home.cern.ch

*Diversity has been an integral part of CERN's mission since its foundation and is an established value of the Organization.*

 **Job Description** **Job Overview:**


We are offering one post\-doctoral research position in the field of applied physics and engineering. The successful candidates will be working in the Accelerator Systems departments of CERN. They will be performing research in the field of Accelerator Physics and System Design, including but not limited to:  

* Design, develop and optimise beam transfer systems supporting CERN's accelerator complex and future accelerator projects.
* Perform accelerator physics studies, including beam optics design, particle tracking and multi\-physics simulations, to support system design, validation and performance optimisation.
* Develop functional specifications for beam transfer systems based on accelerator physics requirements and engineering constraints.
* Develop and implement modern commissioning strategies using automation, numerical optimisation and data\-driven techniques.
* Analyse beam and system performance to improve beam quality, operational efficiency and system reliability.
**Candidate Profile:**

* You have a strong background in applied physics, engineering or a closely related field.
* You have research experience in applied physics and engineering, ideally linked to the design, development or operation of experimental systems.
* You are interested in pursuing a career in research or academia and in taking an active role within a research project.
* You are motivated to contribute to large\-scale experimental programmes in an international research environment.

**Technical Skills:**

* You have strong analytical and problem\-solving skills applied to experimental systems and technologies.
* You are able to work collaboratively within large, international and multidisciplinary teams.
* You communicate effectively in a scientific and technical environment.
* You are able to work independently while contributing to shared project objectives.
* Your PhD is in the fields of Applied Physics and Engineering.

 **Additional Information**

Do you enjoy solving complex engineering challenges rather than building standard web pages? At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

Your role Bring your specialist knowledge and experience to a company managing 50% of the world’s MIPS and play a critical role in our modernization mission. You’ll be in good company among our global community of experts leading the future of mainframe modernization. Experts who share knowledge openly and collaborate freely. In this role, you’ll design, build and maintain the high\-volume business logic that runs on the mainframe. At the same time you’ll play a key role in refactoring legacy code to enable modern cloud and mobile applications to seamlessly interact with the mainframe’s core data. What you will do Maintain Performance •Prevent decay and find efficiencies: Monitor the architecture and identify opportunities to optimize code to maintain and enhance mainframe performance. Debug and Test •Find and fix: Debug, troubleshoot, and analyze complex system interactions to keep mission\-critical applications running. Develop for the Future •Bridge the gap: As an instrumental player in modernization, you’ll extract business logic from legacy systems for migration or integration with cloud\-based services.  

  

**Who You Are**

Required skills and experience •Experience working as a software engineer on complex software projects. •Excellent coding skills and solid development experience (Java, Python, .Net etc.) with debugging and problem\-solving skills. •Software development methodologies, with demonstrated experience developing scalable and robust software. •Experienced in relational and NoSQL databases, data mapping, XML/JSON, REST\-based web services. •Knowledge of architecture design \- Microservices architecture, containers (Docker \& k8s), messaging queues. •Deep understanding of OOP and design patterns. Preferred skills and experience •Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. •Certification in one or more of the hyperscalers (Azure, AWS, and Google GCP) \- otherwise, you can obtain certifications with Kyndryl. •Experience with DevOps tools and modern engineering practices.  

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. WSP is at the forefront of delivering the next generation of electricity network infrastructure. As demand for cleaner, more resilient power systems continues to grow, we're expanding our Primary Substation capability and are looking for Engineers, Senior Engineers and Associate's and Associate Director's to join us.


Working on nationally significant projects, including programmes supporting the Great Grid Upgrade, you'll contribute to the design and delivery of high\-voltage substations that will help connect renewable generation, strengthen network resilience and support the UK's net zero ambitions.


Responsibilities:


* Produce a comprehensive suite of design drawings for Grid and Primary substations.

* Produce substation design feasibility reports, cost estimate, layouts, GA’s as well as the preparation of plant specifications that include transformers, switchgear and battery systems.

* Ensure project design works are aligned with programme, quality, and margin.
* Actively developing external and internal client relationships.

Preparing specifications for HV and EHV substation equipment including the evaluation and identification of plant accessories such as CT’s, battery systems and terminations.

* Exposure to substation cable design and protection and control.
* Experience of small, medium and technically complex new substation, retrofit or network reinforcement projects.

With over 11,000 professionals across the UK and Ireland, we are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower.


**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?**

**Work\-life balance**

At WSP, we understand that work is just one aspect of your life. It’s important to make time for you, your family, friends, interests and your community.


Our hybrid working policy offers the flexibility to work from home two days a week, while also providing opportunities to collaborate in our modern offices across the UK.

We celebrate integrity and treat people with respect, supporting each other and embracing a culture of inclusion and belonging at WSP. new_jobs.title: Digital Product Engineer
new_jobs.description:
### **About the company**


First Line Software works with some of the world's top businesses and organizations in industries like healthcare, data engineering, warehouse automation, retail digitalization, mobile app development, and e\-commerce. Our projects are as varied as our people, and our people are as talented as they come. We prefer working as a transparent and supportive team, who shares our knowledge as well as our success.
  

  

Let's see what we can create together!

### **The project and your role**


Our client is rebuilding its guest\-facing digital estate on a modern microservices architecture moving away from a fragmented collection of out\-of\-the\-box portals toward a purpose\-built digital platform that delivers personalised, seamless guest experiences across discovery, booking, pre\-stay, and in\-stay touchpoints. As a Digital Product Engineer, you'll build the digital products guests and staff use every day, working on a React/Next.js front\-end and a back\-end of independently deployable .NET 8 / ASP.NET Core microservices hosted on AWS.

* Build and maintain guest\-facing features in React and Next.js — search, the booking funnel, conversion optimisation, and promotional campaign delivery, in partnership with commercial and marketing teams
* Deliver logged\-in guest journeys on the guest portal, including pre\-stay upsell, activity booking, and in\-stay engagement
* Contribute to loyalty platform features — enrolment flows, member personalisation, and loyalty mechanics
* Design and build .NET 8 / ASP.NET Core microservices — REST APIs, domain logic, and integrations with core booking, CMS, and contact\-center systems
* Deploy and operate microservices on AWS using Lambda and ECS/Fargate, choosing the right hosting model per service
* Implement event\-driven communication between services using AWS SQS, SNS, and EventBridge
* Design RESTful APIs to agreed standards, including OpenAPI specifications, versioning, and documentation
* Write unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests, and ship through CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
* Participate in code reviews with nearshore engineering partners and take ownership of your services in production, including incident response

### **Your skills**

* 2\+ years of software engineering experience spanning front\-end and back\-end development
* Hands\-on, production experience with React and Next.js — App Router, server components, SSR/SSG
* Hands\-on, production experience with .NET (Core/.NET 5\+) and C\#; .NET 8 / ASP.NET Core strongly preferred
* TypeScript across the stack
* Demonstrable experience building and deploying microservices on AWS (Lambda and/or ECS/Fargate)
* Experience with RESTful API design in a microservices architecture
* Experience working in agile sprint teams, ideally alongside nearshore or offshore engineering partners
* Consumer\-facing product experience — eCommerce, hospitality, travel, or retail preferred
* English language proficiency for technical documentation and team communication

**Nice to have:**

* Experience integrating LLMs or conversational AI (OpenAI API or equivalent)
* WhatsApp Business API or Amazon Connect experience
* Familiarity with hospitality CRS/PMS systems

### **What we can offer**

* Our modern stack projects are the right mix of exciting and challenging
* Gain access to our diverse range of training programs, courses, and certifications
* Choose your work style — this role is hybrid, with 3 days a week in the office
* Enhance your language skills with our corporate English classes
* Work from anywhere and explore the world with our Workation program

new_jobs.title: Application Support Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Application Support Engineer


Help keep public transport moving.


We’re looking for a hands\-on Application Support Engineer to support and improve the systems behind real\-time passenger information, fleet monitoring and service operations. You’ll investigate issues that matter to customers and operators, take ownership through to resolution, and work closely with engineering teams to make our products more reliable.


Our platforms are used around the world to deliver accurate arrival information, manage vehicle fleets and communicate disruption updates to passengers. Built around Vix Horizon, BusNet and the new Beacon cloud platforms, our systems are increasingly cloud\-native on AWS.


What you’ll do* Provide second\- and third\-line support for internal and external customers.
* Investigate, diagnose and resolve application, data and connectivity incidents, using ITIL\-aligned processes.
* Own incidents from initial triage through to resolution, communicating clearly on progress, risk and impact.
* Escalate effectively to engineering, partners or other teams when needed.
* Use the command line to investigate remote devices, services and integrations.
* Support and improve applications, data feeds, cloud platforms and operational tooling.
* Build useful knowledge articles and share insight across the support team.
* Work with development and cross\-functional teams to improve performance, reliability and deployment.
* Contribute ideas that make the service—and the customer experience—better.


What you’ll bring* Proven experience in application support, technical operations or a similar hands\-on environment.
* Experience working with SIRI SM, VM or SX data feeds, or comparable real\-time data integrations.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across Windows, Windows Server and embedded Linux/Unix environments.
* Practical experience investigating remote or embedded devices, including GPRS/3G/4G connectivity and single\-board computers.
* Familiarity with AWS and cloud platforms, including Beacon, and an interest in developing deeper cloud expertise.
* Confidence with SQL and databases, plus an understanding of HTML, CSS and XML.
* Working knowledge of C\# or Python.
* A practical understanding of ITIL, incident management and service improvement.
* Clear communication skills: you can explain technical issues to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


The person we’re looking for
You’re curious, calm under pressure and motivated by finding the root cause. You take ownership, work well independently and know when to bring in the right people. You’re adaptable, collaborative and focused on delivering a great customer outcome—not simply closing a ticket.


This role is predominantly home\-based, with occasional travel to our offices in Manchester and Cambridge. There will also be an on\-call rota, including some out\-of\-hours and occasional weekend cover.

Alongside the opportunity to work for a global, customer\- and people\-focused company, we offer:

* A great team of like\-minded professionals.
* Private healthcare.
* Income protection scheme.
* Pension.
* Group life assurance.
* Cycle to Work scheme.
* Electric Vehicle Benefit scheme.
* Employee Assistance Programme.
* Eyecare vouchers.


Sounds good? Apply now and get on board.


Please include anything else that demonstrates why you would be a great addition to the team. This role is open to UK citizens or residents with an indefinite right to remain and current full\-time right to work in the UK.


No recruitment agencies, please—we will not accept any introductions.


Vix Technology is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind and are committed to equal employment opportunity for all. We aim to build a workforce as diverse as the communities we serve, creating an inclusive environment where everyone can realise their full potential.

new_jobs.description:
Civil Engineering
UKIMEA Region

GLA00007P Requisition \#  

Graduate Civil Engineer


See it differently \- Early Careers at Arup


See it differently


You see the world through a unique lens and that’s exactly what we need. We embrace how you see things differently – it’s essential for creating a sustainable future.


Arup is a global consultancy with advisory and technical expertise across more than 150 disciplines. We guide, plan and design the future of the built environment. Globally, each year we recruit hundreds of graduates and students who help us see things differently and solve the most complex challenges facing our clients, climate and communities.


The Opportunity


Our Civil Engineering team works at the heart of the energy transition, helping to deliver the infrastructure needed to connect renewable energy and improve the resilience of electricity networks. We support major projects across offshore wind, transmission and distribution, energy storage, HVDC infrastructure and pumped storage hydro. As a graduate engineer, you will work alongside experienced specialists and gain hands\-on experience in the planning, design and delivery of civil infrastructure, including site development, earthworks, drainage, highways and access arrangements. You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, use industry\-leading digital tools and contribute to projects that have a lasting impact on the UK's net\-zero ambitions.


Contribute to the planning, design and delivery of major energy infrastructure projects, including offshore wind, transmission networks, substations, HVDC schemes and energy storage developments.


Support the development of civil engineering designs for earthworks, drainage, highways, access roads, foundations and site infrastructure using industry\-leading digital tools.


Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams of engineers, environmental specialists, planners and project managers to develop integrated engineering solutions.


Undertake technical assessments, engineering calculations, site investigations and preparation of reports, drawings and project deliverables.


Develop professional and technical skills through structured training, mentoring and hands\-on project experience while supporting the delivery of sustainable infrastructure that enables the energy transition.


https://www.arup.com/services/civil\-engineering/


https://www.arup.com/markets/energy/energy\-storage/


https://www.arup.com/markets/energy/transmission\-distribution/


Is this role right for you?


For this opportunity, we are seeking the following qualifications, skills and attributes: Masters level in relevant academic discipline, such as Civil Engineering, Construction Management; Ground / Geotechnical Engineering; Structural Engineering.


Skills and experience in Civil Engineering Design Principles; Engineering Drawing Interpretation; AutoCAD; Geotechnical Engineering Fundamentals; Drainage and Surface Water Design; Earthworks and Highway Design; Structural Engineering Fundamentals; Technical Report Writing; Data Analysis and Visualisation; Problem Solving and Engineering Calculations. Civil 3D; GIS (ArcGIS/QGIS); Microsoft Excel; BIM Awareness (ISO 19650\); Revit (basic understanding);


To be considered for a graduate opportunity, your application must include a copy of your academic transcript and meet the following criteria:


* Full working rights in the country of application
* No more than 12 months of full\-time experience in a comparable role
* Recently graduated, or on track to graduate, from your most recent degree, related to your role of choice, before employment starts.

Alongside your degree, we look for the following core attributes:


* Changemakers: A passion for sustainable development and creating a better world is key.
* Innovative minds: We’re looking for critical thinkers who embrace new ideas and challenge the status quo.
* Growth seekers: You have a growth mindset, always eager to learn and explore new ways of working.
* Adaptable adventurers: You’re ready to take on any challenge that comes your way.

Please note, in the event of high applicant volume, this role may be closed ahead of the advertised closing date. Early application is recommended.
  

  

Eligibility
  

Please note that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Therefore, you must ensure that you are eligible to work permanently in the UK without our sponsorship.


What we offer you


At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.


Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.


We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling permanent members to share in the results of our collective efforts.


We take an approach to flexible working that supports the diversity and wellbeing of our graduates.


We also provide for our permanent members Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.


Next Steps


We've designed our application process to be straightforward and supportive, giving you the opportunity to showcase your skills and potential. Applications are reviewed as they're received, so we encourage you to apply as early as possible.


The process includes an online application, psychometric testing, application review, case study, interview and offer stage. Our friendly Early Careers team is available throughout the process to answer questions and help you feel confident every step of the way.


Different people, shared values


Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas \- this drives our excellence.


Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross\-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ\+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your\-life\-at\-arup. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas.
  

  

We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please contact UKEarlyCareersRecruitment@arup.com to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.
  

  

As a Disability Confident Level 2 Employer in the UK, we will strive for one third of all our interview places to be allocated to candidates who have disclosed they are disability confident and best meet the requirements of the role.

new_jobs.title: Cable Project Engineering Opportunities (EHV)
new_jobs.description:
**Base Location:** For this role, we require successful applicants to be based from one of our Scottish locations \- Glasgow, Perth, Aberdeen or Inverness.


**Salary:** Based on experience \+ car / car allowance \+ performance\-related bonus \+ a range of other benefits to support your family, finances and wellbeing.


**Working Pattern:** Permanent \| Full Time \| Flexible First options available


**The role**



As part of SSEN Transmission Pathway to 2030 programme of works, we have EHV Cable Engineering opportunities at Professional, and Senior level, to join our HVDC Project Engineering team to help drive forward our projects and successfully deliver a network for Net Zero. Our projects include state\-of the\-art AC and DC cable system technology, and traverse marine and terrestrial environments across the UK.



Our Cable Project Engineering roles are key in driving technical excellence, quality of installation, best practice, and resolution to design risks/technical issues. These roles reside within SSEN Transmission’s Offshore Project Engineering Team and primarily focus on HVDC cable projects. Experience with Transmission networks is advantageous, although not essential. We encourage candidates with a project engineering background, ideally with HV/EHV cable engineering background in contractor, consultancy or client organisations to apply.


**You will**


* Support project Front End Engineering Design (FEED) activities such as options assessment, cable route development, landfall selection and risk assessment. This includes interdisciplinary working alongside various teams including environmental and land consenting, geotechnical, civil and offshore installation engineers.


* Promote the safety\-in\-design ethos and discharge these CDM duties on behalf of SSE Transmission As a key member of Designer and Principal Designer teams. This includes risk reduction (technical, quality, health, and safety) to the point of elimination or as low as is reasonably practicable.


* Review and acceptance of Contractor engineering and design deliverables for compliance with Employer's requirements, legislation and safe practice.


* Supervise installation and commissioning works for compliance with Employer's requirements and legislation.


* Support and mentoring of junior engineers, ensuring they are adequately supported throughout traineeship.


**Our** **Senior roles include the following additional responsibilities:**


* Inform the HVDC cable system requirements for Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) Contracts and supporting the tender review process as part of the technical team.


* Coordinate and support the installation and commissioning works for compliance with the Employer’s requirements, legislation – promoting health \& safety.


* Technical leadership, mentorship, and driving excellence within the HVDC Project Engineering team.


* Lead special analytical studies, solves complex and ambiguous problems.


**You have**


* A qualification of minimum BEng/BSc qualification level in a relevant engineering discipline.


* Technical knowledge and experience in holding key technical position(s) during development and delivery of a HVDC or HVAC transmission cable projects.


* Work experience and understanding of EPC contracts and CDM regulations; particularly with respect to roles of Supervisor and Principal Designer.


* Competent awareness and working knowledge of relevant industry standards, specifications and recommendations.


* Excellent communication, time\-management, and organisational skills.


* Experience and enthusiasm for giving mentorship/guidance to junior engineers and building technical excellence within the team and wider business.


**About SSE**



SSE’s purpose is to be restless every day until we make electricity clean, affordable and available for all.



We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. This includes electricity transmission and distribution networks, onshore and offshore wind farms, hydro\-electric power and flexible thermal generation. We also provide products and services for businesses and other customers.



Our investment plan will see SSE invest £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure to 2030\.



SSEN Transmission own and operate the electricity transmission network across the north of Scotland. We transport electricity from where it is generated to where it is needed, ensuring a safe and reliable electricity supply for the communities we serve. But that's not all – we're upgrading the grid to deliver cleaner, homegrown power for the future and building the infrastructure needed for a cleaner electricity system to create secure power for generations to come.


**Flexible benefits to fit your life**



Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest\-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.


**Work with an equal opportunity employer**



SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. please contact Hannah at hannah.e.cutajar@sse.com to discuss how we can support you.



We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry.


**Ready to apply?**



Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. We'll be in touch after the closing date to let you know if we'll be taking your application further. If you're offered a role with SSE, you'll need to complete a criminality check and a credit check before you start work.

new_jobs.description:
**Base Location:** Keadby Power Station


**Salary:** £51,600 \- £77,400 depending on experience \+ performance\-related bonus \+ a range of benefits to support your finances, wellbeing and family.


**Working Pattern:** Permanent \| Full Time

  


**The role**



SSE Thermal are recruiting a Mechanical Engineer to join our engineering team at Keadby Power Station. This role is critical in ensuring the safety, reliability, flexibility, and efficiency of plant operations, while contributing to both short\- and long\-term strategic planning.



As a key member of the team, you will play a pivotal role in asset integrity management, proactive maintenance planning, and project delivery aligned with company and station strategies.


**Some of your main accountabilities will include;**


* Assisting in the strategic management and integrity of mechanical assets across the station.


* Contributing to the implementation of maintenance plans, including resource planning, budgeting, and contractor oversight.


* Managing engineering projects from financial justification through to commissioning, ensuring alignment with SSE and station strategies.


* Maintaining and optimise plant performance with a focus on safety, reliability, and efficiency.


* Providing technical support and maintain accurate engineering records in compliance with legal and company standards.


**To be successful in this role, we would love you to have;**


* A Degree\-level qualification (or equivalent) in a relevant engineering discipline, with previous experience in power station maintenance.


* A strong understanding of SHE standards, NEBOSH certification would be advantageous


* Proficiency in Maximo and other relevant IT tools and financial reporting systems.


* Extensive experience in managing plant overhauls and understanding of power station or process plant operations.


* Demonstrable ability to challenge conventional thinking and implement innovative solutions.


**About SSE**



SSE has a bold ambition – to be a leading energy company in a net zero world. We're investing around £10 million a day in homegrown energy to help power a cleaner, more secure future.



SSE Thermal keep the lights on for millions of people while pioneering low\-carbon technologies. From ground\-breaking carbon capture and storage projects to plans for what might be the world's first hydrogen\-fired power station, we're transforming how we generate energy.


**Flexible benefits to fit your life**



Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest\-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme.
