new_jobs.title: Cable Project Engineering Opportunities (EHV)
new_jobs.description:
**Base Location:** For this role, we require successful applicants to be based from one of our Scottish locations \- Glasgow, Perth, Aberdeen or Inverness.


**Salary:** Based on experience \+ car / car allowance \+ performance\-related bonus \+ a range of other benefits to support your family, finances and wellbeing.


**Working Pattern:** Permanent \| Full Time \| Flexible First options available


**The role**



As part of SSEN Transmission Pathway to 2030 programme of works, we have EHV Cable Engineering opportunities at Professional, and Senior level, to join our HVDC Project Engineering team to help drive forward our projects and successfully deliver a network for Net Zero. Our projects include state\-of the\-art AC and DC cable system technology, and traverse marine and terrestrial environments across the UK.



Our Cable Project Engineering roles are key in driving technical excellence, quality of installation, best practice, and resolution to design risks/technical issues. These roles reside within SSEN Transmission’s Offshore Project Engineering Team and primarily focus on HVDC cable projects. Experience with Transmission networks is advantageous, although not essential. We encourage candidates with a project engineering background, ideally with HV/EHV cable engineering background in contractor, consultancy or client organisations to apply.


**You will**


* Support project Front End Engineering Design (FEED) activities such as options assessment, cable route development, landfall selection and risk assessment. This includes interdisciplinary working alongside various teams including environmental and land consenting, geotechnical, civil and offshore installation engineers.


* Promote the safety\-in\-design ethos and discharge these CDM duties on behalf of SSE Transmission As a key member of Designer and Principal Designer teams. This includes risk reduction (technical, quality, health, and safety) to the point of elimination or as low as is reasonably practicable.


* Review and acceptance of Contractor engineering and design deliverables for compliance with Employer's requirements, legislation and safe practice.


* Supervise installation and commissioning works for compliance with Employer's requirements and legislation.


* Support and mentoring of junior engineers, ensuring they are adequately supported throughout traineeship.


**Our** **Senior roles include the following additional responsibilities:**


* Inform the HVDC cable system requirements for Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) Contracts and supporting the tender review process as part of the technical team.


* Coordinate and support the installation and commissioning works for compliance with the Employer’s requirements, legislation – promoting health \& safety.


* Technical leadership, mentorship, and driving excellence within the HVDC Project Engineering team.


* Lead special analytical studies, solves complex and ambiguous problems.


**You have**


* A qualification of minimum BEng/BSc qualification level in a relevant engineering discipline.


* Technical knowledge and experience in holding key technical position(s) during development and delivery of a HVDC or HVAC transmission cable projects.


* Work experience and understanding of EPC contracts and CDM regulations; particularly with respect to roles of Supervisor and Principal Designer.


* Competent awareness and working knowledge of relevant industry standards, specifications and recommendations.


* Excellent communication, time\-management, and organisational skills.


* Experience and enthusiasm for giving mentorship/guidance to junior engineers and building technical excellence within the team and wider business.


**About SSE**



SSE’s purpose is to be restless every day until we make electricity clean, affordable and available for all.



We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. This includes electricity transmission and distribution networks, onshore and offshore wind farms, hydro\-electric power and flexible thermal generation. We also provide products and services for businesses and other customers.



Our investment plan will see SSE invest £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure to 2030\.



SSEN Transmission own and operate the electricity transmission network across the north of Scotland. We transport electricity from where it is generated to where it is needed, ensuring a safe and reliable electricity supply for the communities we serve. But that's not all – we're upgrading the grid to deliver cleaner, homegrown power for the future and building the infrastructure needed for a cleaner electricity system to create secure power for generations to come.

new_jobs.title: Senior Engineer - Open Banking Europe
new_jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior Engineer \- Open Banking Europe
Overview:  

Software engineers working on Mastercard’s Open Banking platform play a key role in the development and maintenance of the products that secure high quality connectivity to banks across Europe. Building on the strong foundation of our state\-of\-the\-art bank connectivity APIs, the engineers create turn\-key solutions that take the burden of handling account information and payment initiation services from customers that want to spend their efforts building great products that leverage the full potential of the Open Banking standard.  

  

Role:  

Open Banking engineers work at the bleeding edge of the account information and payment initiation technologies, often solving problems that are yet to be tackled within the industry in areas of API security, data accessibility, processing, and analysis. You will be joining a group of highly skilled individuals working together as a team to push the limits of what is possible to achieve with open banking.  

  

You will have many colleagues around different countries, with your nearest peers being located primarily in Denmark, Ireland and Poland.  

  

About you:  

We are looking for motivated individuals that are looking to be a part of an established team comprised of both industry veterans as well as newcomers. What they all have in common is the understanding that in order to achieve great things, being able to work together as a team is a must.  

You will be spending most of your time in the Microsoft domain, meaning APIs built in C\# with .NET (latest version) and ASP.NET deployed to the cloud (Azure, AWS). Deep knowledge of at least some of these areas is a requirement. However, we believe that learning is a part of the job, so if you for example have extensive experience building ASP.NET apps, but not in the cloud, do not hesitate to apply regardless.  

  

Beyond that, it is expected that you have experience building software using modern development standards, meaning it should not come as a surprise that we utilise all the tools at our disposal from standard ticketing systems (Azure DevOps), VCS, test automation, to CI/CD pipelines.  

Additionally, if you have experience with provisioning infrastructure as code (Terraform) as well as interest in computer security (Certificates, HTTPS) it would be a great benefit. Prior experience from working in closely regulated industries (financial, medical, etc.) is welcome, but not required.  

  

And above all, we hope that you love solving problems!**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Luxoft has one of the world's leading Murex practices. We are a top\-tier Murex Alliance Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade and migration. Build, test, and provide support to clients on MX.3 integration modules.


Contribute to project implementations

Develop an understanding of ongoing activities and manage own deliverables / progress


Manage bug fixes and enhancements with the Product Team


Integrate with various teams to deliver the right solution to client.


Work with S4C stream leads, Front\-Office, Back\-Office, or Risk teams to understand requirements and develop solutions for the client.


Work with the Product division team to provide them timely details on defects – how to reproduce the issue, project/client constraints, and how to validate the fix.

Use SQL for end\-of\-day report generation, STP (straight through processing) failure issues, P\&L evaluation, for analyzing issues in trade feed and status Etc.


Java programming skills are not essential but are a plus.


Various Murex proprietary languages and formats: Data Query Language for querying in various screens in MX.3, MSL (Murex Scripting Language) for pre\-trade logic, XMLF for post\-trade flow processing, MxML in various contexts, etc.


Create shell/python scripts for automation of day\-to\-day manual activities.


Understand requirements, analyze the problem areas of the current system and behavior of pre


trade and post\-trade workflow, and integration points.

Must have


Must:


4\+ years experience with Murex Datamart and workflows

SQL; XML; MxML; UNIX; Scripting languages

new_jobs.title: Specialist Engineer – System Design Tools
new_jobs.description:
As Specialist Engineer – System Design Tools, you will provide long\-term technical ownership of the System Design software ecosystem and support its continued evolution. Working at the intersection of engineering and software development, you will ensure that our engineering tools remain maintainable, scalable, and aligned with business and engineering needs. You will collaborate with engineers across projects and regions to translate engineering methodologies into robust software solutions while promoting modern software engineering practices, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.


  
* Provide technical ownership of the System Design software ecosystem.
* Define and maintain software architecture, development standards, and engineering practices.
* Lead and coordinate software development activities across the System Design Tool Development Group.
* Develop, review, and maintain engineering software using modern software engineering practices.
* Plan, validate, document, and support software releases.
* Translate engineering requirements into maintainable software solutions.
* Support modernization of legacy applications and drive continuous improvement.
* Mentor software contributors and promote knowledge sharing.
* Collaborate with engineers, Principal Engineers, and Engineering Managers to support engineering delivery and future capability development.
* Evaluate new technologies and identify opportunities for automation and digitalization.

  
**Essential**

* Experience within System Design.
* M.Sc. in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
* Experience developing engineering or scientific software.
* Strong understanding of software architecture and software engineering principles.
* Proficiency in Python, VBA, and modern software development practices.
